title: Data Analyst (Freelancer)
description:
About Us:

Deccan AI experts is a pioneering company founded by IIT Bombay and IIM Ahmedabad alumni, with a strong founding team from IITs, NITs, and BITS. We specialize in delivering high-quality human-curated data, AI-first scaled operations services, and more. Based in SF and Hyderabad, we are a young, fast-moving team on a mission to build AI for Good, driving innovation and positive societal impact.




About the Role:

We are looking for a Data Analyst to evaluate and refine data-oriented outputs generated by AI systems. You will analyze datasets, validate AI-generated insights, and enhance the model’s ability to interpret patterns and derive meaningful conclusions. Your analytical expertise will directly influence the training of next-generation analytical AI tools.




Responsibilities:

 * Analyze AI-generated data insights, reports, and dashboards.
 * Validate statistical accuracy, data logic, and analytical reasoning.
 * Identify inconsistencies, anomalies, or incorrect interpretation
 * Provide structured feedback to strengthen AI understanding of analytics.
 * Review prompts involving data cleaning, EDA, visualization, and metrics.




Requirements:

 * Strong foundation in data analysis, Excel, SQL, and visualization tools.
 * Experience with Python, Pandas, NumPy, or analytical workflows is a plus.
 * Understanding of statistics, data validation, and business intelligence.
 * Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving and reasoning skills.




Why Join Us?

 * Work on high-impact projects that contribute to building AI for Good.
 * Collaborate with top-tier engineers and domain experts from IITs, NITs, and BITS.
 * Opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.




NOTE: This will be a flexible freelancing opportunity. Pay will vary by project and typically is up to ₹1500 per hour.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Better is the first AI-native mortgage and home equity finance company, revolutionizing one of the largest financial markets in the world. We make home finance radically more transparent; using AI and proprietary technology to eliminate friction from the mortgage process through our industry-leading AI platform, Tinman®, and the first voice-based AI mortgage assistant, Betsy™. Our mission is simple: make homeownership cheaper, faster and more accessible by transforming how people buy and finance homes.

The facts that speak for themselves:



 * We’ve funded over $110 billion in loans (more than any other fintech in the US!)
 * Raised over $1.2 billion in equity capital to modernize the $15 trillion mortgage industry
 * Better’s propriety AI platform makes us an award-winning lender:
 * Fintech Breakthrough Award 2025: Best Lending Innovation
 * Yahoo! Finance (Jan 2025): Best Mortgage Lender for First-Time Homebuyers – Best for quick approval
 * Yahoo! Finance (2025): Best Online Mortgage Lender
 * Money Magazine (2025): Best for fast closing
 * Forbes (2023): Best Online Mortgage Lender
   
   
   
   

We’re building the future of home finance—and we’re looking for smart, driven, ambitious innovators who are ready to tackle the most impactful work of their careers.

Role Overview
The Data Analyst will support the Regulatory Strategy & Operations (RSO) team in delivering accurate, timely, and scalable regulatory reporting and compliance analytics across the organization. This role sits at the intersection of data, automation, and regulatory execution, supporting critical filings such as HMDA (Home Mortgage Disclosure Act), NMLS MCR (Mortgage Call Reports), and other state and federal reporting requirements.

This is a high-visibility, execution-focused role with a fast track to independent ownership of regulatory data workflows and automation initiatives.

Key Responsibilities


 * Support end-to-end data preparation and validation for HMDA LAR, NMLS MCR, and other regulatory filings
 * Write, optimize, and troubleshoot complex SQL queries to extract and validate large datasets from internal systems
 * Develop Python-based validation scripts to automate regulatory data checks and field-level calculations
 * Partner with US-based compliance stakeholders to ensure data accuracy, completeness, and timely submission
 * Perform field-level testing, reconciliation, and variance analysis across regulatory datasets
 * Identify root causes of data inconsistencies and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Operations teams to remediate
 * Maintain structured documentation of data logic, transformations, and validation frameworks
 * Build reusable SQL and Python workflows to reduce manual reporting effort
 * Support automation of recurring regulatory processes and validation checks
 * Contribute to scalable data models supporting regulatory dashboards and executive reporting
 * Develop dashboards and visualizations (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.) to monitor regulatory metrics and data quality trends
 * Perform structured analysis to support remediation tracking and compliance risk monitoring
   
   
   
   

Required Qualifications


 * Bachelor’s degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or related field
 * 3–4 years of experience in a data analyst or similar role
 * Strong proficiency in SQL, including complex joins, window functions, aggregations, and performance optimization
 * Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation
 * Advanced Excel skills
 * Experience with data visualization tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker, etc.)
 * Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving abilities
 * Ability to work in a fast-paced, deadline-driven regulatory environment
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills
   
   
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Experience working with large datasets in cloud data warehouses (Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake, etc.)
 * Exposure to HMDA, MCR, or other regulatory reporting frameworks
 * Experience with ETL processes and data modeling
 * Understanding of mortgage lifecycle data (origination, underwriting, closing, servicing)
 * Experience in FinTech, mortgage, or other highly regulated environments
   
   
   
   

Company Benefits
In Office Perks

Experience our comprehensive office perks, including daily meals and transport facility for commuting to and from the office, available for all employees coming to the office.

Health & Well-being

Our comprehensive medical plan is available for you, your spouse and dependents. Employees are covered under Mediclaim, Group Term life insurance and Accidental insurance.

Other Perks at Better

Experience flexibility with our night shift allowance, work from home allowance and transportation allowance, where applicable. We prioritize your convenience.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Data Analyst, Marketing Procurement
description:
ABOUT UNILEVER: Be part of the world’s most successful, purpose-led business. Work with brands that are well-loved around the world, that strive to improve the lives of our consumers and the communities around us every day. Every day, nine out of ten Indian households use our products to feel good, look good and get more out of life – giving us a unique opportunity to build a brighter future. We promote innovation, big and small, to make our business win and grow; and we believe in business as a force for good. Our brilliant business leaders and colleagues provide mentorship and inspiration, so you can be at your best.

At HUL, we believe that every individual irrespective of their race, colour, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, nationality, caste, disability or marital status can bring their purpose to life. So apply to us, to unleash your curiosity, challenge ideas and disrupt processes; use your energy to make the world a better place. As you work to make a real impact on the business and the world, we’ll work to help you become a better you!

Position: Assistant Manager - Data Analyst

Location: Mumbai

Main Job Purpose

The Data Analyst supports the Marketing Procurement Business Group (BG) Leads in delivering data-driven insights and reporting that enhance the efficiency and effectiveness of Unilever’s Marketing Procurement operations. The role enables better decision-making through advanced analytics, dashboarding, and data visualisation, helping drive portfolio strategy, reduce fragmentation, leverage scale, and unlock 4G growth.

About Procurement

Procurement sits within Unilever’s Supply Chain organization and manages more than €30B in global spend across 60,000+ suppliers. The team ensures materials and services are responsibly sourced, drives financial value through competitive buying, and partners closely with the business to meet consumer, customer, and employee needs. With a strong focus on digitalization, Procurement embeds advanced analytics, tools, and data-based decision making across operations. Our strategy—Procurement with Purpose—centres on buying responsibly, buying better, and growing with partners through value, partnership, and transformation.

ABOUT Marketing Procurement

Unilever’s Marketing Procurement team is responsible for Unilever’s sourcing and supplier strategy and execution for all third party spend across Marketing. We support the business requirements of Brands, Business Groups, Markets, and functions to drive 4G growth through strategic supplier management, cost and value management, sustainability and innovation, aligned with Unilever’s Compass. The team manages an annual spend of 6.5B Euro with a supplier base of about 9,000.

This role supports Marketing Procurement BG Leads in partnering with Global Brand Teams and Business Units to strengthen Marketing Procurement performance, streamline processes, build capabilities, and align strategies across markets and portfolios

The Data Analyst will support the Marketing Procurement BG leads by providing the data insights and creating decks to support increased efficiency of our marketing procurement by driving scale where it makes sense, decreasing fragmentation, prioritizing higher impact areas, leveraging technology and data, and drive performance that unlocks 4G growth for Unilever.

Key Accountabilities


 * Collaborate with Marketing Procurement BG Leads to drive data-based analysis and insights.
 * Extract, consolidate, and manage datasets from internal tools, platforms, and systems.
 * Conduct data analysis and visualisation, transitioning work from Excel to Python and Power BI.
 * Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and KPIs to track performance, identify trends, and provide actionable insights.
 * Prepare high-quality presentations using advanced PowerPoint skills for senior stakeholders.
   
   

Support reporting across the four Business Groups: Beauty & Wellbeing, Personal Care, Home Care, and Foods.


 * Develop data-driven insights aligned to portfolio strategies and business needs across the marketing value chain.
 * Interpret marketing spend data to support future-fit procurement strategies.
 * Ensure alignment with Unilever Compass, BG priorities, market needs, Procurement with Purpose, and Marketing Procurement principles
   
   

Experience Required

Qualification/experience


 * 3 - 5+ years of data analytics experience,
 * Understanding of marketing value chains, marketing trends and FMCG is preferable.
   
   

Technical Skills & Competencies


 * Strong data analytics and information management background.
 * Advanced PowerPoint and Excel capabilities; ability to create clear, data-led narratives.
 * Hands-on experience transitioning analytics from Excel into Power BI or other dashboarding tools.
 * Strong data manipulation, cleansing, and analytical modelling skills.
 * Experience with data warehouses, reporting frameworks, and dashboard development.
 * Ability to convert complex datasets into actionable insights and compelling visual stories.
 * Proficiency in visualising data across tools (e.g., Power BI, PowerPoint) General Skills & Competencies
   
   

General Skills & Competencies


 * Strong communication and interpersonal skills; effective in cross-functional and multicultural environments.
 * Detail-oriented, analytical, and comfortable working with ambiguity.
 * Ability to work under pressure and balance multiple stakeholder needs in a global context.
 * Change-oriented mindset with a passion for continuous improvement.
 * Strong financial and business acumen with the ability to translate data into strategic insights.
 * Resilient, persistent, and capable of driving results against challenging goals.
   
   

Travel

Limited international travel required. Not projected to require more than 20% on average (may vary based on location/projects)

Procurement

Internal:


 * Marketing Leadership Team
 * Marketing Procurement BG Leads
 * Portfolio teams
 * In-Market Sourcing teams
 * Data & Analytics team
 * Procurement Strategy and Insights Business partners:
 * Business Groups
 * Business Units
 * Marketing
 * Finance
 * Legal

title: Analyst-Data Science
description:
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience this powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.




How will you make an impact in this role?


How we serve our customers is constantly evolving and is a challenge we gladly accept. Whether you’re finding new ways to prevent identity fraud or enabling customers to start a new business, you can work with one of the most valuable data sets in the world to identify insights and actions that can have a meaningful impact on our customers and our business. And, with opportunities to learn from leaders who have defined the course of our industry, you can grow your career and define your own path. Find your place in risk and analytics on #TeamAmex.


The Analytics, Investment & Marketing enablement (AIM) team – is the analytical engine that enables the Global Commercial Services (GCS) card business. The team drives Profitable Growth in Acquisitions through Data, Analytics, AI powered Targeting & Personalization Capabilities.


About the Role


This Analyst - Data Science role, based out of India, part of AIM team would be responsible for US Prospect Analytics for sales channels. The incumbent will be responsible for performing strategic analyses, synthesizing conclusions, and communicating recommendations to partners aimed at driving revenue through prospect acquisitions. The position is part of a highly collaborative environment, interacting with and influencing partners across the Global Commercial Service’s business at American Express. The role will require the incumbent to drive not only sophisticated analysis but also heavy partner management through thought-leadership.


A very important focus for the role shall be quantitatively determining the value, deriving insights, and then assuring the insights are leveraged to create positive impact that cause a meaningful difference to the business. This B30 will support the B35 and would serve as a key interface between various partners – the functional channel owners, the business partners and end-users of analytical solutions and technology partners.




Key Responsibilities include:

 * 
   Spearheading analytics to drive commercial acquisitions in sales channels for US market using GenAI, data science, big data capabilities and advanced analytical techniques.
   
   
   
   
 * 
   Enable decision making across channels and markets by exploring big data and advanced analytics techniques which includes creating segmentation logic, prompt engineering, traditional ML techniques for prioritization of leads and lead intelligence arbitration.
   
   
   
   
 * 
   Support and enable the GCS partners with actionable, insightful analytical solutions to help the leadership team evaluate and drive business performance.
   
   
   
   
 * 
   A self-initiator who is quick to understand the business and support pilot projects amidst ambiguity.
   
   
   
   
 * 
   Independently manage cross-collaboration among marketing, sales, capabilities, and modeling teams to ensure analytics and data science-based strategies are appropriately incorporated and timely deployed / tracked.
   
   
   
   
 * 
   Exceptional execution skills – be able to resolve issues, find opportunities, and define success metrics and make things happen.
   
   
   
   
 * 
   Excellent communication skills with the ability to engage, influence, and inspire partners and stakeholders to drive collaboration and alignment.
   
   
   
   
 * 
   Willingness to challenge the status quo; breakthrough thinking to generate insights, alternatives, and opportunities for business success.
   
   


Minimum Qualifications
 * 0-3 years of experience in relevant domain.
 * Degree in a quantitative field preferred – e.g. B. Tech; BSc/MSc Statistics, Bachelors/master’s in economics
 * Knowledge of Hive, Python, PySpark, SQL, ChatGPT encompassing data manipulation and statistical modeling/data-mining techniques and knowledge of decision trees
 * Strong analytical skills: Applying analytical thinking to diagnose business needs and to establish analytical hypothesis and solutions. Drive insights and recommendations on marketing and product solutions.
 * Know-how of GenAI techniques to automate and innovate on current processes and should be able to integrate GenAI techniques with current business solutions to drive marketing efficiency.
 * Strong communication skills enabling ability to interact effectively with business leaders and to present structured and compelling messages addressed to various levels within the organization
 * Team player: Able to collaborate with partners and team members to define key business objectives, and to align on solutions that drive actionable items
 * Passion for data science and machine learning: Proven track record of independently developing novel analytical solutions optimizing business processes or product constructs

Preferred Qualifications:
 * 
   Experience in Advanced GenAI techniques, marketing/acquisition analytics/data science; relevant industry experience preferred
    
   

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
 * Competitive base salaries 
 * Bonus incentives 
 * Support for financial-well-being and retirement 
 * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location) 
 * Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need 
 * Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location) 
 * Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location) 
 * Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program 
 * Career development and training opportunities

About the Role


This Analyst - Data Science role, based out of India, part of AIM team would be responsible for US Prospect Analytics for sales channels. The incumbent will be responsible for performing strategic analyses, synthesizing conclusions, and communicating recommendations to partners aimed at driving revenue through prospect acquisitions. The position is part of a highly collaborative environment, interacting with and influencing partners across the Global Commercial Service’s business at American Express. The role will require the incumbent to drive not only sophisticated analysis but also heavy partner management through thought-leadership.


A very important focus for the role shall be quantitatively determining the value, deriving insights, and then assuring the insights are leveraged to create positive impact that cause a meaningful difference to the business. This B30 will support the B35 and would serve as a key interface between various partners – the functional channel owners, the business partners and end-users of analytical solutions and technology partners.

  • A self-initiator who is quick to understand the business and support pilot projects amidst ambiguity.

  • Strong analytical skills: Applying analytical thinking to diagnose business needs and to establish analytical hypothesis and solutions. Drive insights and recommendations on marketing and product solutions.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
About the Role:

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst who will work on a broad range of data analytics, data visualization and business intelligence problems across a variety of industries.

More specifically, you will:

 * Engage with clients to understand their business context
 * Understand business processes and map the complete process in visual formats.
 * Translate business problems into analytical structures and solve using statistical/ML techniques
 * Manage a team of data analysts to deliver solutions for clients.
 * Collaborate with a team of data scientists and engineers to embed AI and analytics into the business decision processes.

Desired Skills & Competencies:

 * Developing and enhancing algorithms and models to solve business problem.
 * Providing end-to-end analysis support across different industry domains and application areas.
 * Generate data cuts/outputs according to agreed specifications (for example, survey data clean up, weighting data, recoding variables, creating custom tabular views, and running cross-tabulations)
 * Conducting quantitative analyses and interpreting results
 * Proficient in visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QlikView, Spotfire (Any).
 * Proficient in MS SQL Database.
 * Python knowledge is good to have.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Storyboarding, Client Interaction is a value addition.

Education & Desired Experience

 * 3 - 6 years of relevant Analytics experience with focus on problem solving and advanced analytics solutions
 * B.E, MBA or an Advanced degree in Mathematics/Statistics or Equivalent.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Job Description

Job Purpose

This individual will be responsible for creating Tableau dashboard reports, creating business intelligence reports and visualizations, and collaborating with the BI team to analyze and interpret large datasets. The goal is to provide actionable insights that drive business decisions and performance.

Data & Document Automation (DDA) is an automation solution that automates key business processes for lenders, investors, and servicers. Data and Document Services (DDS) provides critical value-added services to Lenders, Investors and Servicers.

Responsibilities


 * Data Visualization: Create comprehensive Tableau dashboard reports that effectively communicate data insights and business performance metrics.
 * Collaboration: Collaborate with the Business Intelligence team to define, design and implement data visualization solutions that provide business critical insights. Collaborate with stakeholders to understand the requirements and provide data driven solutions.
 * Data Analysis: Analyze and interpret a large variety of datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that inform business strategies.
 * Documentation: Develop and maintain documentation for data analysis processes, dashboard designs, and report generation procedures.
 * Data Quality: Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing regular data quality checks and validations.
 * Data Integrity: Good understanding of PII data and protect data to which they have access.
 * Training: Participate in the continuous improvement of data analysis methodologies and learn new data sets. Train end users on dashboards and reports
   
   

Knowledge And Experience


 * College degree or equivalent industry experience in Information Systems, Business Analysis, Data Analysis.
 * 1 to 2 years of experience
 * Expertise in data analysis tools and techniques, including Tableau, Python, Splunk, Unix, Shell Scripting, SQL, XML and Excel is required.
 * Experience with analyzing large volumes of data, identifying trends, and providing insights that support business decisions.
 * Experience managing accuracy and integrity of data in all reports and visualizations.
 * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal, with effective communication of complex data insights to various stakeholders.
 * Experience working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
 * Proven experience with identifying issues and developing solutions that enhance data analysis processes and outcomes.
 * Availability: Work in 24 / 7 shifts

title: Data Analyst (Freelancer)
description:
About Us:

Deccan AI experts is a pioneering company founded by IIT Bombay and IIM Ahmedabad alumni, with a strong founding team from IITs, NITs, and BITS. We specialize in delivering high-quality human-curated data, AI-first scaled operations services, and more. Based in SF and Hyderabad, we are a young, fast-moving team on a mission to build AI for Good, driving innovation and positive societal impact.

We are looking for a Data Analyst to evaluate and refine data-oriented outputs generated by AI systems. Requirements:

 * Experience with Python, Pandas, NumPy, or analytical workflows is a plus.
 * Understanding of statistics, data validation, and business intelligence.
 * Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving and reasoning skills.




Why Join Us?

 * Work on high-impact projects that contribute to building AI for Good.
 * Collaborate with top-tier engineers and domain experts from IITs, NITs, and BITS.
 * Opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.




NOTE: This will be a flexible freelancing opportunity. Pay will vary by project and typically is up to ₹1500 per hour.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About Fyle (now part of Sage)

We are Fyle, a SaaS start-up focused on business expense management with real time card feed. We help companies of all sizes manage their expenses with a powerful platform that makes it easy to track, report, and reconcile expenses. Our goal is to help companies save time and money so they can focus on growing their businesses, but we cannot do that without you!




We take our data seriously — but not ourselves. We're a team that values curiosity, ownership, and the ability to present insights clearly (ideally with a good sense of humour). If that sounds like your vibe, we'd love to hear from you!




About the Role

We're hiring our first Data Analyst to build foundational capabilities in how we query, analyse, and act on data. You'll work closely with Engineering and Product teams to unblock data access, improve instrumentation, and drive better decisions through clear, actionable insights. This is a high-impact role with both operational and strategic dimensions.




What You'll Need

Must-Have Skills

 * SQL (PostgreSQL): You should be highly proficient.
 * Google Sheets / Excel: Solid working knowledge, including formulas, pivot tables, and basic charting.
 * Analytical Thinking: Comfortable working with raw data to identify patterns and derive insights.
 * Presentation Skills: Ability to summarize, format, and communicate findings clearly — charts, not data dumps.
 * High Agency: You don't wait for someone to tell you what to do. You figure out what needs to be done and do it.
 * Experience: 3-4 years in a data-heavy role (e.g., data analyst, business analyst, product analyst).




Good-to-Have

 * Prior experience with Mixpanel or similar product analytics tools.
 * Familiarity with data visualization tools like Looker, Metabase, or Google Data Studio.
 * Exposure to SaaS or product analytics in a B2B setting.
 * Comfort using AI tools (e.g., ChatGPT) effectively as part of your workflow




Key Responsibilities




1. Own Data Operations

 * Be the go-to person for data queries across Product and Business teams.
 * Take ownership of data running tasks currently handled by engineering, freeing them to focus on core product work.
 * Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and workflows that democratize data access internally.
 * Help teams self-serve using tools like Mixpanel and Google Sheets.
 * Leverage AI tools extensively in your workflows, while ensuring data consistency.




2. Enable Better Instrumentation

 * Audit and clean up event tracking in Mixpanel to ensure consistent naming and complete coverage.
 * Collaborate with Engineering to define and implement key tracking events and data structures.
 * Establish best practices around analytics data hygiene.




3. Drive Analytical Insight

 * Explore behavioural and product usage data to identify leading indicators of customer retention, product adoption, and engagement.
 * Run exploratory and hypothesis-driven analysis to inform the product roadmap.
 * Identify patterns and surface trends that others may not be looking for — and present them in a way that drives action.




Caveats

 * This is not a junior role. You'll be expected to hit the ground running with minimal handholding.
 * Some meetings or collaboration may happen during early mornings or late evenings (to overlap with North America).
 * If you prefer someone else to structure the analysis and just execute queries, this probably isn't the role for you

title: Data Analyst
description:
Role:

We are looking for a Tableau Developer with over 1+ years of hands-on experience in building tableau dashboards, reports, and data models. The candidate should have solid knowledge SQL, Excel and any BI Tools and be capable of delivering insightful and interactive business reports based on requirements from business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

 * Design, develop, and maintain Tableau dashboards, reports, and visualizations based on business requirements.
 * Work closely with business analysts, data engineers, and stakeholders to understand data needs and translate them into effective visual solutions.
 * Optimize Tableau dashboards for performance and usability.
 * Create data extracts, calculations, and parameters to support dynamic reporting.
 * Integrate Tableau with various data sources (SQL, Excel, cloud databases, etc.).
 * Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability in all dashboards and reports.
 * Participate in data validation and testing activities.
 * Document technical processes, data models, and dashboard functionalities.

What You’ll Bring:

 * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Applications, or a related field
 * Proven experience delivering high-quality dashboards.

Mandatory Skills

 * 2–4 years of hands-on experience with Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server.
 * Strong understanding of SQL and relational databases.
 * Experience working with large datasets and complex data models.
 * Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
 * Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have:

 * Experience with another BI tool Power BI.
 * Knowledge of ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks, Fabric, or Snowflake.
 * Knowledge of Azure, AWS, or GCP and their data ecosystem.

  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability in all dashboards and reports.
  • Participate in data validation and testing activities.
  • Document technical processes, data models, and dashboard functionalities.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Applications, or a related field
  • Proven experience delivering high-quality dashboards.

Mandatory Skills

  • 2–4 years of hands-on experience with Tableau Desktop and Tableau Server.
  • Strong understanding of SQL and relational databases.
  • Experience working with large datasets and complex data models.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical specifications.
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills.

Nice to Have:

  • Experience with another BI tool Power BI.
  • Knowledge of ETL/ELT pipelines using Databricks, Fabric, or Snowflake.

title: Data Analyst (Freelancer)
description:
About Us:

Deccan AI experts is a pioneering company founded by IIT Bombay and IIM Ahmedabad alumni, with a strong founding team from IITs, NITs, and BITS. We specialize in delivering high-quality human-curated data, AI-first scaled operations services, and more. Based in SF and Hyderabad, we are a young, fast-moving team on a mission to build AI for Good, driving innovation and positive societal impact.




About the Role:

We are looking for a Data Analyst to evaluate and refine data-oriented outputs generated by AI systems. You will analyze datasets, validate AI-generated insights, and enhance the model’s ability to interpret patterns and derive meaningful conclusions. Your analytical expertise will directly influence the training of next-generation analytical AI tools.




Responsibilities:

 * Analyze AI-generated data insights, reports, and dashboards.
 * Validate statistical accuracy, data logic, and analytical reasoning.
 * Identify inconsistencies, anomalies, or incorrect interpretation
 * Provide structured feedback to strengthen AI understanding of analytics.
 * Review prompts involving data cleaning, EDA, visualization, and metrics.




Requirements:

 * Strong foundation in data analysis, Excel, SQL, and visualization tools.
 * Experience with Python, Pandas, NumPy, or analytical workflows is a plus.
 * Understanding of statistics, data validation, and business intelligence.
 * Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving and reasoning skills.




Why Join Us?

 * Work on high-impact projects that contribute to building AI for Good.
 * Collaborate with top-tier engineers and domain experts from IITs, NITs, and BITS.
 * Opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.




NOTE: This will be a flexible freelancing opportunity. Pay will vary by project and typically is up to ₹1500 per hour.

description:
* Oversee all aspects of quality assurance including establishing and reporting on metrics, applying industry best practices and developing new tools and processes to ensure quality goals are met.
 * Adhere to formal QA processes, ensuring that the Data & BI Implementation team is using Industry accepted best Practices.

 * Act as key point of contact for all QA aspects of releases, providing test services and coordinating QA resources internally and externally in SQL.
 * Create and Provide Feedback on test cases, scripts, plans and Procedures (manual and automated) responsible for executing them.
 * The entire Data/BI solution development life cycle and test cycles (unit, Regression, Functional, Systems, stress& scale, smoke and sanity)
 * Strong experience in functional testing and test automation.
 * Process breakdown & testing the different scenarios at every step.
 * Diagnose defects and track them from discovery to resolution.
 * Ensure all testing work is carried out in accordance with the testing plan, Including schedule and quality requirement.
 * Collaborates with data warehouse architect, the ETL lead and BI developers in the construction and execution of test scenarios including those applicable to the development, test and production data warehouse environment.
 * Perform necessary BI UX testing, BI run, ETL runs, maintain quality monitoring dashboard/report etc.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About the Team

The Analytics team at Navi plays a pivotal role in driving data-informed decision-making across the organization. We work closely with all business functions to generate insights, build visibility, and validate hypotheses that shape strategy and execution. Our work spans five key verticals: Business and Product Analytics, Credit & Credit Risk Analytics, Collections & Biz-fin Analytics, Self-Serve and Automation.




About the Role

Data analyst is a key role within the Navi central analytics team, which bridges the gap between business teams and data. Their responsibilities would be around creating visibility across business KPIs, essential reports, dashboards for key business metrics. They will also work on leveraging automation for operational efficiency and data modeling to build a strong data infrastructure for easy access across teams.

This is an entry level position within the team where you will get the opportunity to work with highly motivated colleagues to build data based solutions that will have direct business impact.




Must Haves

● Bachelor's degree in Technology

● Proven 1-3 years of experience as an Analyst

● Proficiency in data analysis tools Excel, SQL, and any data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI etc)

● Basic understanding of data platforms and ETL processes

● Ability to interpret complex data sets, has good attention to

detail

● Problem Solving skills

● (Good to have) Prior data wrangling experience in R/Python




What We Expect From You

Data Management:

○ Collect, organize, and maintain large datasets from multiple sources.

○ Ensure data accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

○ Develop and implement data quality standards and procedures.

Analysis and Reporting:

○ Use SQL Query, VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, and other Excel functions to analyze financial and operational data.

○ Prepare regular and ad-hoc reports for management, highlighting key performance metrics, trends, and insights.

○ Identify areas for improvement and recommend actionable solutions based on data analysis.

Dashboard Development:

○ Design and develop interactive dashboards using Tableau, Excel or specialized BI tools.

○ Customize dashboards to meet specific departmental or stakeholder

requirements.

○ Continuously monitor and update dashboards to reflect the latest data and insights.

Process Optimization and stakeholder management:

○ Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline data collection and reporting processes.

○ Identify inefficiencies and bottlenecks in existing workflows and propose enhancements. ○ Implement automation solutions to improve efficiency and accuracy in data management and reporting.




Inside Navi

We are shaping the future of financial services for a billion Indians through products that are simple, accessible, and affordable. From Personal & Home Loans to UPI, Insurance, Mutual Funds, and Gold — we’re building tech-first solutions that work at scale, with a strong customer-first approach.

Founded by Sachin Bansal & Ankit Agarwal in 2018, we are one of India’s fastest-growing financial services organisations. But we’re just getting started!




Our Culture

The Navi DNA

Ambition. Perseverance. Self-awareness. Ownership. Integrity.

We’re looking for people who dream big when it comes to innovation. At Navi, you’ll be empowered with the right mechanisms to work in a dynamic team that builds and improves innovative solutions. If you’re driven to deliver real value to customers, no matter the challenge, this is the place for you.

We chase excellence by uplifting each other—and that starts with every one of us.

Why You'll Thrive at Navi

At Navi, it’s about how you think, build, and grow. You’ll thrive here if:

● You’re impact-driven

You take ownership, build boldly, and care about making a real difference.

● You strive for excellence

Good isn’t good enough. You bring focus, precision, and a passion for quality.

● You embrace change

You adapt quickly, move fast, and always put the customer first.

title: Data Analyst
description:

We are seeking a Senior Project Coordinator with 8 to 11 years of experience to join our team. The ideal candidate will have expertise in SnM DigiMktg SnM MDM and SnM Data Lake. This hybrid role requires a proactive individual who can manage projects effectively ensuring alignment with our strategic goals. The candidate will contribute to the success of our digital marketing initiatives and data management processes enhancing our companys impact on society.

 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to drive project success.
 * Proficiency in project management tools and methodologies.
 * Experience in a hybrid work model demonstrating flexibility and adaptability.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Type: Contract (2 months) → Potential Conversion

Location: Remote




About Meddflow:

At Meddflow, we believe that healthcare should be smarter, faster, and more connected. Our mission is to build technology that empowers hospitals and clinics to operate seamlessly, reduce inefficiencies, and deliver better patient care without being slowed down by outdated systems.

 

We build seamless, intelligent, and scalable solutions that empower healthcare providers to focus on what truly matters, delivering exceptional patient care.




Beyond our products, Meddflow provides expert consulting services, specializing in workflow optimization, telehealth implementation, inventory and billing management, digital transformation, and change management.




Role Summary:

You will design and build the analytics layer on top of our MongoDB and Firebase infrastructure.




Your responsibility is to convert distributed, document-based healthcare data into structured, decision-ready insights. This role involves close collaboration with product, engineering, and operations teams to ensure that data insights support clinical and operational performance.




This is a contract role (2 months) with the potential to extend or convert full-time based on performance and project needs.




Core Responsibilities:

 * Develop and maintain dashboards using data from MongoDB and Firebase.
 * Design aggregation queries and data transformations to structure patient and operational metrics.
 * Create clean, intuitive, and visually effective dashboards for non-technical stakeholders.
 * Identify trends, anomalies, and performance gaps through data analysis.
 * Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reliability across reporting systems.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine reporting requirements and improve decision-making frameworks.
 * Document methodology, assumptions, and recommendations for further improvement.




Must-Have Skills:

 * 1–5 years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or data reporting roles
 * Working knowledge of MongoDB (including aggregation pipelines and query optimization).
 * Experience working with Firebase / Firestore data structures.
 * Experience with dashboarding or BI tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Metabase or similar platforms.
 * Strong understanding of data visualization principles and user-friendly design.
 * Ability to translate complex datasets into actionable insights.




Nice-to-Haves:

 * Experience working with healthcare or patient-related data.
 * Familiarity with healthcare operational workflows.
 * Basic knowledge of frontend visualization libraries is an advantage.

 

How to Apply:

 

Please send an email to aditya@meddflow.com with the subject line:

“Application: Data Analyst”




Your application must include all three items below (incomplete submissions will not be considered):

 1. A brief summary of a project where you independently designed and delivered a solution.
 2. A GitHub/portfolio link.
 3. Your CV or LinkedIn profile.




⚠️ Note:

·     Direct messages will not be reviewed. Only complete email applications will be processed.

·     We are only considering individual applicants for this role.

·     Freelancers, agencies, or development firms submitting on behalf of others will not be considered.




Next Steps in the Process

 

 * Screening Round (Application Review): We’ll shortlist candidates based on the above submissions.
 * Interview: Direct interview focused on your past work, technical depth, and ability to independently design solutions.




For Queries

 

If you have any questions regarding the role or process, please write to aditya@meddflow.com with the subject line:

Query: Data Analyst




⚠️ Note: Queries sent via direct messages or without the proper subject line will not be addressed.

title: Data Analyst - Cross Sell & Retention Analytics
description:
Designation

Assistant Manager/Data Analyst- Portfolio, Cross Sell & Collection Analytics

Reporting to

Lead-Portfolio/Cross Sell

Location

Mumbai

Function

Analytics

Job Purpose

Join our Portfolio, Cross‑Sell & Collection Analytics team to drive data‑backed strategies that enhance portfolio quality, unlock customer value, and support business growth. You will work across portfolio diagnostics, cross‑sell strategy, and risk insights to help shape smarter credit and customer engagement decisions.

Role

 * Monitor portfolio health through deep‑dive analytics, dashboards, and early‑warning insights
 * Identify high‑value customer segments for cross‑sell using behavioural data and predictive analytics
 * Analyse campaign performance across channels and recommend actions to improve conversion & ROI
 * Partner with marketing to analyse channel performance, campaign effectiveness, and audience targeting.
 * Build data‑driven customer journeys for hyper‑personalized communication across digital channels
 * Conduct root‑cause analysis of portfolio trends, acquisition quality, and campaign outcomes
 * Collaborating with Credit, Risk, Business, Marketing, and Product teams to build data‑led strategies
 * Drive process improvements across data, reporting, and analytics workflows
 * Build actionable insights to improve collection efficiency, pre-delinquency management and reduce overdue buckets.
 * Conduct deep‑dive analysis on customer payment behaviour, delinquency patterns, and slippage root causes.
 * Develop segmentation strategies for early-, mid-, and late‑stage collections.

Qualification & experience

 * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or any quantitative discipline.2–4 years of relevant experience in risk analytics, preferably in BFSI.

Essential skills

 * Strong command of Excel, SQL, Python/R, and statistical modelling.
 * Prior exposure to PL portfolio analytics OR XSell & Collection Analytics.
 * Strong Business Acumen with out of the box thinking
 * Strong Strategic and Tactical communications Skills
 * Ability to work independently

Team or Individual Contributor role

Individual Contributor

title: Analyst - Data Analytics
description:
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.
 

As part of Team Amex, you'll experience this powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.






How will you make an impact in this role?


The Analytics (AIM) team – a part of Global Strategy & Operations, GCS – is the analytical engine that enables the Global Commercial Card business. The team drives profitable growth in Acquisitions through Data, Analytics, AI powered Targeting & Personalization Capabilities.


This role will be an integral part of the customer cross-functional team responsible for driving strategic analysis and initiatives spanning across channels and products for US market. The incumbent would be responsible for analytics solutions that would shape customer acquisitions and organic growth roadmap. The role requires a strong background in data analytics and commercial card knowledge. The position is part of a highly collaborative environment, interacting with and influencing partners across the Global Commercial Service’s business at American Express.

Key Responsibilities Include


 * Support Data Driven Strategy: Conduct analysis to evaluate marketing and sales performance, identify customer trends, and uncover opportunities for growth
   

 * Deliver actionable insights: Translate complex data into clear recommendations for senior leadership and functional partners, supporting decision-making on customer engagement, product performance, and revenue outcomes
   

 * Enable cross-functional decision-making: Effectively engage and deliver results in collaboration with key partners including the functional channel owners, the business partners and end-users of analytical solutions and technology partners

 * Influence and storytelling: Communicate insights in a compelling way, shaping strategic narratives that drive alignment among cross-functional stakeholders and senior leaders
   

Minimum Qualifications


 * Experience of 0-2 years with minimum Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Statistics, Engineering, Physics, Mathematics and Economics).
   
    

   

   
   

 * Strong technical and analytical skills with the ability to apply both quantitative methods and business skills to create insights and drive results

   

   
   
   

 * Ability to work independently and across a matrix organization partnering with business partners, functional owners, capabilities, technology teams and external vendors
   
    

   

   
   
   

 * Strong programming (SQL and Python) skills.
   
    

 * Ability to prioritize and manage several concurrent projects through collaboration across teams/geographies

title: Data Analyst
description:
Req ID: 360688

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Data Analyst to join our team in Hyderbad, Telangana (IN-TG), India (IN).

What are the job duties for this role?

Analyze large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights for business decisions.

Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, aggregate, and validate data from multiple sources.

Use Python for data cleaning, transformation, and advanced analytics, including statistical modeling.

Develop and maintain Power BI dashboards and reports to visualize key metrics and KPIs.

Work with notebooks (Jupyter or similar) to document analysis workflows and share reproducible results.

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver data-driven solutions.

Perform exploratory data analysis (EDA) and generate summary statistics for decision-making.

Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity through rigorous validation and quality checks.

Automate repetitive data tasks using Python scripts and scheduling tools.

Communicate findings clearly through reports, presentations, and visualizations for business teams.

What are the minimum skills required for this role?

Strong proficiency in SQL for querying, data manipulation, and performance optimization.

Hands-on experience with Python for data analysis, including libraries like Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib.

Expertise in Power BI for creating dashboards, reports, and implementing DAX calculations.

Familiarity with notebook environments (Jupyter or similar) for interactive analysis and documentation.

Solid understanding of data cleaning, transformation, and preparation techniques.

Ability to perform statistical analysis and interpret results for actionable insights.

Knowledge of data visualization best practices and storytelling with data.

Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with attention to detail.

Excellent communication skills and ability to work effectively in a 2 PM–11 PM IST shift.

Experience with Microsoft Fabric or cloud-based analytics platforms is a strong plus.

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. While many positions offer remote or hybrid work options, these arrangements are subject to change based on client requirements. For employees near an NTT DATA office or client site, in-office attendance may be required for meetings or events, depending on business needs. At NTT DATA, we are committed to staying flexible and meeting the evolving needs of both our clients and employees. NTT DATA recruiters will never ask for payment or banking information and will only use @nttdata.com and @talent.nttdataservices.com email addresses. If you are requested to provide payment or disclose banking information, please submit a contact us form, https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us.

NTT DATA endeavors to make https://us.nttdata.com accessible to any and all users. If you would like to contact us regarding the accessibility of our website or need assistance completing the application process, please contact us at https://us.nttdata.com/en/contact-us. This contact information is for accommodation requests only and cannot be used to inquire about the status of applications. NTT DATA is an equal opportunity employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status. title: Associate Data Analyst - Enterprise & Reporting
description:
Job Description

Circle K (Part of Alimentation Couche-Tard group) is a global leader in the convenience store and fuel space, it has a footprint across 31 countries and territories. At the Circle K Business Centre in India, we are #OneTeam using the power of data analytics to drive our decisions and strengthen Circle K’s global capabilities. We make it easy for our customers all over the world – we partner with the business to empower the right decisions and deliver effectively, while rapidly unlocking value for our customers across the enterprise. Our team in India is an integral part of our talent ecosystem that helps advance us on our journey to becoming a data-centric company. The future of data analytics at Circle K is bright – and we’re only just getting started.

About The Role

The India Data & Analytics Global Capability Centre (D&A GCC) is an integral part of ACT’s Global Data & Analytics Team, and the Associate Data Analyst will be a key player on this team that will help grow analytics globally at ACT. The hired candidate will partner with multiple departments, including Global Marketing, Merchandising, Global Technology, and Business Units.

The incumbent will be responsible for deploying analytics algorithms and tools on chosen tech stack for efficient and effective delivery. Responsibilities include delivering insights and targeted action plans, address specific areas of risk and opportunity, work cross-functionally with business and technology teams, and leverage the support of global teams for analysis and data.

Roles & Responsibilities

Analytics (Data & Insights)


 * Clean and organize large datasets for analysis and visualization using statistical methods; verify and ensure accuracy, integrity, and consistency of data
 * Identifying trends and patterns in data and using this information to drive business decisions
 * Create the requirement artefacts e.g., Functional specification document, use cases, requirement traceability matrix, business test cases and process mapping documents, user stories for analytics projects
 * Build highly impactful and intuitive dashboards that bring the underlying data to life through insights
 * Generate ad-hoc analysis for leadership to deliver relevant, action-oriented, and innovative recommendations
   
   

Operational Excellence


 * Improve data quality by using and improving tools to automatically detect issues
 * Develop analytical solutions or dashboards using user-centric design techniques in alignment with ACT’s protocol
 * Study industry/organization benchmarks and design/develop analytical solutions to monitor or improve business performance across retail, marketing, and other business areas
   
   

Stakeholder Management


 * Work with high-performing Functional Consultants, Data Engineers, and cross-functional teams to lead / support the complete lifecycle of visual analytical applications, from development of mock-ups and storyboards to complete production ready application
 * Provide regular updates to stakeholders to simplify and clarify complex concepts, and communicate the output of work to business
 * Create compelling documentation or artefacts that connects business to the solutions
 * Coordinate internally to share key learning with other teams and lead to accelerated business performance
   
   

Behavioral Skills


 * Delivery Excellence
 * Business disposition
 * Social intelligence
 * Innovation and agility
   
   

Knowledge


 * Functional Analytics (Retail Analytics, Supply Chain Analytics, Marketing Analytics, Customer Analytics, etc.)
 * Working understanding of Statistical modelling using Analytical tools (Python, PySpark, R, etc.)
 * Enterprise reporting systems, relational (MySQL, Microsoft SQL Server etc.), non-relational (MongoDB, DynamoDB) database management systems
 * Business intelligence & reporting (Power BI, Tableau, Alteryx, etc.)
 * Cloud computing services in Azure/AWS/GCP for analytics
   
   

Education


 * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Management or related technical fields
   
   

Experience


 * 1 - 2 years for Associate Data Analyst
 * Relevant working experience in a quantitative/applied analytics role
 * Experience with programming, and the ability to quickly pick up handling large data volumes with modern data processing tools, e.g. by using Spark / SQL / Python

title: Data Analyst (Freelancer)
description:
About Us:

Deccan AI experts is a pioneering company founded by IIT Bombay and IIM Ahmedabad alumni, with a strong founding team from IITs, NITs, and BITS. We specialize in delivering high-quality human-curated data, AI-first scaled operations services, and more. Based in SF and Hyderabad, we are a young, fast-moving team on a mission to build AI for Good, driving innovation and positive societal impact.




About the Role:

We are looking for a Data Analyst to evaluate and refine data-oriented outputs generated by AI systems. You will analyze datasets, validate AI-generated insights, and enhance the model’s ability to interpret patterns and derive meaningful conclusions. Your analytical expertise will directly influence the training of next-generation analytical AI tools.




Responsibilities:

 * Analyze AI-generated data insights, reports, and dashboards.
 * Validate statistical accuracy, data logic, and analytical reasoning.
 * Identify inconsistencies, anomalies, or incorrect interpretation
 * Provide structured feedback to strengthen AI understanding of analytics.
 * Review prompts involving data cleaning, EDA, visualization, and metrics.




Requirements:

 * Strong foundation in data analysis, Excel, SQL, and visualization tools.
 * Experience with Python, Pandas, NumPy, or analytical workflows is a plus.
 * Understanding of statistics, data validation, and business intelligence.
 * Detail-oriented with strong problem-solving and reasoning skills.




Why Join Us?

 * Work on high-impact projects that contribute to building AI for Good.
 * Collaborate with top-tier engineers and domain experts from IITs, NITs, and BITS.
 * Opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, innovation-driven environment.




NOTE: This will be a flexible freelancing opportunity. Pay will vary by project and typically is up to ₹1500 per hour.

title: Analyst - Trust & Safety
description:
Ways of Working: Employees will work full time from Bangalore office.




About Swiggy

Swiggy is India’s leading on-demand delivery platform with a tech-first approach to logistics and a solution-first approach to consumer demands. With a presence in 500+ cities across India, partnerships with hundreds of thousands of restaurants, an employee base of over 5000, a 2 lakh+ strong independent fleet of Delivery Executives, we deliver unparalleled convenience driven by continuous innovation. Built on the back of robust ML technology and fuelled by terabytes of data processed every day, Swiggy offers a fast, seamless and reliable delivery experience for millions of customers across India.

From starting out as a hyperlocal food delivery service in 2014, to becoming India’s leading on-demand convenience platform today, our capabilities result not only in lightning-fast delivery for customers, but also in a productive and fulfilling experience for our employees.




Summary of Role :

This position will be a part of the Trust & safety team, where the candidate will be working closely with cross functional teams by bringing together right elements w.r.t fraud identification & remediation.




About the Team:

The Trust and Safety team is formed with an objective to reduce fraud and abuse across the systems of Swiggy. We scan processes across Restaurant, Delivery and Customer systems to identify current gaps and potential loopholes. We then work with Product, Customer Experience, Engineering and Business finance teams to develop and implement solutions, and governance mechanisms, while ensuring seamless experience to the Restaurant, Delivery Partners and Consumers.




Key responsibilities:

 * Online fraud detection such as collusion, multiple ids, bonus abuse etc. using data analytics.
 * Use analytics techniques to detect, prevent and mitigate fraud. Fraud hypothesis and identifying new patterns of abuse
 * Work on Insights and help in translating data into actionable business decisions.
 * Solutioning with Business & Product team by bringing in the right process/ system/ policy fixes in a manner that balances b/w cost & experience
 * Defining key Financial and Operational metric to enable real time detection of fraud/ abuse
 * Own daily, weekly and monthly reporting of KPIs.
 * Build strategies and suggest changes in processes which will eventually become industry benchmarks in the risk management space.
 * Analyzing behavior of new users and old users for identifying new patterns which may help in early detection of risk.
 * Explore new features, external engagements and features/variables for better Risk mitigation.




Desired Skill Sets:

 * Experience of 1-2 years in the field of Analytics (preferably risk analytics)
 * Strong analytical thought process and aptitude for creative problem solving
 * (Mandatory) Working knowledge of database tools is must; Hands on experience in one of SQL/HQL/Hive along with strong hold in MS Excel/Google sheets
 * (Optional) Working knowledge of Python, Power BI or Tableau for data visualization and KPI measurement
 * Need high level of energy and enthusiasm.




We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regards to race, color, religion, sex, disability status, or any other characteristic protected by the law.

title: Data Analyst
description:
About Us

Volante Technologies is the leading global provider of low-code cloud Payments as a Service solution for financial businesses. We are disruptors and innovators and we are growing fast. For the last three years, we have been the #1 seller of wholesale payment systems worldwide. At Volante, we are all about revolutionizing the world of Payments.




Role - RevOps Data Analyst or AM Data Analyst




We are looking for a proactive and agile professional who can manage complex data operations while also supporting day‑to‑day office administration. This hybrid role combines RevOps/AM Data Analyst responsibilities with corporate administrative support, requiring someone who is flexible, detail‑oriented, and comfortable working in a fast-paced, unstructured environment.

Key Responsibilities

 * Data Management & Integrity: Manage, clean, and merge data from multiple sources (e.g., Salesforce, Finance, Legal, Delivery) to establish and maintain a reliable “single source of truth.”
 * Process Automation: Improve and automate repetitive data collection and reporting processes to enhance operational efficiency.
 * Stakeholder Coordination: Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams, including senior leaders, to follow up on action items and ensure timely completion of deliverables.
 * AM Operational Support: Provide accurate data for internal reviews, customer meetings, and QBRs to support the Account Management function.
 * Office Administration: Oversee general office operations, ensuring smooth administrative functioning and continuity in the Hyderabad office during the transition.

What We’re Looking For

 * Background in small to mid-sized SaaS, software development, or FinTech environments.
 * Strong agility and comfort working in an evolving, fast-moving setup.
 * Hands-on experience managing messy and fragmented datasets.
 * A proactive mindset with the confidence to drive accountability across teams.
 * Willingness to handle a blend of data operations and corporate admin tasks.

✔ Competitive compensation

✔ Health benefits

✔ Remote/flexible work options

✔ Professional development support

title: Econometric Data Analyst (Remote)
description:
* Title: Econometric Data Analyst (Remote)
 * Location : Remote
 * Compensation: $20 – $100 per hour
 * Engagement Type: Independent Contractor




We are hiring for one of our clients seeking an Econometric Data Analyst with deep expertise in Stata SE to support advanced research and policy-focused analytical projects.




This role is ideal for professionals experienced in panel data analysis, causal inference, and reproducible research workflows.




Role Overview

You will design and implement econometric models using Stata SE, manage complex datasets, and produce well-documented, reproducible research outputs. The role requires strong technical rigor, analytical precision, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to academic or policy audiences.




Key Responsibilities

 * Design and implement econometric models using Stata SE
 * Conduct panel data analysis and apply causal inference techniques
 * Develop and optimize do-files for automation and reproducibility
 * Clean, transform, and validate large-scale datasets
 * Produce clear technical reports, memos, and presentation materials
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine analytical approaches
 * Ensure transparency, reproducibility, and ethical data handling standards




Required Qualifications

 * Expert proficiency in Stata SE
 * Strong experience with econometric modeling and automation via do-files
 * Advanced knowledge of panel data methods and causal inference frameworks
 * Experience handling and optimizing large datasets
 * Strong documentation and reporting skills
 * Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders
 * Self-motivated and comfortable working in a remote environment




Preferred Qualifications

 * Master’s or PhD in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or related field
 * Experience supporting academic research or policy institutions
 * Familiarity with complementary tools such as R or Python
 * Experience producing peer-reviewed or policy-grade analytical outputs




Ideal Candidate Profile

 * Methodologically rigorous and detail-oriented
 * Strong emphasis on reproducibility and clean documentation
 * Comfortable working with complex longitudinal or administrative datasets
 * Able to translate quantitative findings into practical insights




Engagement Details

 * Independent contractor engagement
 * Fully remote
 * Flexible scheduling
 * Hourly compensation based on expertise and project complexity
 * Project duration may vary depending on needs and performance




Equal Opportunity Statement

All qualified applicants will be considered without regard to legally protected characteristics. Reasonable accommodations are available upon request.




Apply Now

This role is ideal for professionals experienced in panel data analysis, causal inference, and reproducible research workflows.

You will design and implement econometric models using Stata SE, manage complex datasets, and produce well-documented, reproducible research outputs. The role requires strong technical rigor, analytical precision, and the ability to communicate findings clearly to academic or policy audiences.

  • Design and implement econometric models using Stata SE
  • Conduct panel data analysis and apply causal inference techniques
  • Develop and optimize do-files for automation and reproducibility
  • Clean, transform, and validate large-scale datasets
  • Produce clear technical reports, memos, and presentation materials
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to refine analytical approaches
  • Ensure transparency, reproducibility, and ethical data handling standards


Required Qualifications

  • Strong experience with econometric modeling and automation via do-files
  • Advanced knowledge of panel data methods and causal inference frameworks
  • Experience handling and optimizing large datasets
  • Strong documentation and reporting skills
  • Ability to communicate complex findings clearly to non-technical stakeholders

  • Master’s or PhD in Economics, Statistics, Data Science, or related field
  • Experience supporting academic research or policy institutions
  • Familiarity with complementary tools such as R or Python

title: Financial Data & BI Analyst - Gurugram (Contractual)
description:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable. 

We are seeking a detail-oriented Financial Data Analyst with strong analytical and accounting capabilities and hands-on experience in Power BI, SQL, Tableau, Financial Modelling, and Advanced Excel (including Macros). The ideal candidate will support financial planning, reporting, forecasting, and business decision-making by transforming raw data into meaningful, actionable insights.

This is a contractual role (12 months) based in Gurugram (hybrid), with the possibility of extension based on performance and business needs.

About The Role


 * Develop, maintain, and optimize dashboards and reports using Power BI, Power Query, and SQL, including data extraction, cleaning, and analysis using multiple data tools.
 * Build automated processes and dynamic reporting solutions using Advanced Excel and Macros, automating repetitive reporting tasks and supporting continuous process improvements.
 * Support financial planning activities such as forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
 * Perform data modelling to identify business trends, risks, and opportunities, and deliver insights that support strategic decision-making.
 * Collaborate closely with Finance and Business teams to understand reporting needs and deliver timely, relevant insights.
 * Provide actionable recommendations to improve revenue growth, cost efficiency, and operational performance, translating data into business impact.
 * Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all reporting systems, and present insights to stakeholders in a clear, concise, and structured format.
   
   

About You


 * Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Data Analytics, or related field.
 * 1–2 years of experience in financial data analysis or a similar analytical role.
 * Proficiency in Power BI, Tableau, and advanced SQL (must have).
 * Strong command over Advanced Excel, Power Query, and Macros.
 * Solid understanding of financial statements (must have), ratios, and forecasting concepts.
 * Ability to convert data into meaningful narratives and actionable insights.
 * Strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and analytical problem-solving skills.
 * Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and manage multiple priorities.
 * Good to have: Exposure to financial planning tools (e.g., Adaptive Insights).Understanding of statistical techniques, forecasting models, or basic programming (Python/R).
   
   

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you! 

What We Offer


 * Work closely with senior leadership and influence key financial decisions.
 * Opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
 * Collaborative, supportive culture with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement.
 * Flexible hybrid work model based out of Gurugram.
   
   

Why Join Flix?

At Flix, you’ll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.

As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you’re ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

title: Data Analyst (Marketing Analytics, Bangkok Based, Relocation provided)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

This role is based in Bangkok, Thailand, and is open to candidates worldwide. We offer a generous relocation package to ensure a smooth transition to living and working in Bangkok.

Get to Know our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this Role, you’ll get to:


 * Search: Experiment with text ads, bidding, and campaign structures on Google, Bing, Baidu, Naver, and other search engines. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.
 * Display: Test, analyze, and optimize campaigns on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and others.
 * Modeling: Analyze the vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop models we can use for optimization, and build dashboards for account managers.
   
   

What you’ll Need to Succeed:


 * 2–3 years of experience
 * Bachelor’s Degree or higher from top university in a quantitative subject (computer science, mathematics, economics, engineering, statistics or science)
 * Strong English communication
 * Solid business acumen
 * Strong statistical and analytical skills
 * Proficient in Excel and hands-on with data tools (SAS, R, SPSS, Python, VBA, SQL, Tableau)
 * Experience designing and analyzing A/B tests
 * Works independently on daily analytics tasks and provides business recommendations
   
   

It’s Great if you Have:


 * Experience in digital marketing
 * Academic research experience
