title: Lead – Advanced Analytics (Intelligence Services)
description:
Job Purpose

To spearhead the development and deployment of advanced analytics and data-driven solutions across the CBG value chaindriving process optimization, predictive insights, and innovation in production, maintenance, supply chain, and commercial operations.

Key Responsibilities

Analytics Strategy & Roadmap:


 * Define and own the advanced analytics roadmap, aligning data initiatives with CBG business objectives (yield maximization, cost reduction, quality improvement).
 * Identify high-impact use cases across feedstock selection, digester performance, purification, bottling, logistics, and sales forecasting.
   
   

Data Modelling & Solution Development


 * Lead the design, development, and validation of statistical and machine-learning models (predictive maintenance, anomaly detection, yield forecasting, optimization).
 * Oversee end-to-end analytics workflows: data ingestion/cleansing, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, and deployment.
   
   

Platform & Tool Leadership


 * Evaluate, select, and manage analytics platforms and toolchains
 * Drive the adoption of automated ML pipelines, MLOps best practices, and scalable data architectures.
   
   

Insight Delivery & Visualization


 * Collaborate with plant operations, supply chain, and commercial teams to translate analytical insights into actionable dashboards and reports (Power BI/Tableau/Grafana).
 * Present findings and recommendations to senior leadership, translating complex analyses into clear business narratives.
   
   

Team Leadership & Collaboration


 * Mentor and lead a small team of data scientists, analysts, and engineers; coordinate with IT, digital infrastructure, and manufacturing applications leads.
 * Foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and cross-functional collaboration.
   
   

Governance & Compliance


 * Establish data governance standards, model validation protocols, and documentation for reproducibility and audit readiness.
 * Ensure compliance with data security, privacy, and regulatory requirements.
   
   

Key Skills


 * B.E. / B.Tech
 * Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, ML frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch), and big-data technologies (Spark, Databricks, etc.).
 * Hands-on experience with predictive maintenance, process optimization, time-series forecasting, and anomaly detection.

title: Data Analyst II
description:
We are seeking a Task Mining Data Analyst who combines strong programming, data wrangling, and visualization skills with a deep understanding of business processes. This role involves transforming raw task mining data into meaningful insights that drive operational efficiency, automation, and AI-enabled decision-making.




In this role, You will

- work with large, complex, multi-application interaction datasets and build insightful analytics, dashboards that reveal how work actually gets done.

- be involved in building reproducible data pipelines for processing millions of events.

- create modular, well-structured scripts and reusable components for analytics.

- create high-quality visualizations and convert technical analysis into meaningful business themes




Skills

 * 3–6 years of experience in data analysis, business process analysis, task mining or process mining.
 * Strong proficiency in SQL and Python/Pandas for data transformation and analysis (Pandas, NumPy, regex, data manipulation).
 * Ability to handle large data sets and work with structured and semi-structured event data
 * Understanding of enterprise workflows, multi-application work patterns, and human-in-the-loop processes is a plus
 * Familiarity with ML techniques such as clustering, sequence alignment, pattern mining, or similar analytical methods.
 * Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical insights into clear business language.
 * Strong attention to detail and a passion for understanding how work truly gets done at scale.

title: Junior Data Analyst
description:
Job Description: Junior Data Analyst

Are you passionate about data and analytics? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced and dynamic start-up environment? If so, we are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our team! We are a data consultancy start-up with a global client base, headquartered in London UK, and we are looking for someone to join us full time on-site in our cool Office in Gurugram.

About Uptitude

Uptitude is a forward-thinking consultancy that specializes in providing exceptional data and business intelligence solutions to clients worldwide. Our team is passionate about empowering businesses with data-driven insights, enabling them to make informed decisions and achieve remarkable results. At Uptitude, we embrace a vibrant and inclusive culture, where innovation, excellence, and collaboration thrive.

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for transforming complex data sets into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations for our clients. You will work closely with our team to develop data-driven strategies and help our clients to make informed decisions. Your role will involve data cleaning, data analysis, and data visualization, as well as collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and solve business problems.

In addition to your technical skills, you should be a creative thinker, have effective communication skills, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Requirements: (1-3 years of experience)

1-3 years of experience as a Data Analyst or similar role

Strong knowledge of business intelligence tool (preferably Power BI)

Proficiency in data warehousing and data management tools (Preferably SQL)

Hands on experience on advanced excel.

Ability to work with cross-functional teams and communicate complex ideas to non- technical stakeholders.

Creative thinker and problem solver

Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Head office based in London, UK, with the role located in Gurugram, India

At Uptitude, We Embrace a Set Of Core Values That Guide Our Work And Define Our Culture. As a Data Analyst, You Should Align With These Values

Be Awesome: Strive for excellence in everything you do, continuously improving your skills and delivering exceptional results.

Step Up: Take ownership of challenges, be proactive, and seek opportunities to contribute beyond your role.

Make a Difference: Embrace innovation, think creatively, and contribute to the success of our clients and the company.

Have Fun: Foster a positive and enjoyable work environment, celebrating achievements and building strong relationships.

Benefits

Uptitude values its employees and offers a competitive benefits package, including:

Competitive Salary Commensurate With Experience And Qualifications.

Private health insurance coverage.

Offsite trips to encourage team building and knowledge sharing.

Quarterly team outings to unwind and celebrate achievements.

Corporate English Lessons with UK instructor

We are a fast-growing company with a global client base, so this is an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to grow and develop their skills in a dynamic and exciting environment. If you are passionate about data and analytics, have experience with Power BI and SQL, and want to be part of a team that is making a real impact, we want to hear from you!

description:
Job Title: Data Analyst

Location: Andheri (Mumbai)




Company Overview:

Spinnaker Analytics is a predictive analytics and artificial intelligence company headquartered in Boston, US with offices across the globe. We build prediction models and algorithms to solve high priority business problems. Working across multiple industries, we have designed and developed breakthrough analytic products and decision-making tools by leveraging predictive analytics, AI, machine learning, and deep domain expertise. Please visit www.spinnakeranalytics.com for more details.




Job Description:

We are seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Data Analyst with 2-4 years of experience to join our dynamic team. The Data Analyst will be responsible for gathering, processing, and analyzing data to provide actionable insights that support strategic business decisions. Responsibilities:

 * Opportunity to work in a collaborative and innovative environment with industry-leading technologies.
 * Exposure to real-world projects that drive business impact and enhance technical skills.

title: Customer Success Data Analyst
description:
Job Title - Remote

Job Location - Pune

Work Arrangements - Hybrid

We’re a leader in data and AI. Through our software and services, we inspire customers around the world to transform data into intelligence - and questions into answers.

If you're looking for a dynamic, fulfilling career with flexibility and a world-class employee experience, you'll find it here. We're recognized around the world for our inclusive, meaningful culture and innovative technologies by organizations like Fast Company, Forbes, Newsweek and more.

About The Job

An ideal candidate is an Analytics specialist with experience in Marketing Projects.

The SAS Customer Intelligence Customer Experience Team is looking for a Data Analyst to design and maintain analytics and reporting across Customer Experience function for SAS Customer Intelligence 360 SaaS Solution. a business insights system to support decision making in a customer adoption program.

Our team focuses on improving customer satisfaction, loyalty, and retention by helping the customers in increasing the value of their investments and driving initiatives that enhance their overall experience.

As a Data Analyst in the Customer Experience Team, you will be responsible for discovering and combining data from various sources and creating analyses to provide insights about customer status, satisfaction, solution usage and adoption. [You will also be devising data collection tools like surveys, questionnaires and building analytics to assess Customer Satisfaction and provide key insights for improvements.]

As a Data Analyst, You Will


 * Build automated digital customer health scoring models.
 * Analyze onboarding funnels, adoption rates, and behavior patterns.
 * Identify churn risks early using digital telemetry.
 * Build models predicting activation success and drop‑offs.
 * Develop self‑service dashboards and micro‑reports.
 * Work with Content Experts to transform the findings into externally sharable insights.
 * Ensure all applicable security policies and processes are followed to support the organization’s secure software development goals.
 * Embrace curiosity, passion, authenticity and accountability. These are our values and influence everything we do.
   
   

Required Qualifications


 * Bachelor’s degree in data science or computer science, or other quantitative field.
 * Minimum three years of relevant experience such as analyzing data and building analytical models.
 * Solid understanding of fundamental data concepts (table joins, data deduplication, Boolean logic, if/then logic.
 * Proficiency in Python (with libraries like Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow/PyTorch) or SAS for preparation, exploration, analysis and modeling of digital telemetry data.
 * Knowledge of SQL to query, manipulate, and manage data from databases is crucial.
 * Good experience of developing bespoke reports, dashboards for different user personas
 * Experience in using SAS for analysis and modelling
 * Experience using relational databases for data management
 * Equivalent combination of related education, training and experience may be considered in place of the above qualifications.
   
   

Additional Competencies, Knowledge And Skills


 * Ability to organize and manage multiple projects
 * Ability to relate technical concepts and data analysis to a business audience
 * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate and work with team members, and key leadership within division
 * Basic Knowledge of MarTech domain is beneficial.
   
   

You are welcome here.

At SAS, it’s not about fitting into our culture – it’s about adding to it. We believe our people make the difference. Our inclusive workforce brings together unique talents and inspires teams to create amazing software that reflects the diversity of our users and customers.

Additional Information

SAS only sends emails from verified “sas.com” email addresses and never asks for sensitive, personal information or money. If you have any doubts about the authenticity of any type of communication from, or on behalf of SAS, please contact Recruitingsupport@sas.com.

Let's stay in touch! Join our Talent Community to stay up to date on company news, job updates and more.

title: Remote Data Analyst - 60736
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L




Role Overview:

We are looking for experienced Data Analysts (MLE Bench) to contribute to benchmark-driven evaluation projects focused on real-world machine learning systems. This role involves hands-on analytical work with production-like datasets, metrics, and ML outputs to help evaluate, diagnose, and improve the performance of advanced AI systems.




The ideal candidate is comfortable working at the intersection of data analysis and machine learning, with strong analytical rigor and the ability to work with real datasets and ML evaluation workflows.




What does day-to-day life look like?

 * Analyze structured and unstructured datasets generated from ML training, inference, and evaluation pipelines.
 * Define, compute, and validate metrics used to evaluate model performance and behavior.
 * Investigate data distributions, model outputs, failure modes, and edge cases relevant to benchmark tasks.
 * Write and run Python and SQL code to analyze data, create reports, and support evaluation workflows.
 * Validate data quality, consistency, and correctness across datasets and experiments.
 * Create clear, well-documented analytical artifacts and reproducible analysis workflows.
 * Collaborate with ML engineers and researchers to design challenging, real-world evaluation scenarios for MLE Bench.




Requirements:

 * Minimum 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst or Analytics-focused Engineer.
 * Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis.
 * Solid experience with SQL and relational datasets.
 * Experience analyzing ML outputs and evaluation metrics.
 * Strong understanding of statistics and analytical reasoning.
 * Ability to work with large, complex datasets and draw reliable insights.
 * Experience writing clean, readable, and well-documented analytical code.
 * Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.




Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

 * Work in a fully remote environment.
 * Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.




Offer Details:

 * Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
 * Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
 * Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)

title: ML Data Associate I, V-CARE
description:
Description

Excited about innovative technology and how it will be used in our everyday lives? Amazon is pushing the boundaries of what's possible in smart device technology, making the future closer than ever.

Our devices use AI and machine learning to seamlessly interact with people and spaces, helping customers protect and monitor what matters most. Our products are designed to help with a range of tasks like security, monitoring, and staying connected with family. We bring together advancements in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor technology, voice and edge computing to create solutions that are helpful, reliable, and convenient.

Key job responsibilities


 * Perform annotation-related tasks across ML data processing areas including audio, image, video, and text files by following defined instructions to collect accurate ground truth data for product development
 * Execute structured, detail-oriented exercises based on evolving instructions while maintaining high quality standards using internal software tools and data capture systems
 * Apply thoughtful language skills, grammar knowledge, and linguistic awareness to ensure generated text adheres to proper grammar, syntax, and appropriate language usage
 * Understand and follow procedures, guidelines, and compliance requirements for new tasks and releases while collaborating in data collection activities using provided scripts and instructions
 * Meet daily productivity and quality targets efficiently by tracking task completion status using recommended tools and providing individual status reports
 * Maintain high internal quality of processes by performing thoughtful quality audits and verification activities
 * Capture and report results accurately, communicate issues effectively, and escalate concerns promptly through established channels
 * Raise all questions, concerns, and issues related to execution through the designated portal and resolve them according to defined SLAs, while sharing relevant information with stakeholders through effective collaboration
 * Take trustworthy ownership of daily targets and manage dependencies, both internal and external, to ensure timely completion
 * Adhere to confidentiality and compliance requirements to ensure trustworthy and responsible handling of customer data
 * Help test new SOPs and ML data tools while providing specific and timely feedback to improve existing processes and support consistent, high-quality results
 * Follow organizational processes on a daily basis while meeting established productivity and quality expectations
   
   

Job Requirement


 * Flexible for rotational schedule/work area, including weekends and/or holidays
 * Familiarity with US culture is added advantage
   
   

Basic Qualifications


 * Bachelor's degree
 * Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
 * Knowledge of advanced English language skills at CEFR level B2 (Intermediate) or C1 (Advanced)
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Master's degree or above in Computational Linguistics
 * Minimum 1+ years of experience in ML Data operations
   
   

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Data Quality Analyst
description:
Purpose of the role


 * Data and analytics is an important enabler for the UK Business’ strategy and in achieving its’ outcomes. The Data Quality Analyst is within the UK Data and Analytics function. The UK Data and Analytics function is responsible for data risk and control management, delivering the data platform strategy, delivering data and analytics products and AI for the UK Business.
 * The Data Quality Analyst is responsible for supporting the objectives of ensuring that the accuracy, consistency and integrity of data across the UK Business is sufficient to operate the bank’s services and controls.
   
   

In This Role, You Will


 * Create data quality and validation rules across all key UK Business data that address data risk through the data quality dimensions: accuracy, completeness, consistency, timeliness, uniqueness and validity
 * Manage data quality issue remediation working with various stakeholders and escalating where appropriate
 * Perform root cause analysis of systemic data quality issues
 * Conduct testing of data quality issue fixes to ensure that the root cause is remediated
 * Monitor data pipelines to highlight and resolve integration errors
 * Analyse datasets to identify errors, duplicates and inconsistencies
 * Collaborate within the data management team, contributing to a high-performing data quality function
   
   

To Be Successful You Will


 * Experience on data quality with knowledge of evolving data quality best practices
 * Understanding of data flows across banking operations, from front office to operations
 * Experience of measuring, assessing and improving data quality in a large Global organisation
 * Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills
 * Experience in working with business stakeholders and remediation teams, including data and IT architects and engineers, to address and resolve data issues
 * Proficiency with enterprise data quality and governance tools. Well versed with Excel. Familiarity with Python or BI tools, Confluence and Jira is an added advantage
 * Experience of working on a regional scale (i.e. across time zone & geography and with remote teams)

title: Manager - Data Analytics
description:
About the Role:




We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst who will work on a broad range of data analytics, data visualization and business intelligence problems across a variety of industries.




More specifically, you will:

 * Engage with clients to understand their business context
 * Understand business processes and map the complete process in visual formats.
 * Translate business problems into analytical structures and solve using statistical/ML techniques
 * Manage a team of data analysts to deliver solutions for clients.
 * Collaborate with a team of data scientists and engineers to embed AI and analytics into the business decision processes.

Desired Skills &Competencies:

 * Developing and enhancing algorithms and models to solve business problem.
 * Providing end-to-end analysis support across different industry domains and application areas.
 * Generate data cuts/outputs according to agreed specifications (for example, survey data clean up, weighting data, recoding variables, creating custom tabular views, and running cross-tabulations).
 * Conducting quantitative analyses and interpreting results
 * Proficient in visualisation tools such as Power BI, Tableau, QlikView, Spotfire (Any)
 * Proficient in MS SQL Database.
 * Python knowledge is good to have.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Storyboarding, Client Interaction is a value addition.

Education & Desired Experience:

 * 7 - 12 years of relevant Analytics experience with focus on problem solving and advanced analytics solutions
 * B.E, MBA or an Advanced degree in Mathematics/Statistics or Equivalent.

title: Senior Analyst- Product Management (Product Analytics, SQL)
description:
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.




As part of Team Amex, you'll experience this powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.




How will you make an impact in this role?

Responsible for contacting clients with overdue accounts to secure the settlement of the account. Also, they do preventive work to avoid future overdue with accounts that have a high exposure.

 * Build a comprehensive understanding of the organization’s current targeting and modeling landscape across all business segments. Identify capability gaps, future needs, and integration opportunities, and translate these into clear product and technical requirements for platform and engineering teams.
 * Shape the product and capability roadmap by working closely with Marketing, Product, Analytics, Modelling, Data Engineering, and other key partners. Drive alignment on strategic priorities, use-cases, and delivery milestones, ensuring the roadmap reflects both near-term business value and long-term capability evolution.
 * Ensure continuity and protection of existing targeting objectives and performance KPIs during capability or platform transitions. Define validation criteria, performance safeguards, and migration frameworks to maintain business impact while enabling modernization.
 * Cultivate strong cross-functional partnerships across business units, acting as a connector to bring teams together around shared goals. Facilitate decision-making, resolve ambiguity, and ensure effective execution across diverse stakeholders.
 * Provide structured, proactive updates to senior leadership, including key decisions, trade-offs, risks, and alignment needs. Represent the end-to-end capability vision and ensure leadership is informed and aligned ahead of critical milestones.




Minimum Qualifications

 * Experience in product analytics, data-driven product roles, marketing analytics, or related domains.
 * Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate business problems into actionable product solutions.
 * Advanced SQL experience working with large datasets in big data or cloud-native environments.
 * Understanding of data pipelines, models, and activation systems at a conceptual level.
 * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and contributing to backlog refinement and sprint execution.
 * Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present insights and recommendations to diverse stakeholders.
 * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.




Preferred Qualifications

 * Familiarity with handling and analyzing large datasets in data-driven environments
 * Experience with Python or other relevant analytical/programming tools in a data-driven environment.




We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

 * Competitive base salaries
 * Bonus incentives
 * Support for financial-well-being and retirement
 * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location)
 * Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need
 * Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location)
 * Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location)
 * Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
 * Career development and training opportunities




American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Data Analytics Engineer - Asst Manager
description:
Summary

Position Summary

Data Analytics Engineer – CL4

Role Overview : As a Data Analytics Engineer , you will actively engage in your engineering craft, taking a hands-on approach to multiple high-visibility projects. Your expertise will be pivotal in delivering solutions that delight customers and users, while also driving tangible value for Deloitte's business investments. You will leverage your extensive engineering craftmanship across multiple programming languages and modern frameworks, consistently demonstrating your strong track record in delivering high-quality, outcome-focused solutions. The ideal candidate will be a dependable team player, collaborating with cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy advanced software solutions.

Key Responsibilities :

Outcome-Driven Accountability: Embrace and drive a culture of accountability for customer and business outcomes. Develop engineering solutions that solve complex problems with valuable outcomes, ensuring high-quality, lean designs and implementations.

Technical Leadership and Advocacy: Serve as the technical advocate for products, ensuring code integrity, feasibility, and alignment with business and customer goals. Lead requirement analysis, component design, development, unit testing, integrations, and support.

Engineering Craftsmanship: Maintain accountability for the integrity of code design, implementation, quality, data, and ongoing maintenance and operations. Stay hands-on, self-driven, and continuously learn new approaches, languages, and frameworks. Create technical specifications, and write high-quality, supportable, scalable code ensuring all quality KPIs are met or exceeded. Demonstrate collaborative skills to work effectively with diverse teams.

Customer-Centric Engineering: Develop lean engineering solutions through rapid, inexpensive experimentation to solve customer needs. Engage with customers and product teams before, during, and after delivery to ensure the right solution is delivered at the right time.

Incremental and Iterative Delivery: Adopt a mindset that favors action and evidence over extensive planning. Utilize a learning-forward approach to navigate complexity and uncertainty, delivering lean, supportable, and maintainable solutions.

Cross-Functional Collaboration and Integration: Work collaboratively with empowered, cross-functional teams including product management, experience, and delivery. Integrate diverse perspectives to make well-informed decisions that balance feasibility, viability, usability, and value. Foster a collaborative environment that enhances team synergy and innovation.

Advanced Technical Proficiency: Possess deep expertise in modern software engineering practices and principles, including Agile methodologies and DevSecOps to deliver daily product deployments using full automation from code check-in to production with all quality checks through SDLC lifecycle. Strive to be a role model, leveraging these techniques to optimize solutioning and product delivery. Demonstrate understanding of the full lifecycle product development, focusing on continuous improvement, and learning.

Domain Expertise: Quickly acquire domain-specific knowledge relevant to the business or product. Translate business/user needs, architectures, and data designs into technical specifications and code. Be a valuable, flexible, and dedicated team member, supportive of teammates, and focused on quality and tech debt payoff.

Effective Communication and Influence: Exhibit exceptional communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts clearly and compellingly. Inspire and influence teammates and product teams through well-structured arguments and trade-offs supported by evidence. Create coherent narratives that align technical solutions with business objectives.

Engagement and Collaborative Co-Creation: Engage and collaborate with product engineering teams at all organizational levels, including customers as needed. Build and maintain constructive relationships, fostering a culture of co-creation and shared momentum towards achieving product goals. Align diverse perspectives and drive consensus to create feasible solutions.

The team : US Deloitte Technology Product Engineering has modernized software and product delivery, creating a scalable, cost-effective model that focuses on value/outcomes that leverages a progressive and responsive talent structure. As Deloitte’s primary internal development team, Product Engineering delivers innovative digital solutions to businesses, service lines, and internal operations with proven bottom-line results and outcomes. It helps power Deloitte’s success. It is the engine that drives Deloitte, serving many of the world’s largest, most respected companies. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

Key Qualifications :


 * A bachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related discipline. An advanced degree (e.g., MS) is preferred but not required. Experience is the most relevant factor.
 * Strong data engineering foundation with deep understanding of data-structure, algorithms, code instrumentations, etc.
 * 5+ years proven experience with data ETL and ELT tools (such as ADF, Databricks, Alteryx, cloud-native tools), data warehousing tools (such as SAP HANA, Snowflake, ADLS, Amazon Redshift, Google Cloud BigQuery).
 * 5+ years of experience with cloud-native engineering, using FaaS/PaaS/micro-services on cloud hyper-scalers like Azure, AWS, and GCP.
 * Strong understanding of methodologies & tools like, XP, Lean, SAFe, DevSecOps, SRE, ADO, GitHub, SonarQube, etc.

title: Remote Data Analyst - 60736
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L




Role Overview:

We are looking for experienced Data Analysts (MLE Bench) to contribute to benchmark-driven evaluation projects focused on real-world machine learning systems. This role involves hands-on analytical work with production-like datasets, metrics, and ML outputs to help evaluate, diagnose, and improve the performance of advanced AI systems.




The ideal candidate is comfortable working at the intersection of data analysis and machine learning, with strong analytical rigor and the ability to work with real datasets and ML evaluation workflows.




What does day-to-day life look like?

 * Analyze structured and unstructured datasets generated from ML training, inference, and evaluation pipelines.
 * Define, compute, and validate metrics used to evaluate model performance and behavior.
 * Investigate data distributions, model outputs, failure modes, and edge cases relevant to benchmark tasks.
 * Write and run Python and SQL code to analyze data, create reports, and support evaluation workflows.
 * Validate data quality, consistency, and correctness across datasets and experiments.
 * Create clear, well-documented analytical artifacts and reproducible analysis workflows.
 * Collaborate with ML engineers and researchers to design challenging, real-world evaluation scenarios for MLE Bench.




Requirements:

 * Minimum 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst or Analytics-focused Engineer.
 * Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis.
 * Solid experience with SQL and relational datasets.
 * Experience analyzing ML outputs and evaluation metrics.
 * Strong understanding of statistics and analytical reasoning.
 * Ability to work with large, complex datasets and draw reliable insights.
 * Experience writing clean, readable, and well-documented analytical code.
 * Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.




Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

 * Work in a fully remote environment.
 * Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.




Offer Details:

 * Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
 * Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
 * Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)

title: Advanced Specialist, Product Data Analyst
description:
Role Overview

The Product Data Analyst will use data to provide valuable insights on how to increase product adoption, user retention, engagement, and monetization. This role will be fundamental for our product development strategy. The Employee will work along with Data Engineers to collect and interpret large data sets, identify trends and develop data visualizations.

The Product Analyst will answer requests from business stakeholders but also explore on their own by performing A/B testing and investigating new opportunities to improve the user journey. They will communicate effectively with technical and non-technical people and drive critical business decisions.




Responsibilities

● Define, analyze, and communicate key performance indicators (KPIs) to enable performance measurement and drive product enhancements.

● Design and build reports, dashboards, and metrics to monitor product performance.

● Conduct trends and cohort analysis for user behavior, A/B testing to improve the user journey, and other types of analysis and experiments to identify potential areas of improvement and recommend changes based on data-driven insights.

● Provide valuable insights on how to increase product adoption rate, user retention, user engagement, and product monetization.

● Participate in product planning and strategy meetings, providing data-driven insights to guide decision making.

● Translate complex quantitative analysis and data into easily understandable results for all levels of the company.

● Work closely with data engineers to clean, refine, and analyze large datasets. Offer clear specifications for the Analytics team to collect and interpret large datasets, identify trends and develop data visualizations.

● Ensure data quality by collaborating with data engineers and implementing data validation practices.

● Stay current on industry trends and latest analytics technologies to continue improving data quality and insights.

● Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and UX designers to influence product design and user experience based on insights.

● Champion a data-driven culture within the organization, advocating for the importance of data in decision-making processes.







Qualifications & Skills

● Degree (or equivalent) in Informatics, Economics, Computer Science, or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

● Minimum 5 years of experience with data analysis, working with BI tools

● Strong knowledge of SQL and good knowledge of other tools for data analysis, like Excel, Python, PowerBI, and similar

● Proficiency with analyzing feature and usage metrics, A/B testing, conversion and retention, segmentation, and developing user archetypes and their usage patterns.

● Excellent attention to details and analytical skills

● Previous success with uncovering data insights to form hypotheses, designing product experiments, evaluating results, and making recommendations

● Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, including the ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders;

● Ability to work in a fast-paced environment and handle multiple priorities;

● Ability to work in a team and communicate effectively with colleagues;

title: ML Data Associate I, V-CARE
description:
Description

Excited about innovative technology and how it will be used in our everyday lives? Amazon is pushing the boundaries of what's possible in smart device technology, making the future closer than ever.

Our devices use AI and machine learning to seamlessly interact with people and spaces, helping customers protect and monitor what matters most. Our products are designed to help with a range of tasks like security, monitoring, and staying connected with family. We bring together advancements in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor technology, voice and edge computing to create solutions that are helpful, reliable, and convenient.

Key job responsibilities


 * Perform annotation-related tasks across ML data processing areas including audio, image, video, and text files by following defined instructions to collect accurate ground truth data for product development
 * Execute structured, detail-oriented exercises based on evolving instructions while maintaining high quality standards using internal software tools and data capture systems
 * Apply thoughtful language skills, grammar knowledge, and linguistic awareness to ensure generated text adheres to proper grammar, syntax, and appropriate language usage
 * Understand and follow procedures, guidelines, and compliance requirements for new tasks and releases while collaborating in data collection activities using provided scripts and instructions
 * Meet daily productivity and quality targets efficiently by tracking task completion status using recommended tools and providing individual status reports
 * Maintain high internal quality of processes by performing thoughtful quality audits and verification activities
 * Capture and report results accurately, communicate issues effectively, and escalate concerns promptly through established channels
 * Raise all questions, concerns, and issues related to execution through the designated portal and resolve them according to defined SLAs, while sharing relevant information with stakeholders through effective collaboration
 * Take trustworthy ownership of daily targets and manage dependencies, both internal and external, to ensure timely completion
 * Adhere to confidentiality and compliance requirements to ensure trustworthy and responsible handling of customer data
 * Help test new SOPs and ML data tools while providing specific and timely feedback to improve existing processes and support consistent, high-quality results
 * Follow organizational processes on a daily basis while meeting established productivity and quality expectations
   
   

Job Requirement


 * Flexible for rotational schedule/work area, including weekends and/or holidays
 * Familiarity with US culture is added advantage
   
   

Basic Qualifications


 * Bachelor's degree
 * Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
 * Knowledge of advanced English language skills at CEFR level B2 (Intermediate) or C1 (Advanced)
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Master's degree or above in Computational Linguistics
 * Minimum 1+ years of experience in ML Data operations
   
   

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. title: Remote Data Analyst - 60736
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L




Role Overview:

We are looking for experienced Data Analysts (MLE Bench) to contribute to benchmark-driven evaluation projects focused on real-world machine learning systems. This role involves hands-on analytical work with production-like datasets, metrics, and ML outputs to help evaluate, diagnose, and improve the performance of advanced AI systems.




The ideal candidate is comfortable working at the intersection of data analysis and machine learning, with strong analytical rigor and the ability to work with real datasets and ML evaluation workflows.




What does day-to-day life look like?

 * Analyze structured and unstructured datasets generated from ML training, inference, and evaluation pipelines.
 * Define, compute, and validate metrics used to evaluate model performance and behavior.
 * Investigate data distributions, model outputs, failure modes, and edge cases relevant to benchmark tasks.
 * Write and run Python and SQL code to analyze data, create reports, and support evaluation workflows.
 * Validate data quality, consistency, and correctness across datasets and experiments.
 * Create clear, well-documented analytical artifacts and reproducible analysis workflows.
 * Collaborate with ML engineers and researchers to design challenging, real-world evaluation scenarios for MLE Bench.




Requirements:

 * Minimum 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst or Analytics-focused Engineer.
 * Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis.
 * Solid experience with SQL and relational datasets.
 * Experience analyzing ML outputs and evaluation metrics.
 * Strong understanding of statistics and analytical reasoning.
 * Ability to work with large, complex datasets and draw reliable insights.
 * Experience writing clean, readable, and well-documented analytical code.
 * Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.




Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

 * Work in a fully remote environment.
 * Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.




Offer Details:

 * Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
 * Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
 * Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)

title: Data Analyst Intern
description:
Job Description: Data Analyst Intern

Are you passionate about data and analytics? Do you enjoy working in a fast-paced and dynamic start-up environment? If so, we are looking for a talented Data Analyst to join our team! We are a data consultancy start-up with a global client base, headquartered in London UK, and we are looking for someone to join us full time on-site in our cool Office in Gurugram.

About Uptitude

Uptitude is a forward-thinking consultancy that specializes in providing exceptional data and business intelligence solutions to clients worldwide. Our team is passionate about empowering businesses with data-driven insights, enabling them to make informed decisions and achieve remarkable results. At Uptitude, we embrace a vibrant and inclusive culture, where innovation, excellence, and collaboration thrive.

As a Data Analyst, you will be responsible for transforming complex data sets into meaningful insights and actionable recommendations for our clients. You will work closely with our team to develop data-driven strategies and help our clients to make informed decisions. Your role will involve data cleaning, data analysis, and data visualization, as well as collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify and solve business problems.

In addition to your technical skills, you should be a creative thinker, have effective communication skills, and be comfortable working in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Requirements: (0-1 year of experience)

Graduated in Computer Science or related field.

0-1 year of experience as a Data Analyst or similar role

Basic knowledge of business intelligence tool (preferably Power BI)

Basic awareness of data management tools (Preferably SQL).

Hands on experience on advanced excel.

Strong attention to detail and ability to work in a fast-paced environment.

Head office based in London, UK, with the role located in Gurugram, India

Company Values

At Uptitude, we embrace a set of core values that guide our work and define our culture. As a Data Analyst, you should align with these values:

Be Awesome: Strive for excellence in everything you do, continuously improving your skills and delivering exceptional results.

Step Up: Take ownership of challenges, be proactive, and seek opportunities to contribute beyond your role.

Make a Difference: Embrace innovation, think creatively, and contribute to the success of our clients and the company.

Have Fun: Foster a positive and enjoyable work environment, celebrating achievements and building strong relationships.

Benefits

Uptitude values its employees and offers a competitive benefits package, including:

Competitive Salary Commensurate With Experience And Qualifications.

Private health insurance coverage.

Offsite trips to encourage team building and knowledge sharing.

Quarterly team outings to unwind and celebrate achievements.

Corporate English Lessons with UK instructor

We are a fast-growing company with a global client base, so this is an excellent opportunity for the right candidate to grow and develop their skills in a dynamic and exciting environment. If you are passionate about data and analytics, have experience with Power BI and SQL, and want to be part of a team that is making a real impact, we want to hear from you!

Job Title: Project & Change Analyst

The Projects and Processes team is a global function which will be responsible for driving transformation, continuous improvement, risk remediation and talent and knowledge management across RTM.
 * You will work with Management across Corporate Bank and partners to address top priorities by driving collaborative thinking and strategic change. Together with the project teams, you will lead and execute high impact initiatives, in partnership with stakeholders globally.
   
   
   

What We’ll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy


 * Best in class leave policy
 * Gender neutral parental leaves
 * 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
 * Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 * Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 * Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
 * Accident and Term life Insurance
 * Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
   
   
   

Your Key Responsibilities


 * Support key global initiatives for the Corporate Bank RTM team by assisting with analysis, reporting, and coordination activities.

 * Contribute to research and preparation of best practices to support the ongoing development of the RTM function.
 * Work with teams across RTM, CB Products, Technology, and Operations to help track and deliver priority tasks.
 * Build effective working relationships across teams, seeking guidance where needed and supporting knowledge‑sharing with junior team members.
   
   
   

Your Skills And Experience


 * Strong command of Excel, MIS reporting, and analytical techniques, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
 * Advanced PowerPoint and business presentation skills, capable of creating clear, impactful executive-level decks.
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills, enabling effective interaction with stakeholders across levels.
 * Keeps client needs in mind while supporting day‑to‑day tasks and deliverables.
 * Demonstrates a logical approach to problem‑solving with the ability to learn quickly and adapt.
 * Motivated, reliable, and able to work in a structured manner even under time pressure.
 * Pays strong attention to detail, helping identify issues and support basic troubleshooting.
 * Builds positive working relationships and collaborates effectively within global or virtual team environments.

title: Remote Data Analyst - 60736
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L




Role Overview:

We are looking for experienced Data Analysts (MLE Bench) to contribute to benchmark-driven evaluation projects focused on real-world machine learning systems. This role involves hands-on analytical work with production-like datasets, metrics, and ML outputs to help evaluate, diagnose, and improve the performance of advanced AI systems.




The ideal candidate is comfortable working at the intersection of data analysis and machine learning, with strong analytical rigor and the ability to work with real datasets and ML evaluation workflows.




What does day-to-day life look like?

 * Analyze structured and unstructured datasets generated from ML training, inference, and evaluation pipelines.
 * Define, compute, and validate metrics used to evaluate model performance and behavior.
 * Investigate data distributions, model outputs, failure modes, and edge cases relevant to benchmark tasks.
 * Write and run Python and SQL code to analyze data, create reports, and support evaluation workflows.
 * Validate data quality, consistency, and correctness across datasets and experiments.
 * Create clear, well-documented analytical artifacts and reproducible analysis workflows.
 * Collaborate with ML engineers and researchers to design challenging, real-world evaluation scenarios for MLE Bench.




Requirements:

 * Minimum 3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst or Analytics-focused Engineer.
 * Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis.
 * Solid experience with SQL and relational datasets.
 * Experience analyzing ML outputs and evaluation metrics.
 * Strong understanding of statistics and analytical reasoning.
 * Ability to work with large, complex datasets and draw reliable insights.
 * Experience writing clean, readable, and well-documented analytical code.
 * Excellent spoken and written English communication skills.




Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

 * Work in a fully remote environment.
 * Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.




Offer Details:

 * Commitments Required: At least 4 hours per day and minimum 20 hours per week with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
 * Engagement Type: Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
 * Duration of Contract: 3 months (adjustable based on engagement)




Know amazing talent? Refer them at turing.com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Senior Business Intelligence Analyst (Business & Product)
description:
Experience: 6–10 Years

Location: Noida / Bangalore

Joining: Immediate / Short Notice Preferred




About the Role




We are looking for a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst who can independently drive insights that influence business performance and product decisions. This role requires strong analytical depth, a clear business mindset, and the ability to understand customer behavior across the product lifecycle.




You will work closely with Product, Business, Growth, and Leadership teams to convert data into actionable intelligence, going beyond dashboards to answer why things are happening and what should be done next.




Key Responsibilities




 * Own and drive business and product insights across acquisition, engagement, retention, and monetization.
 * Partner with Product and Business teams to define, track, and evolve key metrics and north-star KPIs.
 * Perform deep-dive analyses on customer behavior, funnels, cohorts, and feature usage to identify growth and efficiency levers.
 * Build and maintain dashboards, MIS, and self-serve reports that serve as a reliable source of truth.
 * Support experimentation and A/B testing by defining success metrics and analyzing outcomes.
 * Proactively surface risks, anomalies, and opportunities using data-backed narratives.
 * Collaborate with Data Engineering and Product teams to improve data quality, tracking, and analytical readiness.
 * Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable insights for non-technical stakeholders.




Required Skills & Experience

 * 6–10 years of experience in Business Intelligence / Analytics, preferably in product-led or consumer internet / fintech organizations.
 * Strong hands-on experience with SQL (mandatory); ability to work with large and complex datasets.
 * Experience with BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar.
 * Solid understanding of product metrics, funnels, cohorts, and lifecycle analytics.
 * Proven ability to independently structure ambiguous problems and deliver end-to-end insights.
 * Strong communication skills and comfort working with senior stakeholders.




Good to Have

 * Experience with event-based data (Mixpanel, Amplitude, GA).
 * Working knowledge of Python / R for advanced analysis.
 * Exposure to A/B testing and experimentation frameworks.
 * Domain exposure to Wealth and Trading or FinTech, Payments, Investments, Consumer Platforms.




What We’re Looking For

 * Strong IC mindset with high ownership and accountability.
 * Business-first thinking with a strong product understanding.
 * Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
 * Focus on impact, not just reporting.




Why Join Us

 * High-impact role influencing both business outcomes and product direction.
 * Opportunity to work with rich customer and behavioral data at scale.
 * Direct exposure to leadership and strategic decision-making.
 * Data-driven culture with scope to shape how insights are used

title: Data Analyst (Technical)
description:
Your role

Are you curious about how financial instruments, benchmarks and indices are used within the Asset Management lifecycle? Are you organized and have an eye for detail? Are you motivated by analytical challenges? We’re looking for someone who can:


 * Support daily and periodic index calculations, validation and distribution tasks including benchmark setup, maintenance, reconciliation, and deactivation within agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs) throughout its lifecycle.
 * Respond to internal requests to clarify, verify, reconcile, and control security, index, benchmark, and performance data ensuring completeness, accuracy, and timeliness.
 * Control, analyze, calculate, and maintain systems/databases to ensure the accuracy and integrity of static and time series data across applications.
 * Follow, document, and review standard operating procedures, to ensure its fit for purpose.
 * Conduct comprehensive business analysis and define requirements for data management processes and system workflows.
 * Engage in User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and oversee Production releases, collaborating with data vendors, operations teams, and stakeholders to resolve data issues and ensure adherence to (SLAs).
   
   

Job Type

Full Time

Job Reference #

331538BR

City

Pune

Your team

You will be working in the Data Services team within Asset Management Chief Data Office aligned to traditional operations. You will be supporting the day-to-day processes carried out by the Data Services team, which would include providing timely, accurate and complete benchmark, index, and analytics data to the UBS Asset Management Division – in line with defined requirements.

Team provides 24*6 coverage to ensure uninterrupted support and assistance to the Asset Management Division. Team members are in Chicago, Zurich, Krakow, Singapore, and Pune

Your expertise


 * A university degree, ideally in – Business Mgmt. / Finance / Information Technology
 * Solid knowledge of benchmarks, indices and asset classes, financial instruments.
 * Solid experience with reconciliation, root cause analysis, complex troubleshooting and document findings.
 * Proficiency in data manipulation, analysis tools (Excel/VBA/Macro, SQL) and ETL tool (Alteryx).
 * Strong communication skills (English) both verbal and written. Able to explain technical and non-technical topics to stakeholders.
 * Working knowledge of leading market data platforms (e.g., Rime, Bloomberg, ICE, Refinitiv).
 * Basic knowledge of scripting (Python, Shell) to aid in automation.
 * Nice to have - experience with tools such as: PowerBI, SimCorp Dimension Platform, Power Automate and other Power Apps.
 * Nice to have - familiarity with index licensing, vendor management.
   
   

intellectually curious, accountable, and data-driven


 * a self-starter with the ability to work with minimal supervision as part of a team.
 * an individual who possesses a positive, action-oriented attitude and initiative taker
 * able to challenge the status quo and suggest viable and actionable alternative approaches.
   
   

About Us
UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Disclaimer / Policy statements

UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

title: Python Engineer (Data/ML)
description:
Company Description

Gleantap is an intelligent customer experience platform designed for fitness and wellness clubs, enabling businesses to harness data to run effective sales and marketing campaigns. By integrating contextual data, AI, and automation, Gleantap streamlines communication between brands and their customers. The platform drives enhanced lead conversion rates and improves customer retention. Gleantap is at the forefront of helping businesses deliver personalized experiences and achieve growth through innovative technology solutions.




Role Description

This is a full-time remote role for a Python Engineer (Data/ML) at Gleantap. The role involves developing and maintaining backend systems, implementing features for handling and analyzing data, and contributing to the integration of machine learning models into the platform. The Python Engineer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to design scalable solutions and improve system performance. The position requires a proactive approach to identifying and solving technical challenges.




Requirements

 * 3–5+ years of experience in data engineering or applied ML.
 * Strong proficiency in Python, SQL, and one or more ML libraries (scikit-learn, LightGBM, XGBoost, PyTorch).
 * Experience with data pipelines (Airflow, dbt, or custom ETL).
 * Comfortable with event-driven systems (Kafka, Redis, ClickHouse or similar OLAP).
 * Understanding of ML lifecycle: training, serving, monitoring, retraining.
 * Ability to design time-based labels (avoiding data leakage).
 * Strong problem-solving skills and eagerness to work in a startup environment.




Nice-to-Haves

 * MLOps tools (MLflow, BentoML, Ray Serve).
 * Experience with bandit algorithms, A/B testing, or uplift modeling.
 * Prior work with customer engagement, CRM, or subscription businesses.

title: BI Analyst
description:
Convoso is a leading AI-powered contact center platform purpose-built for revenue teams. Since 2006, Convoso has remained at the forefront of innovation, consistently developing solutions to drive customer growth while supporting adherence to regulatory standards.

Who We Are:

While headquartered in Los Angeles, the Convoso team can be found around the globe working in either a hybrid or remote capacity. Awarded as a "best place to work" company, our culture fosters team integrity, positive persistence, and continuous growth.

Our core platform powers successful sales teams across multiple industries, giving our customers a competitive edge and streamlined productivity. With built-in Al and automations, our product is a premium offering in a competitive space. We continue to grow our product capabilities to better serve our current customers and to expand into newer markets.

Convoso is looking for people who are excited about technology and innovation. We are a company of motivated team players with diverse backgrounds driving accelerated growth in a supportive, positive culture.

The Job:

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Business Intelligence Analyst with strong Alteryx expertise to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a critical part in transforming data into actionable insights that drive business decisions and optimize organizational performance. Your proficiency in Alteryx workflow development, data analysis, and visualization will be central to delivering impactful reporting and insights.

What You'll Be Doing:


 * Collect, organize, and analyze large volumes of structured and unstructured data from multiple sources using Alteryx and other BI tools.
 * Identify trends, patterns, and opportunities to support informed decision-making.
 * Develop and maintain reports and interactive dashboards using Alteryx, Tableau, Power BI, and Excel.
 * Ensure that complex data is presented clearly and effectively to stakeholders.
 * Track key performance indicators (KPIs) and business metrics to measure impact and identify areas for improvement.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define targets, establish benchmarks, and create performance reports using Alteryx workflows.
 * Ensure accuracy, consistency, and integrity of data through Alteryx-based ETL processes, validation, and cleansing.
 * Identify and resolve discrepancies in large datasets to maintain high-quality outputs.
 * Partner with cross-functional teams to understand requirements and translate data into actionable insights.
 * Leverage Alteryx automation and workflow optimization to streamline reporting and analysis.
   
   
   

Who You Are:


 * Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, or a related field.
 * 3-4 years of experience as a BI Analyst or in a similar analytical role, with a strong focus on Alteryx workflow development, data analysis, and visualization.
 * Hands-on experience with Alteryx is required; experience with Tableau, Power BI, SQL, and Snowflake is a plus.
 * Detail-oriented with excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; able to work with complex datasets and derive meaningful insights.
 * Strong communication skills to convey complex information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
 * Advanced Excel skills (including formulas, pivot tables, and data manipulation).
 * Proven ability to manage multiple projects and priorities in a fast-paced environment.
 * US company experience preferred.
 * Highly organized with strong follow-through and a sense of urgency; understands the impact of maintaining clean, accurate data workflows.
 * Able to collaborate effectively, while also driving timelines and projects independently.
   
   
   

Work Perks Worth the Hype:


 * 100% covered premiums for employees + dependents (spouse + up to four children)
 * PTO, Paid Sick Time, Holidays
 * Your birthday off
 * Monthly credits toward food & beverage
 * Employee referral bonus
 * And a team of highly experienced and kind colleagues!

title: Reference Data Analyst, NCT
description:
Position Overview

Job Title: Reference Data Analyst, NCT

Location: Bangalore, India

Role Description


 * The project involves verification of the Client data, performing due diligence checks on the Clients, reviewing KYC documentation performing the risk assessment of the Client, liaising with the Business/Compliance, advising on KYC requirements and signing off on new client adoptions.
 * The Reg & Tax analyst role is an operations function where you will be involved in reviewing various regulatory documents related to clients to ensure that all the regulatory requirements are met and the bank is in compliance.
   
   
   

What We’ll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy


 * Best in class leave policy
 * Gender neutral parental leaves
 * 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
 * Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 * Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 * Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
 * Accident and Term life Insurance
 * Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
   
   
   

Your Key Responsibilities


 * Responsible for verification of Client data
 * Perform due diligence of new and existing clients covering a wide range of different client types including; Listed and Regulated, small/medium/ large private and public companies as well as more complex structures such as; SPVs, Co-operatives, Foundations and Funds,
 * Governments, Joint Ventures, etc.
 * Verifying KYC documentation of the Clients to be adopted/reviewed
 * Perform the risk assessment of the Client to be adopted/reviewed
 * Signing off on new client adoptions and periodic reviews
 * Manage New Client Adoption or Periodic Review stream, to ensure that all requests are approved in accordance with regulatory requirements and the bank’s internal policie
 * Manage exception ensuring that all SLA’s defined with the Business on timeliness and quality are adhered
   
   
   

Your Skills And Experience


 * 6+ years of relevant work experience (AML/KYC/compliance related) within corporate financial services industry, Research/Analytics role in other Banks / KPOs etc
 * Understanding of Control, Compliance, Investigation/chasing functions in banks
 * Familiarity AML/KYC regulations and industry guidelines (FSA, JMLSG, 3rd EU Money Laundering Directive, MiFID)
 * Ability to interpret regulatory guidelines and assessing risk scores and entity types
 * Ability to interpreting alerts
 * Ability to identifying trends and inconsistencies
 * Understanding of end to end KYC process
   
   
   

How We’ll Support You


 * Training and development to help you excel in your career.
 * Coaching and support from experts in your team.
 * A culture of continuous learning to aid progression.
 * A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs.
   
   
   

About Us And Our Teams

Please visit our company website for further information:

https://www.db.com/company/company.html

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
About the Role:

We’re hiring a Senior Business Intelligence Analyst who prioritizes hands‑on Power BI development and stakeholder management. Technically, you’ll architect and optimize semantic models, author advanced DAX/M, and implement performance best practices (e.g., aggregations, composite models) to deliver governed, high‑performing dashboards that accelerate decision-making. You’ll lead requirements workshops, translate business needs into clear data stories, and drive adoption across teams.




Key Responsibilities

 1. Power BI Development & Modeling

 * Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards, reports, and semantic models to support business needs.
 * Implement best practices for data modeling, DAX calculations, and query performance optimization.

 1. Stakeholder Engagement

 * Communicate complex analytical concepts in a clear and concise manner to non-technical audiences.
 * Partner with business teams to ensure BI solutions align with strategic objectives.

 1. Data Analytics & Storytelling

 * Translate business questions into effective data stories and actionable insights.
 * Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver high-quality BI solutions.

 1. Performance & Troubleshooting

 * Diagnose and resolve issues related to DAX, M queries, and data refresh performance.
 * Continuously improve existing Power BI solutions for scalability and efficiency.




Must-Have Qualifications:

 * 4+ years of experience in Power BI development with advanced features and functionalities.
 * 4+ years in Data Analytics, including data modeling and visualization.
 * Demonstrated expertise in building, maintaining, and improving Power BI semantic models.
 * Strong knowledge of DAX, M, relational database modeling, and query optimization.
 * Good communication and stakeholder management skills.
 * Proven ability to translate business requirements into data-driven solutions.
 * Excellent problem-solving skills and DAX troubleshooting experience.




Nice-to-Have:

 * Experience with Snowflake, SQL, and Salesforce.
 * A portfolio of Power BI dashboards personally developed (PBIX, .JPEG, or .PNG formats acceptable).

title: Data Analyst
description:
Job Description

🎯 Atlys' mission is to enable every person on earth to travel freely.

At Atlys, we believe that the path to creating a more open world is by making it efficient to travel. Travelers cite visas as the most frustrating pain point, and we're starting by automating that completely. We're looking for talented people who are interested in building the future of travel alongside us.

Building technology to increase global movement liquidity will be one of the most exciting developments in decades. If you are curious why the smartest people want to work at Atlys, read this post.

Atlys is a product-led, data-enabled company that leverages data at every critical juncture to make informed decisions. Our commitment to data-driven insights spans across all functions and levels within the organization. We are seeking a talented Data Analyst to elevate our data infrastructure and capabilities.

Job requirements

Why hire a Data Analyst?


 * Atlys is a product-led but data-enabled company.
 * We’ve used data at every inflexion point to make better decisions, and the data requirements comes from across the board.
 * Data Analytics has been at the core of our problem solving which has helped us grow 200x in the last 2 years and improve our customer experience drastically.
 * However, as our business expands horizontally, we want someone to take over the data side of things from the PoV of helping us solve for visibility around the vertical of business, marketing and finance.
 * The requirement for a Data Analyst, is to take the above to the next level by:
    * Own all business data decisions, you become the single source of truth in helping the company grow.
    * Solve for marketing analytics by owning the entire channel of attribution, ads performance and brand campaigns efficacy.
      

Experience Requirements


 * 1-3 Years of Experience as a Data Analyst.
   
   

Technical Skills


 * You need to be an SQL nerd, nothing should be impossible if it is in a structured table.
 * Good experience with any visualisation tool is required (Power BI, Tableau, Looker Studio, Metabase, or any other tool). You should be able to differentiate between a good vs a bad dashboard.
   
   

Non Technical Skills


 * You need to be money minded, if you’ve worked on business problem statements in the past (like pricing, discounting frameworks, etc), it is a plus.
 * You should have strong analytical thinking, a solid understanding of operations and fulfillment processes, and the ability to translate data into actionable insights that improve efficiency, accuracy, and performance.
   
   

Good To Have Skills


 * Brownie points if you know Python and understand how the generally flow of any tech system works.
   
   

Why join Atlys?


 * Competitive Salary.
 * Relocation Expenses.
 * Chance to join an exciting team that grew 200x in the last 24 months and immense potential of growth.
 * Additional Benefits (link below):
   
   

Perks @Atlys

Important Pointers to be noted


 * This is a fully in office role, based out of Delhi.
 * Ideal joining period should be before 10th March, 2026
   
   

Hiring Process


 * Resume Shortlist
 * Analytical Round of Interview with the Senior Data Analyst
 * Take Home Task with a 72 hours deadline (will be emailed to you)
 * Behavioural Round of Interview with one of the internal stakeholders
 * Technical Round of Interview with the Head of Data
