title: 1985306-Lead Assistant Manager
description: EXL Decision Analytics EXL (NASDAQ:EXLS) is a leading operations management and analytics company that helps businesses enhance growth and profitability in the face of relentless competition and continuous disruption. Using our proprietary, award-winning Business EXLerator Framework™, which integrates analytics, automation, benchmarking, BPO, consulting, industry best practices and technology platforms, we look deeper to help companies improve global operations, enhance data-driven insights, increase customer satisfaction, and manage risk and compliance. EXL serves the insurance, healthcare, banking and financial services, utilities, travel, transportation, and logistics industries. Headquartered in New York, New York, EXL has more than 51,000 professionals in locations throughout the United States, Europe, Asia (primarily India and Philippines), Latin America, Australia, and South Africa. EXL Analytics provides data-driven, action-oriented solutions to business problems through statistical data mining, cutting edge analytics techniques and a consultative approach. Leveraging proprietary methodology and best-of-breed technology, EXL Analytics takes an industry-specific approach to transform our clients’ decision making and embed analytics more deeply into their business processes. Our global footprint of nearly 2,000 data scientists and analysts assist client organizations with complex risk minimization methods, advanced marketing, pricing and CRM strategies, internal cost analysis, and cost and resource optimization within the organization. EXL Analytics serves the insurance, healthcare, banking, capital markets, utilities, retail and e-commerce, travel, transportation, and logistics industries. Please visit www.exlservice.com for more information about EXL Analytics. Roles and Responsibilities for Data Governance Create and update a comprehensive business glossary that defines key terms, data elements, and their usage to ensure consistent understanding across the organization. Partner with stakeholders to create, implement, and enforce data governance policies and standards, resolve data conflicts, and ensure cross-functional alignment on data practices. Regularly evaluate data quality metrics, ensure compliance with policies, and work with data stewards and custodians to address and resolve data issues. Oversee data quality within specific domains, enforce governance standards, and act as a primary contact for data-related queries within those areas. Establish and maintain technical controls for data, manage access permissions, and ensure secure data storage and ongoing data maintenance. Candidate Profile: Experienced Business analyst with diverse experience using a variety of tools (3-8 years). Expertise in designing and implementing robust data governance frameworks, policies, and standards. Proficient in ensuring data accuracy, managing data lineage, and maintaining regulatory compliance across data assets. Hands-on experience with leading data management tools (e.g., Collibra, Informatica) and a solid understanding of data infrastructure. Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams to align on data governance initiatives and drive adherence to data policies. Strong skills in identifying data quality issues, implementing effective solutions, and driving continuous improvement in data management practices. Knowledge on asset management data types (e.g., portfolio data, market data, client data) and their specific governance requirements. Good to have knowledge on SQL and Snowflake What we offer: EXL Analytics offers an exciting, fast paced, and innovative environment, which brings together a group of sharp and entrepreneurial professionals who are eager to influence business decisions. From your very first day, you get an opportunity to work closely with highly experienced, world-class analytics consultants. You can expect to learn several aspects of businesses that our clients engage in. You will also learn effective teamwork and time-management skills - key aspects for personal and professional growth. Analytics requires different skill sets at various levels within the organization. At EXL Analytics, we invest heavily in training you in all aspects of analytics as well as in leading analytical tools and techniques. We provide guidance/ coaching to every employee through our mentoring program wherein every junior level employee is assigned a senior level professional as advisors. Sky is the limit for our team members. The unique experiences gathered at EXL Analytics set the stage for further growth and development in our company and beyond. "EOE/Minorities/Females/Vets/Disabilities"

title: Senior Analyst - Data Science
description:
At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.


As part of Team Amex, you'll experience this powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.


The Analytics, Investments and Marketing Enablement (AIM) team—within Global Commercial Services Marketing (GCSM)—is the analytics engine powering Commercial customer acquisition, engagement, and retention. AIM develops insights, data products, and analytical solutions that shape smarter marketing and powerful digital experiences. 


This Senior Analyst role sits within Corporate Digital Acquisition Analytics, supporting the strategy, development, and optimization of personalized digital experiences for Commercial corporate prospects across Digital channels using data, advanced analytics, and emerging AI. 


How will you make an impact in this role?


As a Senior Analyst, you will lead analytical work that fuels the next generation of AMEX’s Corporate digital acquisition engine. You will design and implement data-driven strategies, build analytical solutions to optimize targeting, personalization, and prospect conversion. 


This role is ideal for someone who is passionate about digital marketing analytics, enthusiastic about emerging AI and GenAI capabilities, and eager to help shape how AMEX engages Commercial Corporate prospects in a dynamic and competitive digital landscape. 


Key Responsibilities: 


 * Develop analytical solutions and data products that improve targeting accuracy, personalization, and digital acquisition performance across the AMEX website. 
   

 * Build and enhance targeting models leveraging AMEX’s vast first-party data and evolving digital intelligence capabilities. 
   

 * Apply emerging AI and GenAI techniques, such as intelligent customer journey optimization, semantic modeling and automated insights to enhance targeting precision and analytical productivity. 
   

 * Drive experimentation, performance measurement and Investment optimization - designing test structures, evaluating results, and making actionable recommendations to improve conversion and efficiency. 
   

 * Develop & foster cross functional relationships with partners across American Express to ensure implementation of analytical solutions and ensure business impact. 
   
   
   


Minimum Qualifications


 * Master’s Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Engineering, Mathematics, Finance, Computer Science, Statistics, Economics). 
   
 * 1-2 years of professional work experience in Data Science and Analytics domain
   
 * Experience working with LLMs and in building ML models like XGBoost, K-Means, etc with proficiency in analytical tools such as SQL, Python, or similar; knowledge of digital analytics or experimentation frameworks is a plus. 
   
 * Strong analytical/conceptual thinking acumen to solve unstructured and complex business problems 
   
 * Excellent written and oral communication skills 
   
   


Preferred Qualifications


 * Hands-on GenAI experience with background in Prompt Engineering, RAG architectures to solve business problems 
   
 * Experience in digital marketing analytics, personalization, website optimization, or acquisition strategy. 
   
 * Familiarity and interest in applying emerging AI and Gen AI capabilities to improve digital targeting outcomes. 
   
 * Experience in large data processing and handling; and basic understanding of data science: XGBoost, decision trees, regression modeling, etc. 
   
 * Strong communication skills with the ability to influence partners and drive action. 



 



We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:
 * Competitive base salaries 
 * Bonus incentives 
 * Support for financial-well-being and retirement 
 * Comprehensive medical, dental, vision, life insurance, and disability benefits (depending on location) 
 * Flexible working model with hybrid, onsite or virtual arrangements depending on role and business need 
 * Generous paid parental leave policies (depending on your location) 
 * Free access to global on-site wellness centers staffed with nurses and doctors (depending on location) 
 * Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program 
 * Career development and training opportunities
   

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.  

Offer of employment with American Express is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background verification check, subject to applicable laws and regulations.

title: Healthcare Research & Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Healthcare Research and data analyst to join our LifeScience and Healthcare Products business group in Noida. This is an amazing opportunity to be a member of a talented and vibrant Biopharma Insights team. The team consists of about 100 colleagues. We have a great skill set in market research and assessment, analysis and insights and we would love to speak with you if you have skills in pharmaceutical market research.

About You: Experience, education, skills, and accomplishments


 * Masters or higher degree (PhD, MBA) and/or at least 2 years of experience in the biopharma, healthcare, or market research.
 * Ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and objectively in written and spoken English.
 * Ability to manage competing priorities and meet project deadlines.
 * Excellent presentation skills.
 * Ability to build relationships with co-workers and clients.
 * Experience with PowerPoint and Excel.
   
   

It would be great if you also had the following


 * Experience in working with complex data sets.
 * Familiarity with clinical research, drug development, and/or commercialization processes.
 * Experience in modeling and forecasting pharmaceutical markets.
 * Experience with key information resources (e.g., clinical trial and pipeline databases, sales/consumption data, physician audit databases).
 * Experience with real-world data (e.g., claims, EHR)
   
   

What will you be doing in this role?

The role comprises three broad functions: 1) market research and insight generation; 2) project management and execution; and 3) client service. The Analyst will translate subject matter expertise and market research data into targeted insights for key decision-makers within the biopharmaceutical industry. Areas of coverage will span the team’s diverse and intellectually stimulating research portfolio in oncology, immunology, endocrinology, nephrology, and other therapeutic areas.


 * Build and apply an understanding of biosimilar drug development and commercialization, including the dynamics in different therapy areas.
 * Critically analyze primary market research data and commercial information from several sources to evaluate market trends, assess opportunity, and build market forecasts.
 * Effectively and concisely communicate business insights through multiple formats (e.g., slide decks, live presentations).
 * Manage the execution of multiple projects with minimal supervision.
 * Conduct primary research via interviews and surveys with medical and healthcare experts.
 * Field client queries and ad hoc requests with minimal supervision.
 * Develop and maintain partnerships with clients; understand their needs and deliver solutions.
 * Show a strong grasp of complex commercial issues in communication with clients and internal stakeholders.
   
   

About The Team

Analysts in Understand business provide pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, financial services, and managed care companies with the analytics they need to compete and thrive in an increasingly competitive marketplace. Each year, these companies turn to us for their strategic planning, market development, technology management, and competitive intelligence requirements. Biopharma team of Understand Business is a team of business insights analysts who design, research, author, and present market research studies on different indications to help pharmaceutical companies make decisions about the development of new drugs and management of marketed products.

Hours of Work

40 hours in a week as an FTE (Monday - Friday)

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

title: Business Intelligence Associate
description:
Who We Are




The next step of your career starts here, where you can bring your own unique mix of skills and perspectives to a fast-growing team.




Metyis is a global and forward-thinking firm operating across a wide range of industries, developing and delivering AI & Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing & Design solutions and Advisory services. At Metyis, our long-term partnership model brings long-lasting impact and growth to our business partners and clients through extensive execution capabilities.

With our team, you can experience a collaborative environment with highly skilled multidisciplinary experts, where everyone has room to build bigger and bolder ideas. Being part of Metyis means you can speak your mind and be creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you can achieve with a team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.




We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.




What We Offer




 * Interact with C-level at our clients on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change
 * Lead your team in creating new business solutions
 * Seize opportunities at the client and at Metyis in our entrepreneurial environment
 * Become part of a fast growing international and diverse team




What You Will Do




 * Take a leading role in building our center of excellence by delivering dashboarding and visualization requirements to various clients
 * Delivery of reports and dashboards in a timely and efficient manner
 * Liaise with the onsite team and client teams in scoping the requirements and convert to a suitable visualization (that is developed over multiple, agile sprints)
 * Be the single point of contact for all complex query resolution
 * Provide inputs for improving dashboard performance and suggest efficient data transformations for creating dashboards
 * Inculcate best practices
 * Oversee the maintenance of the dashboards that have already been built
 * Guide and mentor team members




What You Will Bring




 * 3 – 6 years of professional work experience in Data Visualization and KPI dashboarding
 * Deep expertise in Power BI. Good to have knowledge of Tableau.
 * Experience in Google Data Studio is desirable
 * Proficient in writing Complex SQL queries & Optimising Queries
 * Good problem-solving skills and an analytical mindset
 * Ability to assess the performance of data pipelines for latency and query run times
 * Ability to work in the English language with strong written and oral communication skills




Metyis, we are driven by curiosity and collaboration. We value diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging (DEIB) in all its forms as it makes us stronger as an organisation and promotes creativity and innovation. We welcome all talents and are committed to creating a workplace where every employee can make a meaningful impact and grow

title: CRM Analytics Manager
description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Team

eBay’s CRM & Loyalty Analytics team transforms customer data into decisions that enhance long-term value. We collaborate across Marketing, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to compose, measure, and enhance CRM programs for buyers, sellers, and central initiatives worldwide.

Role overview

As Analytics Manager, you will own the strategy and execution of data-driven CRM measurement and optimization. You’ll combine rigorous experimentation with machine-learning and AI to personalize experiences, improve engagement and retention, and increase customer lifetime value (CLV). The portfolio may focus on Buyer, Seller, or a cross-company initiative.

What you’ll do


 * Achieve tangible results. Establish benchmarks and learning goals; develop structures that link campaign performance to business results, CLV, retention.

 * Lead experimentation at scale. Build and run A/B and multivariate tests; apply sound statistical methods (power analysis, capping, sequential testing, causal inference) to produce trustworthy results.
 * Develop robust analytics. Use SQL/Python for data modeling and reproducible pipelines; compose self-serve datasets and dashboards to accelerate decision-making.
 * Optimize channel strategy. Evaluate email, push, in-app, onsite, and lifecycle programs; recommend frequency, targeting, and creative strategies grounded in data.
 * Tell the story. Translate complex analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for senior collaborators; influence roadmaps and CRM evolution.
 * Improve the craft. Guide analysts, advocate for guidelines in documentation, code review, and experimentation hygiene; promote an inclusive, growth-focused culture.
 * Safeguard data use. Partner with Legal/Privacy to ensure compliance (e.g., GDPR), guardrails, and responsible AI practices.
   
   
   

Qualifications


 * Hands-on CRM analytics experience delivering impact in a consumer or marketplace context.
 * Machine-learning & AI experience applied to CRM/personalization (e.g., propensity, churn, LTV/CLV modeling, recommendation/next-best action, uplift).
 * Experimentation & statistics expertise, including test building, sample sizing, variance reduction, and causal inference.
 * SQL and Python proficiency for data wrangling, modeling, and automation; familiarity with data warehouses and version control.
 * Dashboarding & data visualization skills (Tableau preferred) to build clear, credible self-serve insights.
 * Business sense proven through translating insights into strategies that yield measurable outcomes.
 * Communication & collaborator leadership across Marketing, Product, and Engineering; ability to influence at executive level.
   
   
   

Nice to have


 * Experience with marketing tech stacks (contact strategy decisioning/orchestration, unified data platforms, experimentation platforms) and event-level data.
 * Familiarity with Spark/Databricks, Airflow, or similar for scalable pipelines.
 * Knowledge of generative AI applications for CRM content/testing and guardrail development.
 * Marketplace or two-sided platform experience.
   
   
   

How you’ll succeed here

You balance scientific rigor with speed, automate the repeatable, and obsess over long-term customer value. You’re comfortable shipping MVPs, learning fast, and setting a higher standard for ethical, privacy-aware analytics.

title: Product Analyst Intern
description:
Company Description

Material Depot is a design-centered home materials platform revolutionizing the way India builds homes by simplifying the discovery, visualization, and sourcing of materials. With over 1 Lac+ designer materials and more than 1 million combinations, we offer curated, globally inspired collections combined with a responsive supply chain to provide better choices, transparent pricing, and reliable deliveries. Founded in 2022 and headquartered in Bengaluru, we are trusted by over 10,000+ homes and supported by leading investors, including Accel and Stellaris Venture Partners. Material Depot aims to create a more transparent and design-led future for home interiors in India.




Role Description

We’re looking for a growth-focused, highly analytical operator who can deeply understand customer journeys and improve conversion across our key funnels. You’ll own funnel measurement, experimentation, and insight generation across web and marketing channels - turning data into clear actions that move metrics.




Stipend : 20-30K/Month




What You'll do

 * Own funnel and journey analysis across acquisition → activation → conversion → retention.
 * Build and maintain dashboards/analysis using tools like Mixpanel, MoEngage, GA (or equivalent).
 * Run A/B tests end-to-end: hypothesis → setup → monitoring → analysis → rollout recommendations.
 * Identify what’s working vs. what’s not (drop-offs, friction points, message gaps) and propose fixes.
 * Perform deeper analysis using SQL and spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets) to answer business questions quickly.
 * Work with cross-functional teams (product, design, marketing, ops) to implement improvements and measure impact.
 * Understand and evaluate attribution across channels (paid, organic, referrals, WhatsApp, offline/store, etc.).
 * Use AI tools to accelerate planning, insight generation, creative iteration, and contextual problem-solving.




What We're looking for

 * Strong understanding of funnels, customer journeys, conversion drivers, and behavioral analytics.
 * Hands-on experience with Mixpanel and MoEngage (or similar event + lifecycle tools).
 * Solid experimentation mindset (A/B testing fundamentals, statistical thinking, clean interpretations).
 * Strong SQL and spreadsheet skills (must-have).
 * Ability to break down ambiguous problems, form hypotheses, and go deep until the “why” is clear.
 * Bonus: design familiarity (Figma/Canva) to communicate ideas clearly and collaborate better with design.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Title: Sr. Data Engineer (Azure)

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

Job Type: Full Time

Experience: 4+ years

Department: Data Engineering




About Simform:

Simform is a premier digital engineering company specializing in Cloud, Data, AI/ML, and Experience Engineering to create seamless digital experiences and scalable products. Simform is a strong partner for Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Databricks. With a presence in 5+ countries, Simform primarily serves North America, the UK, and the Northern European market. Simform takes pride in being one of the most reputed employers in the region, having created a thriving work culture with a high work-life balance that gives a sense of freedom and opportunity to grow.




Key Responsibilities:

 * Design, develop, and maintain scalable end-to-end data pipelines on AWS or Azure.
 * Build robust ETL/ELT workflows for both batch and streaming data workloads.
 * Design high-performance data models and manage large-scale structured and unstructured datasets (100GB+).
 * Develop distributed data processing solutions using Apache Kafka, Spark, Flink, and Airflow.
 * Implement best practices for data transformation, data quality, and error handling.
 * Optimize SQL queries, implement indexing, partitioning, and tuning strategies for performance improvement.
 * Integrate various data sources including PostgreSQL, SQL Server, MySQL, MongoDB, Cassandra, and Neptune.
 * Collaborate with software developers, ML engineers, and stakeholders to support business and analytics initiatives.
 * Ensure adherence to data governance, security, and compliance standards.
 * Participate in client meetings, provide technical guidance, and document architecture decisions.




Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):

 * Exposure to data lake architecture and lakehouse frameworks.
 * Understanding of integrating data pipelines with ML workflows.
 * Experience in CI/CD automation for data pipeline deployments.
 * Familiarity with data observability and monitoring tools.




Why Join Us:

 * Young Team, Thriving Culture
 * Flat-hierarchical, friendly, engineering-oriented, and growth-focused culture.
 * Well-balanced learning and growth opportunities
 * Free health insurance.
 * Office facilities with a game zone, in-office kitchen with affordable lunch service, and free snacks.
 * Sponsorship for certifications/events and library service.
 * Flexible work timing, leaves for life events, WFH and hybrid options.

title: SOC Analyst
description:
Wrike is the most powerful work management platform. Built for teams and organizations looking to collaborate, create, and exceed every day, Wrike brings everyone and all work into a single place to remove complexity, increase productivity, and free people up to focus on their most purposeful work.

Our vision: A world where everyone is free to focus on their most purposeful work, together.

Ready to become a Wriker?

Wrike is looking for a security operations center (SOC) analyst. This team protects Wrike’s valuable assets and data against cyber threats and attacks 24/7.

More about your team:

As a SOC Analyst, you will collaborate with a multidisciplinary security team comprising Infrastructure Security Engineers, Security Engineers, Application Security Engineers, and Compliance specialists. You’ll find yourself among a group of passionate and approachable professionals, dedicated to continuous improvement and teamwork in keeping our organization secure.

Key Responsibilities:



 * Monitor, analyze and triage security alerts and events
 * Assess risk, impact of potential incidents, and take appropriate remediation steps and actions
 * Employ various security tools and technologies to detect and investigate cyber threats
 * Work collaboratively with other teams, including incident responders, to ensure proper escalation and resolution of cases
 * Document and report security incidents
 * Participate in further development and improvement of security monitoring and detection capabilities
 * Stay up to date with the latest security trends, vulnerabilities, and best practices.
   
   
   

You will achieve your best if you have:



 * Over 5 years of experience in a Security Operation Centre (SOC) or similar role
 * Knowledge of network fundamentals and common security threats
 * Well-developed logical thinking capabilities and problem-solving skills
 * Strong communication skills, both written and verbal
   
   
   

You will stand out with:



 * Experience with security information event management (SIEM) and extended detection and response (e.g. Rapid7, Splunk, Wazuh, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, Crowdstrike)
 * Industry certificates is an advantage
 * Experience with log analysis and correlation
   
   
   

Perks of working with Wrike



 * 10 days of National and Festival Holidays per year (eight fixed, two flexible)
 * 18 days of paid vacation per year
 * 14 days of sick leave with a medical certificate per year
 * 5 uncertified sick days per year
 * Group Medical Plan: Coverage for employees, spouse, children, and parents/in-laws for Rs 5,00,000. Free health checkup for employees
 * Personal Accident Insurance: Rs 50,00,000
 * Term Life Insurance: Rs 50,00,000
 * Up to 26 weeks of paid maternity leave for the first two children
 * 4 weeks of paid parental leave
 * 2 days off for volunteering with nonprofit charities
 * Broadband/Internet Reimbursement: INR 1500 per month
 * Full-stocked pantry and complimentary lunch
 * Hybrid work model
   
   
   

Your recruitment buddy will be Tripti Sachan , Senior Recruiter

Who Is Wrike And Our Culture

We’re a team of innovators and creators who solve the complex work problems of today and tomorrow.

Hybrid work mode

Wrike promotes a hybrid model for team members near our office hubs in San Diego, Prague, Dublin, Nicosia, and Tallinn, with 2–3 in-office days per week to foster collaboration and teamwork. This work mode supports our culture of collaboration and solving problems fast to deliver business outcomes and win together.

Our persona

💡 Smart: We love what we do, and we’re great at it because this is our domain. Our combined knowledge in this space is unmatched.

💚 Dedicated: We get up every day focused on helping our customers win. We’re committed to helping our teammates win, too!

🤗 Approachable: We're friendly, easy to get along with, considerate, and helpful.

Our culture and Values

🤩 Customer-Focused

We care about our customers. We understand the customer journey, experience, and value derived from Wrike. Decision-making and action-taking are done with the customer in mind.

🤝 Collaborative

We work as one and win together, each bringing unique strengths that contribute to diversity of thought for better outcomes. Leveraging our own work management platform, we foster an environment of creative collaboration and shared achievement.

🎨 Creative

We strive to succeed through continuous innovation. It’s our pursuit of novel concepts that helped us create a market category. We continue to cultivate a workplace that fosters creative thinking as a means of transcending conventional boundaries and empowers us to break new ground to deliver extraordinary work management solutions.

💪 Committed

We believe in ownership at all levels of the organization, by owning workflows from start to finish. Each member of our team is an integral part of this commitment, establishing work as a platform for personal growth and transformation, as well as collective success and growth.

Check out our LinkedIn Life Page, Company culture page, Instagram, Wrike Engineering Team, Medium, Meetup.com, Youtube for a feel for what life is like at Wrike.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Senior Data Analyst



What will you create and do?


We are looking for a highly analytical and business-driven Senior Data Analyst to transform customer conversation data, transactional data, and product usage data into actionable insights that drive revenue and customer success outcomes.


In this individual contributor role, you will partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams to improve funnel performance, customer engagement, retention, and product adoption. You will play a key role in shaping how Conversive (SMS Magic) uses data to drive decision-making across the organization.


You will work on customer engagement data (SMS, WhatsApp, and conversational channels) along with transactional and product usage datasets to uncover patterns, optimize conversions, and identify growth opportunities.


The ideal candidate is hands-on with data, strong in analytics and business understanding, and capable of translating complex datasets into clear, actionable business recommendations.





Key Responsibilities:



 * Analyse customer conversation data (SMS, WhatsApp, chat interactions) to uncover engagement patterns and trends.
   

 * Work with transactional and product usage data to identify drop-offs, growth opportunities, and user behaviour insights.
   

 * Build and maintain business dashboards and reports for leadership and cross-functional teams
   

 * Develop and manage MQL → SQL → Revenue funnel reporting and analytics
   

 * Track campaign performance, product adoption, and customer engagement metrics
   

 * Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Product teams to understand business challenges and translate them into data models and analytical frameworks.
   

 * Provide data-driven recommendations to improve conversion rates, retention, and revenue growth.
   

 * Work with large-scale datasets and ensure data accuracy, consistency, and governance
   

 * Identify data gaps, tracking issues, and opportunities to improve data infrastructure.
   

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):

Developer Role Description – Data Engineer (Mid-Level)

We are seeking a motivated mid-level data engineer to build and maintain the data pipelines, transformation logic, and reporting datasets that power analytics platform.  * Python expertise for advanced data processing and automation workflows.
 * Exposure to Microsoft Fabric or Azure Synapse Analytics.
 * Experience with dbt for transformation layer development.
 * Understanding of financial data structures or prior experience in a financial services environment.

description:
Overview

Come discover why Tricon has been certified as a Great Place to Work®! The award is based entirely on what current employees say about their experience working at Tricon. Great Place to Work® is the global authority on workplace culture, employee experience, and the leadership behaviors proven to deliver market-leading revenue, employee retention, and increased innovation.

About us: Tricon is an industry leader in the global commodity trade and distribution market. In our 27+ years in business, we have grown to become one of the largest privately held companies in Houston, TX and recognized as the 2nd largest chemical distributor in the world. Our diverse team spans 25+ offices worldwide, adding value by providing logistic, risk management, financing, and market intelligence services. We strive to enhance international commerce through the physical movement and marketing of industrial petrochemicals, polymers, fuels, and raw materials. By providing our suppliers and customers with streamlined services, they are able to focus on their core business.

Job Title: Master Data Analyst

Department: JDE

Reporting to: Director of IT Applications

Location: Mumbai, India

Roles & Responsibilities


 * Review, validate, and correct master data records (customers, vendors, products, pricing, materials, etc.)
 * Identify and resolve data quality issues such as duplicates, missing values, incorrect codes, and inconsistent formatting
 * Perform data cleansing and standardization to match company naming conventions and data governance rules
 * Use Excel to analyze, reconcile, and manage large datasets efficiently
 * Prepare data correction templates and update files for uploads into ERP/CRM systems
 * Work with internal teams (sales, operations, finance, supply chain) to verify data accuracy
 * Maintain logs and documentation for changes made to master data
 * Create basic dashboards/reports to monitor data quality trends and correction progress
 * Ensure timely completion of data correction tasks with high accuracy
   
   

Critical Skills


 * Advanced Excel functions: VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, IF, COUNTIF, SUMIF, TEXT, LEFT/RIGHT/MID
 * Data tools: Pivot Tables, Filters, Conditional Formatting, Data Validation
 * Data cleaning: Remove duplicates, text-to-columns, proper formatting, standard templates
 * Strong ability to work with large data volumes and multiple sheets/workbooks
   
   

Additional Skills


 * Strong leadership skills and the ability to multitask within a fast-paced and dynamic workplace.
 * Exposure to and understanding of consulting services.
 * Proven skills in working with different departments, data assimilation, cleansing and coordinating with Teams
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Excellent English communication and presentation skills.
 * Able to work and thrive in a team environment.
 * Ability to bring innovative solutions to process challenges.
   
   

Assets


 * Familiar with data governance or data standards
 * Knowledge of Power Query / Power BI (optional)
 * Experience in managing projects and training initiatives.
   
   

Minimum Requirement


 * Bachelor’s degree preferred (Business, Data, Supply Chain, Finance, or similar)
 * Experience in master data management or data correction preferred
 * Strong accuracy, attention to detail, and communication skills
 * Ability to meet deadlines and handle repetitive tasks efficiently
   
   

Summary


 * Core responsibilities: The Master Data Analyst is tasked with reviewing, validating, and correcting master data records including customers, vendors, products, and pricing. The role involves resolving data quality issues, performing data cleansing to meet company standards, preparing data for ERP/CRM uploads, collaborating with various internal teams, maintaining documentation, and generating reports to monitor data quality trends. Timely and accurate completion of data correction tasks is emphasized.
 * Required skills: Advanced proficiency in Excel functions such as VLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, and data tools like Pivot Tables and Conditional Formatting is essential. The candidate should be adept at handling large datasets and multiple workbooks. Additional skills include leadership, multitasking, cross-department collaboration, analytical problem-solving, and strong English communication. Exposure to consulting services and innovation in process improvement are also valued.
 * Qualifications and assets: A bachelor’s degree in business, data, supply chain, finance, or related fields is preferred, along with experience in master data management. Accuracy, attention to detail, and meeting deadlines are critical. Familiarity with data governance, Power Query/Power BI, and project management, or training experience, is considered an asset. The company, Tricon Energy, is a global commodities trading firm focused on petrochemicals and plastics, emphasizing rapid growth and facilitating global commerce.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Eloelo:

Eloelo is India’s fastest-growing live entertainment and social gaming platform — blending the energy of live streaming with interactive games and communities. With over 50M+ users and 100K+ creators, we’re redefining how people connect, play, and create online.




Role Overview:

We’re looking for a passionate Data Engineer who can design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines and infrastructure. You’ll play a key role in enabling analytics, business insights, and decision-making across Product, Growth, and Creator teams.




Key Responsibilities:

 * Design, develop, and manage ETL pipelines to collect, process, and transform large-scale data.
 * Work closely with Data Analysts, Data Scientists, and Product teams to ensure data accuracy and accessibility.
 * Implement and optimize data storage solutions (e.g., Redshift, BigQuery, Snowflake).
 * Ensure high data quality, reliability, and performance in all pipelines.
 * Automate workflows, monitor data systems, and troubleshoot issues proactively.
 * Support migration, scaling, and integration of new data sources.




Requirements:

 * 2–5 years of experience as a Data Engineer or similar role.
 * Strong skills in SQL, Python, and data pipeline orchestration tools (Airflow, dbt, etc.).
 * Experience with cloud data platforms (AWS, GCP).
 * Hands-on experience with data warehousing and real-time data streaming (Kafka, Spark preferred).
 * Solid understanding of data modelling and schema design.
 * Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD workflows is a plus.




Bonus Points:

 * Experience in a consumer-tech, gaming, or social media platform.
 * Understanding of analytics and experimentation frameworks.




Why Join Eloelo:

 * Be part of a fast-paced, creator-first platform reshaping India’s live entertainment ecosystem.
 * Work with a talented, collaborative team using cutting-edge tech.
 * Great culture, flexible environment, and opportunities for growth.

description:
At eBay, we're more than a global ecommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells. Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets around the world. We’re committed to pushing boundaries and leaving our mark as we reinvent the future of ecommerce for enthusiasts.

Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day. We're in this together, sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

About EBay

At eBay, we’re more than a global eCommerce leader — we’re changing the way the world shops and sells.

Our platform empowers millions of buyers and sellers in more than 190 markets worldwide.

We’re committed to pushing boundaries and shaping the future of eCommerce for enthusiasts. Our customers are our compass, authenticity thrives, bold ideas are welcome, and everyone can bring their unique selves to work — every day.

We’re in this together — sustaining the future of our customers, our company, and our planet.

Join a team of passionate thinkers, innovators, and dreamers — and help us connect people and build communities to create economic opportunity for all.

About The Role

The Focus Category team partners closely with product and business stakeholders to enable data-driven decision-making and drive the success of eBay’s category initiatives.

We are a dynamic, results-oriented team working on high-impact projects in collaboration with global partners. We are seeking a high-energy, analytical, and collaborative team member with strong problem-solving abilities, sound business judgment, and deep analytical expertise.

The ideal candidate will apply advanced analytics and data science techniques to:


 * Drive innovation,
 * Build scalable data products, and
 * Deliver actionable recommendations through rigorous analysis.
   
   
   

Key Responsibilities


 * Apply strong analytical and statistical skills to solve complex and unstructured business problems with structured, data-supported solutions.
 * Drive product decisions using A/B testing techniques and experimental design.
 * Lead innovation and continuous improvement within the Focus Category Analytics team.
 * Develop data products that enable faster and more accurate decision-making.
 * Leverage advanced analytics tools and data science models to solve category-level challenges.
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams — including Business, Product Management, Engineering, and Finance — to identify, prioritize, and resolve key business challenges.
 * Serve as a trusted partner and advisor to senior leaders, translating complex analytical insights into actionable business recommendations.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Senior Data Analyst

at Traya Health




Location: Mumbai

Experience: 3-5 years




About Us

Traya is an Indian direct-to-consumer hair care platform that provides a holistic treatment for individuals experiencing hair loss. Through personalized consultations, we identify the root cause of hair fall using a combination of Ayurveda, Allopathy, and Nutrition. Our unique diagnostic platform, combined with medically trained hair coaches and proprietary tech, ensures customers receive customized solutions delivered right to their doorstep — and the ongoing guidance they need to stay on track. Founded by Saloni Anand (techie-turned-marketeer) and Altaf Saiyed (Stanford GSB alumnus), Traya’s mission is to de-stigmatize hair loss, address its emotional and psychological impact, and make effective treatment accessible to all.




Our Vision

We aim to create a global awareness movement around hair loss while delivering a scientifically proven, holistic solution that combines the best of three sciences.




About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Data Analyst who can independently drive end-to-end analytics from problem understanding to insights, reporting, and recommendations. This role is focused on strong analytical thinking, business impact, and clear storytelling through data. We are also looking for someone who has hands-on exposure to AI tools and can use them to improve reporting, automation, and insight generation.




What You’ll Be Doing

Advanced Analytics & Insights

• Lead deep-dive analysis across user behavior, funnels, retention, cohorts, revenue, and performance metrics.

• Translate business problems into structured analysis with clear recommendations.

• Identify trends, gaps, and growth opportunities that directly impact business outcomes.

• Design and analyze A/B tests to measure impact of product and marketing initiatives.




Reporting & Visualization

• Build and maintain dashboards for leadership and business teams.

• Create automated reporting frameworks to track key metrics.

• Develop clear and insightful visualizations that simplify complex data.

• Ensure accuracy, consistency, and reliability of reporting outputs.

• Present insights in a concise and structured manner to stakeholders.




Applied AI (Hands-on Exposure)

• Use AI/LLM tools to automate reporting, generate summaries, classify data, or enable faster analysis.

• Contribute to AI-enabled analytics initiatives such as conversational querying or automated insight generation.

• Partner with engineering teams for implementation where required.




What We’re Looking For

• 3–5 years of experience in Data Analytics .

• Strong SQL skills .

• Strong Python skills for data analysis and automation.

• Solid understanding of statistics and experimentation.

• Hands-on experience with BI and visualization tools (Metabase, Looker, etc.).

• Strong ability to communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.

• Hands-on experience applying AI tools to solve real business problems.




Good to Have

• Experience working with product, healthcare or marketing teams.

• Basic understanding of ML concepts.










Traya provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, nation origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by central, state, or local laws.

title: ML Data Associate I, V-CARE
description:
Description

Excited about innovative technology and how it will be used in our everyday lives? Amazon is pushing the boundaries of what's possible in smart device technology, making the future closer than ever.

Our devices use AI and machine learning to seamlessly interact with people and spaces, helping customers protect and monitor what matters most. Our products are designed to help with a range of tasks like security, monitoring, and staying connected with family. We bring together advancements in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor technology, voice and edge computing to create solutions that are helpful, reliable, and convenient.

Key job responsibilities


 * Perform annotation-related tasks across ML data processing areas including audio, image, video, and text files by following defined instructions to collect accurate ground truth data for product development
 * Execute structured, detail-oriented exercises based on evolving instructions while maintaining high quality standards using internal software tools and data capture systems
 * Apply thoughtful language skills, grammar knowledge, and linguistic awareness to ensure generated text adheres to proper grammar, syntax, and appropriate language usage
 * Understand and follow procedures, guidelines, and compliance requirements for new tasks and releases while collaborating in data collection activities using provided scripts and instructions
 * Meet daily productivity and quality targets efficiently by tracking task completion status using recommended tools and providing individual status reports
 * Maintain high internal quality of processes by performing thoughtful quality audits and verification activities
 * Capture and report results accurately, communicate issues effectively, and escalate concerns promptly through established channels
 * Raise all questions, concerns, and issues related to execution through the designated portal and resolve them according to defined SLAs, while sharing relevant information with stakeholders through effective collaboration
 * Take trustworthy ownership of daily targets and manage dependencies, both internal and external, to ensure timely completion
 * Adhere to confidentiality and compliance requirements to ensure trustworthy and responsible handling of customer data
 * Help test new SOPs and ML data tools while providing specific and timely feedback to improve existing processes and support consistent, high-quality results
 * Follow organizational processes on a daily basis while meeting established productivity and quality expectations
   
   

Job Requirement


 * Flexible for rotational schedule/work area, including weekends and/or holidays
 * Familiarity with US culture is added advantage
   
   

Basic Qualifications


 * Bachelor's degree
 * Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
 * Knowledge of advanced English language skills at CEFR level B2 (Intermediate) or C1 (Advanced)
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Master's degree or above in Computational Linguistics
 * Minimum 1+ years of experience in ML Data operations

title: Statistical Analyst (Remote)
description:
* Title: Statistical Analyst (Remote)
 * Engagement: Hourly contract (independent contractor)
 * Rate: USD 62-120/hour




Job Summary

We are seeking a highly analytical Statistical Consultant to contribute expertise in statistical methodology, data validation, and AI model training. In this fully remote contract role, you will apply advanced quantitative techniques to support the development and refinement of AI-driven systems. Your work will ensure data integrity, methodological rigor, and ethical best practices across diverse analytical initiatives.




Key Responsibilities

 * Analyze and interpret complex datasets to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and relationships
 * Evaluate and refine statistical methodologies to ensure validity, reliability, and efficiency
 * Prepare, clean, and validate data for AI model training and advanced analytical applications
 * Develop clear, compelling reports and visualizations, including charts, graphs, and data narratives
 * Recommend appropriate statistical techniques aligned with research objectives and AI performance goals
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate analytical insights into actionable AI improvements
 * Conduct data quality assurance checks, including weighting, normalization, and anomaly detection
 * Ensure compliance with data privacy standards and ethical AI principles




Required Skills and Qualifications

 * Demonstrated expertise in statistical analysis, data interpretation, and methodology evaluation
 * Advanced proficiency in statistical software and programming languages such as R, Python, SAS, and SPSS
 * Strong experience in data cleaning, validation, and quality assurance processes
 * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex findings clearly
 * Experience supporting AI model training or data-driven technology initiatives
 * Analytical mindset with high attention to detail and accuracy
 * Ability to work independently in a remote, collaborative environment




Preferred Qualifications

 * Advanced degree (Master’s or PhD) in Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field
 * Prior experience in AI model development, evaluation, or machine learning workflows
 * Knowledge of data privacy frameworks and ethical AI best practices




APPLY NOW!

About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

 * Search: Experiment with text ads, bidding, and campaign structures on Google, Bing, Baidu, Naver, and other search engines. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.
 * Display: Test, analyze, and optimize campaigns on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and others.
 * Modeling: Analyze the vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop models we can use for optimization, and build dashboards for account managers.

 * Familiar with A/B testing concepts
 * Works under close supervision and supports projects with guidance

title: Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

About the position:

Utilizes software engineering principles to deploy and maintain fully automated data transformation pipelines that combine a large variety of storage and computation technologies to handle a distribution of data types and volumes in support of data architecture design. A Senior Data Engineer designs and oversees the entire data infrastructure, data products and data pipelines that are resilient to change, modular, flexible, scalable, reusable, and cost effective. The expectation for this role is 5-10 years of relevant experience.

Key Responsibilities


 * Oversee the entire data infrastructure to ensure scalability, operation efficiency and resiliency.
 * Mentor junior data engineers within the organization.
 * Design, develop, and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes using Microsoft Azure services (e.g., Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, Azure Fabric).
 * Utilize Azure data storage accounts for organizing and maintaining data pipeline outputs. (e.g., Azure Data Lake Storage Gen 2 & Azure Blob storage).
 * Collaborate with data scientists, data analysts, data architects and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver high-quality data solutions.
 * Optimize data pipelines in the Azure environment for performance, scalability, and reliability.
 * Ensure data quality and integrity through data validation techniques and frameworks.
 * Develop and maintain documentation for data processes, configurations, and best practices.
 * Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline issues to ensure timely resolution.
 * Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies to ensure our data solutions remain cutting-edge.
 * Manage the CI/CD process for deploying and maintaining data solutions.
   
   

Required Qualifications


 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) and able to demonstrate high proficiency in programming fundamentals.
 * At least 5 years of proven experience as a Data Engineer or similar role dealing with data and ETL processes. 5 - 10 years of experience
 * Strong knowledge of Microsoft Azure services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, Azure Blob Storage and Azure Data Lake Gen 2.
 * Experience utilizing SQL DML to query modern RDBMS in an efficient manner (e.g., SQL Server, PostgreSQL).
 * Strong understanding of Software Engineering principles and how they apply to Data Engineering (e.g., CI/CD, version control, testing).
 * Experience with big data technologies (e.g., Spark).
 * Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.
 * Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Learning agility
 * Technical Leadership
 * Consulting and managing business needs
 * Strong experience in Python is preferred but experience in other languages such as Scala, Java, C#, etc is accepted.
 * Experience building spark applications utilizing PySpark.
 * Experience with file formats such as Parquet, Delta, Avro.
 * Experience efficiently querying API endpoints as a data source.
 * Understanding of the Azure environment and related services such as subscriptions, resource groups, etc.
 * Understanding of Git workflows in software development.
 * Using Azure DevOps pipeline and repositories to deploy and maintain solutions.
 * Understanding of Ansible and how to use it in Azure DevOps pipelines.
   
   

Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, supporting business requirements across the world. Accordingly, the work hours for employees will be aligned to support business requirements. The standard work week will be Monday to Friday. Working hours are 8:00am to 5:00pm or 1.30pm to 10.30pm.

title: Data Analyst Intern
description:
Data Analyst Intern




Company: Inficore Soft

Location: Remote

Internship Type: Full-Time

Duration: 1–3 Months

Stipend: ₹15,000 per month




⸻




About the Internship




Inficore Soft is seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst Intern who is passionate about working with data and transforming it into actionable insights. This internship provides hands-on experience with real-world datasets and exposure to practical analytics workflows in a remote working environment.




⸻




Key Responsibilities

• Analyze and interpret data to identify trends, patterns, and insights

• Clean, validate, and organize datasets from multiple sources

• Create reports, dashboards, and visualizations for internal use

• Assist in maintaining data accuracy and documentation

• Support ongoing data-driven projects and ad-hoc analysis

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand data requirements




⸻




Eligibility Criteria

• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field

• Basic knowledge of data analysis concepts

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets

• Familiarity with SQL and Python is an advantage

• Understanding of data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau is a plus

• Strong analytical thinking and communication skills

• Ability to work independently in a remote environment




⸻




What We Offer

• Practical experience with live data projects

• Mentorship from experienced professionals

• Exposure to industry-standard analytics tools

• Internship Certificate upon successful completion

• Potential opportunity for future employment based on performance

title: Sr. Data Analyst
description:
Req ID: GAQ126R127

The Sr. Data Analyst (Tableau) is key in technological decision-making for business teams’ future data, analysis, and reporting needs. The role supports the business’s daily operations, including troubleshooting the data intelligence warehouse environment and monitoring jobs. It is also the role of the analyst to guide the business in identifying new data needs and to deliver mechanisms for acquiring and reporting such information, as well as to address actual needs. The Business Intelligence Data Engineer provides expertise to the business in data analysis, reporting, and business intelligence. You will report to the Director of Business Systems and Data.

The Impact You Will Have


 * Design/Strategy: The Sr. Data Analyst designs and supports the business’s reporting needs using Tableau and, in the future, other BI tools.
 * Collaboration: The role that the Sr. Data Analyst plays is highly collaborative and, as such, works closely with Data engineers and business analysts within the business. Also works closely with other disciplines/departments and teams across the industry to develop simple, functional, and elegant solutions that balance data needs across the business.
 * Analytics: The senior data Analyst is analytical in quickly and thoroughly analysing business requirements for reporting and analysis, translating results into good technical data designs.
   
   

What We Look For


 * 6+ years of experience with Tableau and BI tools
 * Proven experience in developing and working with Tableau-driven dashboards and analytics.
 * Advanced Tableau development skills required
 * Working knowledge of Tableau administration/architecture.
 * Ability to query and display large datasets while maximising the performance of the workbook
 * Ability to interpret technical or dashboard structure and translate complex business requirements to technical specifications
 * Work with business stakeholders to create valuable reports and dashboards that provide insight, improve/automate processes, or add value to the team.
 * High-level competency in Excel (macros, pivot tables, etc.).
 * Understanding of advanced calculations and statistical functions.
 * A solid understanding of SQL, relational database management systems, data modelling, and normalisation
 * Strong communication skills.
 * Attention to detail and accuracy.
 * Prior experience in Data Engineering is a strong plus.
   
   

About Databricks

Databricks is the data and AI company. More than 10,000 organizations worldwide — including Comcast, Condé Nast, Grammarly, and over 50% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform to unify and democratize data, analytics and AI. Databricks is headquartered in San Francisco, with offices around the globe and was founded by the original creators of Lakehouse, Apache Spark™, Delta Lake and MLflow. To learn more, follow Databricks on Twitter, LinkedIn and Facebook.

Benefits

At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region, please visit https://www.mybenefitsnow.com/databricks.

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.

Compliance

If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.

title: Senior Data Analyst (Marketing Analytics, Bangkok Based, Relocation provided)
description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Performance Marketing Team of Agoda is a world leader in online marketing. This department is highly data-driven and focused on developing at-scale marketing programs that improve the lifetime value of Agoda customers through measurable marketing programs and channels. The team is a blend of the best analysts, marketing strategists, and data scientists in the world. The marketing leadership at Agoda have deep experience in data science, product, strategy, and other marketing fields and have built an organization that thrives on data, creative ideas, and technology. The Performance Marketing Team also fosters a great learning environment. You will be able to learn and grow by working closely with experts from a variety of backgrounds from all over the world.

In this Role, you’ll get to:


 * Search: Experiment with text ads, bidding, and campaign structures on Google, Bing, Baidu, Naver, and other search engines. Adapt to new product features and roll out changes from successful tests.
 * Display: Test, analyze, and optimize campaigns on Facebook, Twitter, Instagram, and others.
 * Modeling: Analyze the vast amounts of data generated by experiments, develop models we can use for optimization, and build dashboards for account managers.
   
   

What you’ll Need to Succeed:


 * 4–5 years of experience
 * Bachelor’s Degree or higher from top university in a quantitative subject (computer science, mathematics, economics, engineering, statistics or science)
 * Excellent English communication
 * Advanced business acumen
 * Advanced statistical and analytical skills
 * Advanced Excel and data tool expertise (SAS, R, SPSS, Python, VBA, SQL, Tableau)
 * Leads A/B testing initiatives and interprets results for business impact
 * Operates independently, leads complex projects, and mentors junior analysts
   
   

It’s Great if you Have:


 * Experience in digital marketing
 * Academic research experience

title: PowerBI Developer
description:
We are seeking a skilled and strategic Power BI Engineer with over two years of experience in business intelligence and data analytics. This role demands proficiency in Power BI, SQL, and Excel, including the ability to build dynamic visualizations from OLAP cubes within Excel. The ideal candidate will participate in the development of scalable BI solutions to deliver actionable insights through Power BI and Excel-based reporting.




Duties & Responsibilities

· Design, development, and deployment of Power BI dashboards and reports

· Expertise in SQL based data models and queries

· Create advanced Excel reports and visualizations using pivot tables, Power Pivot, and cube functions · Build and maintain OLAP cube connections for Excel-based analysis

· Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and translate them into technical solutions

· Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and performance across reporting systems

· Stay current with BI trends and recommend tools and techniques to enhance reporting capabilities




Requirements

Basic Qualifications

· Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field

· 2+ years of experience in business intelligence, data engineering, or analytics

· Proficiency in Power BI (DAX, Power Query, data modeling, visualization)

· Proficiency in SQL skills for data extraction, transformation, and performance tuning

· Proficiency in Excel skills including pivot tables, Power Pivot, cube formulas, and OLAP integration · Familiarity with SharePoint to be able to support existing SharePoint reports and convert them to Power BI

· Experience working with large datasets and complex data environments

· Excellent communication skills · Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git /

SVN

Preferred Qualifications

· Familiarity with SharePoint to be able to support existing SharePoint reports and convert them to Power BI

· Experience with cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP)

· Familiarity with data warehousing concepts and tools (e.g., Snowflake)

· Knowledge of Python or R for data analysis

· Certification in Power BI, Excel, or related technologies

title: Healthcare Research & Data Analyst
description:
We are looking for an Analyst to join our LifeScience and Healthcare Products business group in Noida. This is an amazing opportunity to be a member of a talented and vibrant Biopharma Insights team. The team consists of about 100 people and is reporting to the Director/Senior Director. We have a great skill set in market research and assessment, analysis and insights and we would love to speak with you if you have skills in pharmaceutical market research.

About You – Experience, Education, Skills, And Accomplishments


 * Master’s degree in pharmacy/life sciences/pharmaceutical management is required.
 * At least 2 years of relevant experience in the biopharma, healthcare, market research, or financial sector is required. Global experience and experience in directly working with global stakeholders is preferable.
 * In-depth knowledge of at least one therapeutic area is required.
 * Excellent attention to detail.
 * Outstanding communication skills (written and oral) with ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and objectively in both written and spoken English
 * Proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)
 * Experience in analyzing and interpreting complex datasets
   
   

It would be great if you also had . . .


 * A flexible and collaborative approach to work.
 * Ability to interact and build relationships with co-workers
 * Ability to work well under pressure and meet deadlines
   
   

What will you be doing in this role?

This position offers an excellent opportunity for a highly motivated university postgraduate with 3-5 years of experience to work in market analysis and forecasting while developing an understanding of the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare industries. The Therapy Analyst role consists of three broad functions: 1) primary and secondary market research; 2) writing capabilities; 3) market sizing and forecasts. As part of the role, you will be


 * Gathering and critically analyzing and interpreting clinical data and commercial information from a multitude of data sources, and draw conclusions to evaluate market trends, assess commercial opportunities and work on the various variables for market sizing/ forecasts.
 * Translate domain/therapeutic expertise, primary market research and secondary market research data into knowledge and insights for syndicated reports.
 * Design primary market research surveys including questionnaires, and conduct primary research via surveys and interviews with medical and health experts.
 * Effectively communicate these insights to the appropriate audience via written reports.
   
   

About The Team

Analysts in Understand business provide pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, financial services, and managed care companies with the analytics they need to compete and thrive in an increasingly competitive marketplace. Each year, these companies turn to us for their strategic planning, market development, technology management, and competitive intelligence requirements. Biopharma team of Understand Business is a team of business insights analysts who design, research, author, and present market research studies on different indications to help pharmaceutical companies make decisions about the development of new drugs and management of marketed products.

Hours of Work

40 hours in a week as an FTE.

At Clarivate, we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities for all qualified persons with respect to hiring, compensation, promotion, training, and other terms, conditions, and privileges of employment. We comply with applicable laws and regulations governing non-discrimination in all locations.

  • At least 2 years of relevant experience in the biopharma, healthcare, market research, or financial sector is required. Global experience and experience in directly working with global stakeholders is preferable.
  • In-depth knowledge of at least one therapeutic area is required.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Outstanding communication skills (written and oral) with ability to communicate clearly, concisely, and objectively in both written and spoken English
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, and PowerPoint)
  • Experience in analyzing and interpreting complex datasets

It would be great if you also had . . .

  • A flexible and collaborative approach to work.
  • Ability to interact and build relationships with co-workers
  • Ability to work well under pressure and meet deadlines

What will you be doing in this role?

This position offers an excellent opportunity for a highly motivated university postgraduate with 3-5 years of experience to work in market analysis and forecasting while developing an understanding of the pharmaceutical, biotechnology, and healthcare industries. The Therapy Analyst role consists of three broad functions: 1) primary and secondary market research; 2) writing capabilities; 3) market sizing and forecasts. As part of the role, you will be

  • Gathering and critically analyzing and interpreting clinical data and commercial information from a multitude of data sources, and draw conclusions to evaluate market trends, assess commercial opportunities and work on the various variables for market sizing/ forecasts.
  • Translate domain/therapeutic expertise, primary market research and secondary market research data into knowledge and insights for syndicated reports.
  • Design primary market research surveys including questionnaires, and conduct primary research via surveys and interviews with medical and health experts.
  • Effectively communicate these insights to the appropriate audience via written reports.

About The Team

Analysts in Understand business provide pharmaceutical, biotech, medical device, financial services, and managed care companies with the analytics they need to compete and thrive in an increasingly competitive marketplace. Each year, these companies turn to us for their strategic planning, market development, technology management, and competitive intelligence requirements. Biopharma team of Understand Business is a team of business insights analysts who design, research, author, and present market research studies on different indications to help pharmaceutical companies make decisions about the development of new drugs and management of marketed products.

Hours of Work

40 hours in a week as an FTE.

title: Data Analyst
description:
Binated is hiring for Data Analyst in Pune!




We are looking for a Data Analyst who can transform data into meaningful insights that support business decision making. The ideal candidate should be comfortable working with large datasets, identifying trends, building reports, and collaborating with cross functional teams to drive data driven strategies.




Online: Please submit your resume to hr@binated.com for faster response times




Job Type: Full-time, Permanent




Key Responsibilities

 * Collect, clean, and analyze data from multiple sources.
 * Develop dashboards, reports, and visualizations to track key business metrics.
 * Identify trends, patterns, and actionable insights to support decision-making.
 * Work closely with business teams to understand data requirements.
 * Perform data validation and ensure accuracy and consistency.
 * Write SQL queries to extract and manipulate data.
 * Present findings in a clear and simple manner to stakeholders.
 * Support automation of reports and data workflows.




Required Qualifications

 * Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or related field.
 * 1–3 years of experience in data analysis (freshers with strong skills may apply).
 * Strong knowledge of SQL and Excel.
 * Experience with data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
 * Basic understanding of statistics and data modeling.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
 * Good communication and presentation skills.




Preferred Skills

 * Knowledge of Python or R for data analysis.
 * Experience working with large datasets or cloud data platforms.
 * Understanding of business KPIs and reporting frameworks.
 * Familiarity with automation and workflow tools.




Benefits:

 * Leave encashment
 * Provident Fund




Supplemental Pay Types:

 * Overtime pay
 * Shift allowance
 * Yearly bonus




Binated does not charge any fee at any stage of the recruitment & selection process. Binated has not authorized any person/agency/partner to collect any fee for recruitment from candidates. If at all you notice the above, please bring it to our attention immediately.
