title: GTM Data Analyst
description:
At ClickUp, we’re not just building software. We’re architecting the future of work! In a world overwhelmed by work sprawl, we saw a better way. That’s why we created the first truly converged AI workspace, unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI, empowering millions of teams to break free from silos, reclaim their time, and unlock new levels of productivity. At ClickUp, you’ll have the opportunity to learn, use, and pioneer AI in ways that shape not only our product, but the future of work itself. Join us and be part of a bold, innovative team that’s redefining what’s possible! 🚀

In this dynamic and rapidly evolving digital landscape, the seamless coordination and efficient management of tasks and projects have become paramount. This role will be instrumental in assisting and empowering ClickUp, a cutting-edge productivity platform, to thrive and provide top-notch solutions. While your expertise will be utilized by ClickUp, Deel will serve as your Employer of Record in India. This unique collaboration will create an environment where your talent can truly shine, making a significant impact on the productivity and success of ClickUp's operations.

ClickUp is looking for a motivated Data Analyst with expertise in problem solving and data visualization to join our high-performing Data team in the Growth organization. We are building a world class Growth organization at ClickUp with the goal to make a significant impact on the company's already rapid global growth.

About The Team & Role

The Data team at ClickUp is made up of data analysts, engineers, and scientists that are strategic business partners inside of the larger Growth organization. You will collaborate with the data team members to answer complex business problems.

As a GTM Data Analyst, you will be creating compelling visualizations, dashboards, and reports that provide actionable insights into our business operations and growth initiatives. Your goal will be to arm stakeholders with the data analysis and reporting needed to make important investment and growth decisions.

Your ability to communicate in a clear and concise manner will be critical in collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders. This role will be a part of an India based analytics team.

Key Responsibilities:


 * Collaborate cross-functionally with stakeholders from the Sales, Customer Experience, & Data teams to support strategic decision-making with data-driven analyses.
 * Develop and maintain dashboards by writing custom SQL queries that empower teams and provide actionable insights.
 * Identify key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics that align with business goals, ensuring reporting accuracy and relevance.
 * Define and report on key metrics such as Account Health, Support Team Efficiency, and Customer Success Performance
 * Hands-on experience working with large scale structured, semi-structured and unstructured data and various approaches to clean and quality check data.
 * Translate quantitative analyses and complex questions into digestible reporting for the larger organization.
 * Extract meaningful insights from sales, support, and account behavioral data to enhance understanding of customer behavior and trends.
 * Develop and maintain well-managed data solutions, tools, and capabilities to enable self-service frameworks for data consumers.
 * ClickUp Data Stack: Snowflake, SQL, DBT, Tableau, Hex, Amplitude
   
   

Requirements


 * Bachelor’s (or Master’s) degree in a technical field such as Business Analytics, Engineering, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Stats, etc.
 * 3-6 years of experience as a Data Analyst (or similar profession).
 * Exceptional experience in SQL.
 * Proficiency in Tableau software (or similar BI tool).
 * Excellent communication skills, with the ability to present insights to both technical and non-technical audiences.
 * Fluency in spoken and written English.
   
   

Desirable


 * Project management skills.
 * Basic understanding of Python.
 * Basic working knowledge of statistics and techniques like regression, segmentation and A/B testing
 * Basic understanding of DBT and Git.
 * Experience with Salesforce and Zendesk systems and data
   
   

Unsure if you meet all the qualifications of this job description but are deeply excited about the role? We hire based on ambition, grit, and a passion for improving the way people work. If you think ClickUp is the company for you, we encourage you to apply!

At ClickUp, we assess every candidate based on the potential impact they can have. We hire the best people for the job and support each person’s journey to build their boldest career.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Privacy Notice

ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws.


 * If you are a European Job Applicant, see our privacy policy for further details.

Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com. title: Data Analyst
description:
About The Company

Vensure Employer Solutions is a leading provider of comprehensive HR outsourcing and business solutions, dedicated to helping organizations streamline their human resources functions. With a commitment to innovation and excellence, Vensure offers a wide range of services including payroll processing, employee benefits administration, risk management, and compliance consulting. Our client-centric approach ensures that we deliver tailored solutions that address the unique needs of each business, fostering growth and operational efficiency. As a trusted partner in HR solutions, Vensure Employer Solutions prides itself on maintaining high standards of integrity, professionalism, and technological advancement to support our clients' success.

About The Role

We are seeking a highly skilled Report Developer to join our dynamic team at Vensure Employer Solutions. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in developing and maintaining business intelligence reports and dashboards using Power BI and Sigma. This role requires a deep understanding of SQL, data modeling, and ETL processes to facilitate accurate and insightful data analysis. The Report Developer will collaborate closely with business stakeholders to gather requirements, design effective visualizations, and deliver scalable BI solutions that drive strategic decision-making. You will play a pivotal role in enhancing our data reporting capabilities, ensuring optimal performance, and supporting the organization’s data-driven culture.

Qualifications

The successful candidate should possess a minimum of 6-8 years of experience in report development and business intelligence roles. Expertise in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query, and report design, is essential. Advanced proficiency in Sigma for creating interactive visualizations is required. Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries, stored procedures, and data transformations, are necessary. Familiarity with relational databases such as SQL Server, PostgreSQL, or MySQL is expected. Candidates should have a solid understanding of data modeling, dimensional modeling, and data warehousing concepts. Experience with ETL tools like Azure Data Factory or SSIS, along with knowledge of version control systems such as Git, will be advantageous. A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Business Analytics, Data Science, or a related field is preferred.

Responsibilities


 * Design, develop, and maintain interactive dashboards and reports utilizing Power BI and Sigma platforms to provide actionable insights.
 * Write and optimize complex SQL queries, stored procedures, functions, and data transformations to extract, manipulate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
 * Create advanced data models and dimensional designs using DAX, Power Query, and best practices in data warehousing.
 * Develop and manage ETL/ELT pipelines to connect, import, shape, and transform data from relational databases, ensuring data quality and consistency.
 * Enhance report performance by fine-tuning data models, query execution, and refresh schedules to ensure timely data availability.
 * Publish, share, and manage reports on Power BI Service, including handling user access control and permissions management.
 * Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, understand reporting needs, and translate them into effective visualizations and dashboards.
 * Maintain comprehensive technical documentation for data models, reports, and ETL processes to ensure clarity and facilitate future updates.
 * Participate in code reviews, contribute to the continuous improvement of BI solutions, and implement best practices in report development.
 * Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot report issues, and optimize reports for efficiency and accuracy.
   
   

Benefits

Vensure Employer Solutions offers a competitive benefits package that includes health insurance, dental and vision coverage, retirement plans, paid time off, and professional development opportunities. Employees enjoy a collaborative work environment that fosters innovation and growth. We emphasize work-life balance and provide resources to support employee well-being. Our commitment to continuous learning ensures that team members stay updated with the latest BI tools and industry best practices. Additionally, Vensure offers flexible work arrangements and recognizes outstanding performance through various incentive programs.

Equal Opportunity

Vensure Employer Solutions is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences foster innovation and contribute to our ongoing success. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristic.

description:

As a Analytics Solutions Associate in the WLS team, you will leverage data analytics, machine learning, and business acumen to drive insights, optimize processes, and support strategic decision-making in wholesale lending operations.

 * Integrate AI-driven analytics into dashboards for real-time insights, automated commentary, and dynamic visualizations.

title: Data Management Associate
description:
Job Description

The Workforce Activity Data Utility (‘WADU’) is part of the EX HR Employee Experience organization. WADU is at the forefront of data driven decision making and is focused on building out a new firm-wide capability that unlocks the potential of our Workforce Activity data to enhance our strategic and investment decisions. It is used firm-wide for numerous different use cases and the Palmos Data Quality team is fundamental to the success of Employee Platforms. The team’s role is to ensure the accuracy of data.

As a Data management associate within Workforce Activity Data Utility team, you will be responsible for the end to end data journey, from sourcing of new data feeds, ingestion of those feeds, building data quality rules for data quality assurance and constantly coming up with creative solutions to streamline and improve at every step.

The Palmos Data Quality Utility team is looking for an energetic and driven Data Analyst to join an exciting new opportunity. We need people that can think outside the box, are diligent and curious; and want to get it right.

Job Responsibilities


 * Understand that good data is foundational
 * Daily execution of BAU to ensure our data quality is good.
 * Evaluate current user cases, conduct gap analysis and identify opportunities for building data quality rules covering critical data elements.
 * Partners with our client engagement teams to ensure our end users are getting the maximum value out of our analytics and insights.
 * Build strong relationship with stakeholders and own the responsibility to build and run data quality engine
 * Should be comfortable to code and build data quality rules in DQ tool implemented on Palmos
 * Ensure effective communication to data providers and consumers in case of data issues
   
   

Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills


 * Self-starter with ability to manage own workload and deliverables.
 * 6+ years in a Data related role, or in a Change/Transformation role or as a technology Business Analyst working with a technology team.
 * A passion for data, data skills, BIG Data and data tools.
 * Expertise in working with data to query, be curious with data and have a sensible regard around data accuracy. Data interrogation and Quality checking.
 * Experience around data tools like SQL, Python, Alteryx, Excel, Tableau, Qlikview, RDS.
 * Strong entrepreneurial spirit and ability to structure and scope complex problems; team-oriented nature with clear ownership mentality.
 * Strong problem-solving aptitude, very strong analytical skills and idea generation, with the ability to go from conceptualization to execution.
   
   

Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills


 * Strong inter-personal skills with ability to forge strong relationships with key stakeholders including technology partners.
 * Excellent oral and written executive-level communication and presentation skills.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Job Summary: Help measure the product performance data (website). Bridge the gap between raw data and actionable insights by ensuring our reporting is accurate, untainted by bots, and resilient to tracking issues.




Experience Level: 3-6 yrs




Key Responsibilities:

 * Data Analysis and reporting – Analyse data, build and maintain frameworks to quantify the historical impact of Data Quality (DQ) issues. This will also involve stripping out "noise" to reveal true performance trends. Proactively identify and mitigate data inflation caused by bots, scrapers, and click-tracking errors.
 * Digital Analytics Governance: Utilize CJA (Customer Journey Analytics) or similar tools to build robust reporting dashboards that the product team can trust.
 * Performance Diagnostics: Lead deep-dive investigations into sudden dips or spikes in product KPIs, diagnosing whether the cause is a technical bug, a tracking failure, or a shift in user behaviour.




Skills:

 * Proficient in SQL, Python and Tableau
 * Digital Analytics Expertise: Hands-on experience with Adobe CJA or similar tools like Google Analytics 4, or Amplitude.
 * Analytical Rigor: The ability to look at a metric dip and systematically "peel the onion" to find the root cause.
 * Communication: Ability to translate complex data integrity issues into simple business impact statements for stakeholders.

title: Data Engineer
description:
ABOUT TRIBUTE TECHNOLOGY:

At Tribute Technology, we make end-of-life celebrations memorable, meaningful, and effortless through thoughtful and innovative technology solutions. Our mission is to help communities around the world celebrate life and pay tribute to those we love. Our comprehensive platform brings together software and technology to provide a fully integrated experience for all users, whether that is a family, a funeral home, or an online publisher. We are the market leader in the US and Canada, with global expansion plans and a growing international team of more than 400 individuals in the US, Canada, Philippines, Ukraine and India.

ABOUT YOU:

Tribute Technology is actively seeking a motivated an experienced Data Engineer with expertise in AWS and GCP to join our Data & Analytics team. Our Data & Analytics team drives innovation and excellence by harnessing data to deliver actionable insights across the organization.

As Data Engineer, you will play a crucial role in developing and enhancing our data pipelines, processes and visualizations as well as selecting fit for purpose tools to support our growing business needs. This is an exciting opportunity for a data enthusiast with a strong record of success in managing complex data initiatives. If you have a strong understanding of AWS and GCP and a passion for building data engineering projects, we want to hear from you.

Join us and be a part of our innovative and collaborative environment where your contributions will have a significant impact.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:


 * Strong hands-on experience to design, build and maintain scalable and reliable data pipelines in AWS and GCP for a data lake environment.
 * Define and enforce data governance frameworks to ensure security, integrity and compliance along with optimizing data pipelines for high performance, scalability and cost efficiency in cloud environments (AWS and GCP) and BI tools (Power BI, Looker).
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate them into data engineering solutions.
 * Design and implement data pipelines and processes to integrate data from various sources into the data ecosystem.
 * Improve data observability and ensure the team follows best practices.
 * Ensure timely resolution for data pipeline issues implementing a monitoring and incident response strategy.
 * Implement best practices for data governance, ensuring high data quality, consistency, and security across the data pipelines.
 * Foster a collaborative environment, ensuring the team works cross-functionally with business stakeholders to deliver projects effectively.
 * Create documentation of the pipelines, maintain data asset documentation and data product documentation to ensure visibility and discoverability of our data products.
 * Review and weigh in on functional and technical requirements.
   
   
   

EDUCATION AND/OR EXPERIENCE:


 * Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering or relevant field of study with 5 to 7 years of progressively technology experience.
 * Design and implement cloud native data engineering solutions using core technologies in AWS services such as Glue, Lambda, S3, Athena, IAM roles/policies and Google Big Query.
 * Experience in data engineering technologies such as Python, SQL, Spark, batch, real time streaming pipelines, data lakes and data warehouse solutions.
 * Build and optimize ETL/ELT processes for both structured and unstructured data.
 * Experience in using GitHub and CI/CD pipelines for code deployment.
 * Proven data engineering experience in cloud environments.
 * Experience in creating data products and/or data product environment.
   
   
   

BENEFITS:


 * Competitive salary
 * Fully remote across India
 * An outstanding collaborative work environment
   
   
   

Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of the position

description:
Job Title: Research Trainee – AI Project

Location: Noida (Work from Office – Full Time)

Type: Trainee




About the Role

We are looking for potential Research Trainees to join our AI Project team. This role is ideal for intellectually curious individuals who enjoy deep research, experimentation, and solving real-world problems.

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to build and validate a scalable digital health product through structured research, experimentation, and on-ground insights.







Key Responsibilities

 * Conduct in-depth market research, competitor analysis, and industry benchmarking
 * Perform use-case discovery and validation for digital health solutions
 * Design, execute, and analyze experiments to test hypotheses
 * Leverage AI tools effectively for research, analysis, productivity, and workflow optimization
 * Conduct user surveys, focus group discussions (FGDs), and one-on-one interviews to assess product–market fit
 * Synthesize research findings into structured reports with clear insights and actionable recommendations
 * Coordinate with internal teams (product, tech, operations) and external stakeholders when required
 * Support strategic decision-making through data-backed insights







Ideal Candidate Profile

 * Strong analytical and research skills
 * Experimental and exploratory mindset
 * Highly comfortable using AI tools and digital research platforms
 * Strong verbal and written communication skills
 * Confident interacting with users and stakeholders
 * High ownership, proactive attitude, and bias for action
 * Detail-oriented with structured thinking ability




Preferred Background

 * Students or recent graduates from top-tier institutions such as:
 * Shri Ram College of Commerce (SRCC)
 * St. Stephen’s College
 * Miranda House
 * Hindu College
 * Or other reputed institutions

title: Data Analyst
description:
Job overview

We’re looking for a sharp, execution-focused Data Analyst who will own analytics, CRM integrity, and dashboard intelligence across the organization.

This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Growth, and Finance. You will turn fragmented data into a structured revenue engine, ensuring clean CRM data, accurate reporting, automated dashboards, and actionable insights for leadership.

If you enjoy transforming messy systems into scalable infrastructure, this role is for you.




Requirements

1.Business analytics

 * Aspiring Data Analyst with hands-on experience in data manipulation, visualization, and statistical analysis
 * Strong foundation in SQL, Python (Pandas, NumPy), and Tableau from academic projects and internships
 * Monitor KPIs: pipeline velocity, CAC, win rates, churn, expansion, forecasting
 * Identify risks and opportunities through data-backed diagnostics




2.CRM Ownership

 * Manage and maintain CRM (HubSpot) to ensure data integrity, accuracy
 * Customize pipelines, workflows, automation, scoring logic, and properties
 * Manage CRM integrations (marketing automation, analytics, enrichment tools)




3.Dashboard and automations

 * Build self-serve dashboards for Sales & Leadership
 * Automate recurring reporting (eliminate manual spreadsheets)
 * Design repeatable reporting templates and operating cadences
 * Create structured weekly / monthly performance reporting systems
 * Passionate about deriving actionable insights to support data-driven decision-making




4.Excellent communication and collaboration skills, eager to learn in a fast-paced SaaS environment




Key Skills

 * Data Analysis: SQL, Python
 * Visualization: Tableau / Power BI / Looker / Elastic
 * Database Management: MySQL / PostgreSQL / No SQL databases
 * Scripting & ETL: Bash / Python
 * Soft Skills: Communication, Teamwork, Problem Solving
 * 1–3 years in Analytics, RevOps, Sales Ops, or Data roles (preferably in SaaS/startups)
 * Working knowledge of CRM systems (HubSpot preferred)




Interview process

We follow a fast-paced and friendly interview process, just like the way we work.

There are typically two rounds in total.

 * The first round focuses on understanding your approach to solving problems, how you work with data, and basic technical skills like Excel, SQL, or Python.
 * The second round is more about your thinking process, how you analyze trends, and how well you can communicate your findings. We want to see how curious and sharp you are when it comes to working with numbers and drawing insights from data.




Interview best practices

 * In some interviews you would be required to write your thoughts on google docs. Have a notebook / pen also handy in case you need to jot down your thoughts.
 * Please make sure that you are in an environment that allows you to turn your camera on and make the interview more interactive.




About Company

Vision : BIK helps e-commerce companies in India to generate more revenue. We work with big e-commerce players in India like Livspace, Fireboltt, Tata Brands, Forum mall. We have two products BIK and Manifest.ai. Our vision is to be the market leaders in the marketing automation category across the world.

Scale : We process more than a billion events across these brands on an yearly basis which is increasing rapidly MOM.

Fuel : Monetizing the product from early days we have a solid business model and our revenue numbers are growing at a healthy pace. Apart from this we are funded by top investors in the world like Sequoia capital and Ycombinator.

People : We have a culture which gives you a lot of challenges to solve and at the same time get high rewards.

title: Data Engineer
description:
Greif is a global leader in performance packaging located in 40 countries. The company delivers trusted, innovative, and tailored solutions that support some of the world's most in demand and fastest-growing industries.




With a commitment to legendary customer service, operational excellence, and global sustainability, Greif packages life's essentials - and creates lasting value for its colleagues, customers, and other stakeholders.




Learn more about the company's Customized Polymer, Sustainable Fiber, Durable Metal, and Integrated Solutions at www.greif.com and follow Greif on Instagram and LinkedIn.




Our Vision

Being the customer service company in the world.




Our Purpose

Creating packaging solutions for life’s essentials.




Job Requisition #:

033238 Data Engineer (Open)




Job Description

Greif is seeking a skilled Data Engineer to join our global data team in India. This role will be responsible for designing, developing, and supporting scalable data pipelines and data platform capabilities that improve data reliability, quality, and accessibility across the enterprise. In addition to core data engineering responsibilities, this position will support the enterprise data platform for traditional AI and GenAI use cases, including proofs of concept (PoCs) and pilot initiatives.

The Data Engineer will work closely with data scientists, architects, and analytics teams to ensure data is well-prepared, governed, and performant for AI experimentation and deployment. The role will collaborate with technology and business stakeholders across India, the US, and EMEA, providing both development and operational (administrative) support for enterprise data platforms.




Major Responsibilities

 * Analyze, profile, and organize large volumes of structured and semi-structured data
 * Design, develop, test, and maintain robust ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory and Python
 * Build and optimize data warehouse, data lake, and data platform solutions (e.g., Snowflake or similar platforms)
 * Integrate and harmonize data from multiple internal and external sources
 * Support data acquisition and ingestion strategies aligned with business and AI use-case needs
 * Collaborate with AI Lab teams to prepare, curate, and optimize data sets for AI/ML as well as GenAI PoCs and pilot solutions
 * Enable scalable and reusable data assets that support experimentation, feature development, and model training
 * Evaluate business requirements and translate them into scalable data engineering and platform solutions
 * Prepare data for descriptive, predictive, and prescriptive analytics
 * Develop reusable data engineering frameworks, utilities, and analytical tools
 * Collaborate closely with data scientists, data architects, BI developers, and business analysts
 * Regularly interact with global stakeholders to identify opportunities to enhance analytics, AI, and data platform capabilities
 * Proactively identify, troubleshoot, and resolve data quality, performance, and reliability issues
 * Provide administrative and operational support for the data platform, including monitoring, access support, incident resolution, and basic platform maintenance
 * Contribute to documentation, standards, and best practices for data engineering and AI-ready data platforms
 * Perform other duties as assigned




Education And Experience

 * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, or equivalent degree
 * 3–5 years of hands-on experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar role
 * Strong programming experience with Python
 * Advanced SQL skills, including complex queries and performance tuning
 * Hands-on experience with Snowflake or similar cloud data warehouses
 * Experience supporting analytics and visualization tools such as Power BI (preferred), Tableau, or Cognos
 * Good understanding of business domains such as Finance, Sales, Manufacturing, and Supply Chain
 * Conceptual and practical understanding of data modeling, data integration, and data transformation techniques
 * Experience with Microsoft Azure services, including Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Microsoft Fabric and related platform services
 * Exposure to AI/ML workflows, feature engineering concepts, or data preparation for machine learning is a plus
 * Relevant certifications (e.g., Snowflake Data Engineer, Azure Data Engineer) are desirable




Knowledge And Skills

 * Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a global, matrixed environment
 * Strong verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders
 * Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership, urgency, and accountability
 * Comfortable supporting both stable production platforms and fast-paced AI PoCs/pilots
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
 * Consistently exhibits a positive, proactive, and “can-do” attitude




At Greif, we believe that our colleagues are the center of our success. Our Total Rewards have a comprehensive focus on well-being and offer a competitive package that enables you to thrive, be engaged, and reach your full potential.




Protect Yourself From Scams: We value the integrity of our recruitment process and prioritize the well-being of our candidates. While you may find Greif job postings on various platforms, all legitimate opportunities can be verified on our official Careers page at www.greif.com. All communication from Greif regarding job opportunities will also come from an @greif.com email address. If you have concerns about the legitimacy of a job posting, receive an unsolicited job offer or suspect fraudulent activity, please contact us for verification via this link Contact Us - Greif.




EEO Statement

https://www.greif.com/wp-content/uploads/2023/04/HR-101-Equal-Employment-Opportunity-Policy-English.pdf

We offer a competitive salary, excellent benefits and opportunity for growth. Greif is an equal opportunity employer. We will not discriminate against any applicant or employee on the basis of sex, race, religion, age, national origin, color, disability, veteran status or any other any other legally protected characteristic.

For more information read Greif’s Equal Opportunity Policy.

title: AI Safety Analyst, Workspace AI Trust and Safety
description:
Minimum qualifications:


 * Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
 * 5 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
 * 5 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.
 * 2 years of experience in GenAI safety, adversarial ML, or technical risk management.
   
   

Preferred qualifications:


 * Master's degree in a quantitative discipline.
 * 5 years of experience with one or more of the following languages: SQL, R, Python, or C++.
 * 5 years of experience with machine learning systems.
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
   
   

About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

Workspace AI Trust and Safety is seeking a great analyst who is passionate about making AI safe for the world.

In this role, you'll have the exciting opportunity to shape the safety of Google AI products. With your knowledge and passion for learning new things, you will help the teams to solve the classes of challenging problems in AI safety and misuse at Google scale.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Responsibilities


 * Identify and investigate possible failure modes for GenAI products on a broad range from sociotechnical harms to misuse.
 * Design and build implementation for anti-abuse detection and action systems, including detection and enforcement AI agents, to protect Google Workspace AI products at scale.
 * Perform in-depth analysis of risks, measure and mitigate AI-related risks, using benchmarking, evaluations, dataset design, and usage monitoring.
 * Prepare analysis reports and present findings and solutions to stakeholders with exceptional written and verbal communication.
 * Collaborate with other Google teams to ensure that the issues are understood and solutions are adopted.
   
   
   

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. Minimum qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5 years of experience in data analysis, including identifying trends, generating summary statistics, and drawing insights from quantitative and qualitative data.
  • 5 years of experience managing projects and defining project scope, goals, and deliverables.
  • 2 years of experience in GenAI safety, adversarial ML, or technical risk management.

Preferred qualifications:

  • Master's degree in a quantitative discipline.
  • 5 years of experience with one or more of the following languages: SQL, R, Python, or C++.
  • 5 years of experience with machine learning systems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

About The Job

Trust & Safety team members are tasked with identifying and taking on the biggest problems that challenge the safety and integrity of our products. They use technical know-how, excellent problem-solving skills, user insights, and proactive communication to protect users and our partners from abuse across Google products like Search, Maps, Gmail, and Google Ads. On this team, you're a big-picture thinker and strategic team-player with a passion for doing what’s right. You work globally and cross-functionally with Google engineers and product managers to identify and fight abuse and fraud cases at Google speed - with urgency. And you take pride in knowing that every day you are working hard to promote trust in Google and ensuring the highest levels of user safety.

Workspace AI Trust and Safety is seeking a great analyst who is passionate about making AI safe for the world.

In this role, you'll have the exciting opportunity to shape the safety of Google AI products. With your knowledge and passion for learning new things, you will help the teams to solve the classes of challenging problems in AI safety and misuse at Google scale.

At Google we work hard to earn our users’ trust every day. Trust & Safety is Google’s team of abuse fighting and user trust experts working daily to make the internet a safer place. We partner with teams across Google to deliver bold solutions in abuse areas such as malware, spam and account hijacking. A team of Analysts, Policy Specialists, Engineers, and Program Managers, we work to reduce risk and fight abuse across all of Google’s products, protecting our users, advertisers, and publishers across the globe in over 40 languages.

Responsibilities

  • Identify and investigate possible failure modes for GenAI products on a broad range from sociotechnical harms to misuse.
  • Design and build implementation for anti-abuse detection and action systems, including detection and enforcement AI agents, to protect Google Workspace AI products at scale.
  • Perform in-depth analysis of risks, measure and mitigate AI-related risks, using benchmarking, evaluations, dataset design, and usage monitoring.
  • Prepare analysis reports and present findings and solutions to stakeholders with exceptional written and verbal communication.
  • Collaborate with other Google teams to ensure that the issues are understood and solutions are adopted.

We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

title: Primary Research Analyst- Supervising Associate
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Job Description

Job Title:

Primary Research Analyst

Function:

EY Insights

Job Summary:

The Primary Research Analyst will execute primary research projects, with a focus on survey-based research, to identify insights that power distinctive pieces of thought leadership to help EY shape the global dialogue on topics we study and solve the toughest issues facing our clients, business and society.

As part of the EY Insights, this role will execute primary research projects to support EY’s Tier 1 thought leadership content – a curated set of high impact pieces aligned to EY’s strategic themes that provide a differentiated and innovative point of view on a topic relevant to a broad audience. Topics may be cross-cutting or focused on a specific domain. All work will be done under the guidance of the Primary Research Lead and in collaboration with EY business leaders, EY Knowledge domain analysts, subject matter experts and data specialists in the EY Research Institute, editorial teams and internal/external activation networks.

The Primary Research Analyst will be responsible for analyzing primary data, identifying business-relevant insights, and creating a compelling story and supporting material tailored to external or executive audiences. This person will have expertise in primary research methodology and best practices, with a strong focus on survey-based research. Areas of expertise should include basic and advanced techniques in survey analysis (such as sample weighting, segmentation, and regression), experience with appropriate analytics tools and software, interpretation of data and distillation of insights, survey data visualization best practices, and storytelling with data. Experience with quantitative and qualitative secondary research desirable but not required. The Primary Research Analyst will be part of a center-of-excellence team dedicated to primary research and will leverage expertise and tools across their team and the EY Insights to deliver high quality insights and output.

This position requires the ability to combine strong analytical skills, a strategic mindset, and a commercial perspective driven by an understanding of both clients’ experiences and broader marketplace forces. Collaboration and communication are crucial, as the EY Insights has a key role to play in sharing information across sectors, service lines, accounts and solutions, and using that information to further strengthen the quality of insights produced.

Essential Functions of the Job:


 * Partner with the Primary Research Lead, business leaders and subject matter experts to execute primary research studies resulting in business-relevant insights on a variety of topics with the goal of identifying and testing key trends, understanding how existing trends will evolve, or what new trends may emerge.
 * Select and execute the optimal analytical approach to meet project objective and deliver differentiated insights that go beyond the obvious.
 * Use data to create compelling storylines and communicate them succinctly through data visualizations and PPTs.
 * Leverage appropriate tools to automate the production of decks to tailor data and content to specific audiences.
 * Rapidly develop an understanding of new project topics and their business/market context to inform analysis, interpretation and delivery of insights.
 * Collaborate with members of their team and the EY Insights community to execute analysis, leverage subject matter expertise, identify additional data and tools to enhance output, adopt and share best practices, and deliver high quality insights.
 * Work across EY to centralize our survey data and prepare it to be ingested by EY proprietary tools.
 * Work in a flexible and agile manner, adjusting the depth or focus of analysis to align with publishing priorities agreed by the Global Editorial Board.
 * Leverage EY’s proprietary insights and global network of colleagues to improve and enhance the quality of insights delivered, including interacting with account teams, sector and service line colleagues, domain subject matter experts, Insight teams, clients and external networks.
 * Collaborate with editorial and marketing colleagues to help deliver and activate distinctive insights both internally at EY and externally to clients.
 * Work with external vendors and collaborators to collect, process, and quality control data.
 * Clearly and concisely communicate (both in writing and orally) analytic approaches, novel insights and distinctive points of view on research topics.
 * Develop a credible internal brand within EY as subject matter expert on the practices of primary research.
 * Innovate on approaches to content development; trial new formats and methodologies; and scale successful proofs of concept.
   
   

Analytical/Decision Making Responsibilities:


 * Responsible for analyzing and interpreting the results of complex, global, internally- and externally-executed research projects.
 * Select and implement the appropriate analytical approach to achieve Tier 1 thought leadership objectives.
 * Quality control insights and outputs to ensure accuracy, integrity, and application of best practices in data handling and analysis.
 * Bring together a variety of perspectives and sources to develop a compelling, business-relevant point of view.
 * Work with subject matter experts to evaluate multiple business drivers and identify the root causes of key trends.
   
   

Knowledge and Skills Requirements:


 * Expertise in data analysis and interpretation with 3+ years of primary research and analysis activity.
 * Survey analysis, interpretation and storytelling
 * Experience in survey design, including questionnaire development, logic conditions, setting respondent quotas and screeners
 * Experience in survey execution, including monitoring fieldwork and data quality control
 * Experience in basic survey analysis techniques including significance testing, crosstabs, and sample weighting
 * Experience with advanced survey analytics techniques including segmentation, clustering, regression & driver analysis
 * Experience with appropriate statistical analysis tools used in survey analysis such as SPSS, R, or Q
 * Ability to critically assess survey results, distil key insights, craft a storyline and create compelling supporting material such as PPT decks
 * Intellectual curiosity and a demonstrated ability to rapidly develop an understanding of new content and speak credibly with stakeholders
 * Ability to navigate key stakeholders to understand what they are trying to achieve and the insights they hope to surface
 * Strong communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, including best practices in survey data visualization
   
   

Primary & Secondary Data Analysis


 * Experience employing other quantitative & qualitative techniques for primary and secondary research. Examples could include analyzing numerical data sets (e.g. financial performance data), developing or conducting benchmarking exercises, conducting interviews, or analyzing unstructured data to identify insights and trends.
 * Experience with python to process survey data for ingestion into EY proprietary tools is desirable, but not required
 * Ability to surface the insight that aren't immediately obvious when looking at an issue / market to identify emerging trends
   
   

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

description:
Description

Excited about innovative technology and how it will be used in our everyday lives? Amazon is pushing the boundaries of what's possible in smart device technology, making the future closer than ever.

Our devices use AI and machine learning to seamlessly interact with people and spaces, helping customers protect and monitor what matters most. Our products are designed to help with a range of tasks like security, monitoring, and staying connected with family. We bring together advancements in artificial intelligence, computer vision, sensor technology, voice and edge computing to create solutions that are helpful, reliable, and convenient.

Key job responsibilities


 * Perform annotation-related tasks across ML data processing areas including audio, image, video, and text files by following defined instructions to collect accurate ground truth data for product development
 * Execute structured, detail-oriented exercises based on evolving instructions while maintaining high quality standards using internal software tools and data capture systems
 * Apply thoughtful language skills, grammar knowledge, and linguistic awareness to ensure generated text adheres to proper grammar, syntax, and appropriate language usage
 * Understand and follow procedures, guidelines, and compliance requirements for new tasks and releases while collaborating in data collection activities using provided scripts and instructions
 * Meet daily productivity and quality targets efficiently by tracking task completion status using recommended tools and providing individual status reports
 * Maintain high internal quality of processes by performing thoughtful quality audits and verification activities
 * Capture and report results accurately, communicate issues effectively, and escalate concerns promptly through established channels
 * Raise all questions, concerns, and issues related to execution through the designated portal and resolve them according to defined SLAs, while sharing relevant information with stakeholders through effective collaboration
 * Take trustworthy ownership of daily targets and manage dependencies, both internal and external, to ensure timely completion
 * Adhere to confidentiality and compliance requirements to ensure trustworthy and responsible handling of customer data
 * Help test new SOPs and ML data tools while providing specific and timely feedback to improve existing processes and support consistent, high-quality results
 * Follow organizational processes on a daily basis while meeting established productivity and quality expectations
   
   

Job Requirement


 * Flexible for rotational schedule/work area, including weekends and/or holidays
 * Familiarity with US culture is added advantage
   
   

Basic Qualifications


 * Bachelor's degree
 * Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications
 * Knowledge of advanced English language skills at CEFR level B2 (Intermediate) or C1 (Advanced)
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Master's degree or above in Computational Linguistics
 * Minimum 1+ years of experience in ML Data operations

title: Analyst
description:
Site Name: Bengaluru Luxor North Tower

Posted Date: Mar 5 2026

Key Responsibilities:-

As an Analyst deputed in DS&M sub-functions, at a minimum would carry out the following responsibilities:



 * Responsible for the technical development of electronic Data capture (eDC) and/or Electronic Patient-Reported Outcomes (ePRO) solutions and/or the technical acquisition of vendor data.
 * Engage in activities that enhance automation in a process, involve in tool maintenance and development.
 * Apply technical knowledge on need basis for any of the following – Programming / UAT / Data cleaning & Analysis / Validation / Regulatory submissions.
 * Assist in the creation and maintenance of Quality plan and implementation at study level.
 * Ensure all task related documents are accurate and present in the eTMF system.
 * Adhere to the relevant departmental SOPs, corporate policies, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.
 * Compliant in completing all task-related trainings via Learning Hub and ILT.
 * Provides relevant reports, status updates, feedback on trends observed in day-to-day tasks.
 * Contributes to after-action reviews (success or failure) to share learnings and propose improvements for the future.
 * Involve in interaction with IT, Clinical Systems team and the vendors that are hosting and/or supporting the applications.
   
   
   

Why GSK?

Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.

GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.

People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Inclusion at GSK:

As an employer committed to Inclusion, we encourage you to reach out if you need any adjustments during the recruitment process.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

Important notice to Employment businesses/ Agencies

GSK does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact GSK's commercial and general procurement/human resources department to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to GSK. The obtaining of prior written authorization is a condition precedent to any agreement (verbal or written) between the employment business/ agency and GSK. In the absence of such written authorization being obtained any actions undertaken by the employment business/agency shall be deemed to have been performed without the consent or contractual agreement of GSK. GSK shall therefore not be liable for any fees arising from such actions or any fees arising from any referrals by employment businesses/agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site.

It has come to our attention that the names of GlaxoSmithKline or GSK or our group companies are being used in connection with bogus job advertisements or through unsolicited emails asking candidates to make some payments for recruitment opportunities and interview. Please be advised that such advertisements and emails are not connected with the GlaxoSmithKline group in any way.

GlaxoSmithKline does not charge any fee whatsoever for recruitment process. Please do not make payments to any individuals / entities in connection with recruitment with any GlaxoSmithKline (or GSK) group company at any worldwide location. Even if they claim that the money is refundable.

If you come across unsolicited email from email addresses not ending in gsk.com or job advertisements which state that you should contact an email address that does not end in “gsk.com”, you should disregard the same and inform us by emailing askus@gsk.com, so that we can confirm to you if the job is genuine.

title: KYC Associate
description:
Position Overview

Job Title - KYC Associate

Location - Bangalore, India

Role Description


 * Operations provides support for all of Deutsche Bank’s businesses to enable them to deliver transactions and processes to clients. Our people work in established global financial centers such as London, New York, Frankfurt and Singapore, as well as specialist development and service centers in locations including Bucharest, Moscow, Pune, Dublin and Cary.
 * A dynamic and diverse division, our objective is to make sure that all our services are executed in a timely and professional manner, that risk is minimized and that the client experience is positive. We are proud of the professionalism of our people, and the work they do. In return, we offer excellent career development opportunities to foster skills and talent.
 * In accordance with Anti-Money Laundering Requirements, Banks, such as Deutsche Bank AG ("DB"), are obliged to perform Know-your-client (“KYC”) reviews on all new clients they adopt. These checks and reviews are made in strict accordance with regulatory requirement and the bank’s internal policies.
 * The project involves verification of the Client data, performing due diligence checks on the Clients, reviewing KYC documentation performing the risk assessment of the Client, liaising with the Business/Compliance, advising on KYC requirements and signing off on new client adoptions.The Reg & Tax analyst role is an operations function where you will be involved in reviewing various regulatory documents related to clients to ensure that all the regulatory requirements are met and the bank is in compliance.
   
   
   

What We’ll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy


 * Best in class leave policy
 * Gender neutral parental leaves
 * 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
 * Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 * Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 * Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
 * Accident and Term life Insurance
 * Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
   
   
   

Your Key Responsibilities


 * Responsible for verification of Client data
 * Perform due diligence of new and existing clients covering a wide range of different client types including; Listed and Regulated, small/medium/ large private and public companies as well as more complex structures such as; SPVs, Co-operatives, Foundations and Funds, Governments, Joint Ventures, etc.
 * Verifying KYC documentation of the Clients to be adopted/reviewed
 * Perform the risk assessment of the Client to be adopted/reviewed
 * Signing off on new client adoptions and periodic reviews
 * Manage New Client Adoption or Periodic Review stream, to ensure that all requests are approved in accordance with regulatory requirements and the bank’s internal policies
 * Manage exception ensuring that all SLA’s defined with the Business on timeliness and quality are adhered
   
   
   

Your Skills And Experience


 * 6+ years of relevant work experience (AML/KYC/compliance related) within corporate financial services industry, Research/Analytics role in other Banks / KPOs etc
 * Understanding of Control, Compliance, Investigation/chasing functions in banks
 * Familiarity AML/KYC regulations and industry guidelines (FSA, JMLSG, 3rd EU Money Laundering Directive, MiFID)
 * Ability to interpret regulatory guidelines and assessing risk scores and entity types
 * Ability to interpreting alerts
 * Ability to identifying trends and inconsistencies
 * Understanding of end to end KYC process
   
   
   

How We’ll Support You


 * Training and development to help you excel in your career
 * Coaching and support from experts in your team
 * A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
 * A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
   
   
   

About Us And Our Teams

Please visit our company website for further information:

https://www.db.com/company/company.html

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

description:

NTT DATA strives to hire exceptional, innovative and passionate individuals who want to grow with us. If you want to be part of an inclusive, adaptable, and forward-thinking organization, apply now.

We are currently seeking a Business and Data analyst to join our team in Remote, Karnātaka (IN-KA), India (IN).

"Job Duties: 1. Act as a Business Analyst for P&C claims initiatives using Guidewire ClaimCenter


 * Elicit, analyze, and document end-to-end claims business requirements
 * Translate business needs into functional specifications and user stories
 * Support configuration and enhancement of ClaimCenter modules and workflows
 * Collaborate with product owners, developers, and QA during design and delivery
 * Participate in UAT planning, execution, and defect triage for claims applications
 * Ensure solutions align with insurance regulations, compliance, and best practices
 * Provide functional support during production issues and change requests
 * Facilitate workshops, walkthroughs, and stakeholder reviews across geographies
 * Continuously improve claims processes through data-driven insights and analysis
   
   

Minimum Skills Required: 1. Strong hands-on experience in P&C Insurance, specifically Claims domain


 * Proven expertise in Guidewire ClaimCenter (configuration, workflows, FNOL, claims lifecycle)
 * Solid understanding of claims processing, adjudication, reserves, subrogation, and settlements
 * Experience gathering and documenting business requirements (BRD, FRD, user stories)
 * Ability to work closely with business stakeholders, QA, and development teams
 * Knowledge of insurance data models, policy, claims, and exposure relationships
 * Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies and sprint ceremonies
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills for global stakeholders
 * Willingness and ability to work in 2 PM – 11 PM IST shift with overlapping US business hours"
   
   

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30 billion business and technology services leader, serving 75% of the Fortune Global 100. We are committed to accelerating client success and positively impacting society through responsible innovation. We are one of the world's leading AI and digital infrastructure providers, with unmatched capabilities in enterprise-scale AI, cloud, security, connectivity, data centers and application services. our consulting and Industry solutions help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have experts in more than 50 countries. We also offer clients access to a robust ecosystem of innovation centers as well as established and start-up partners. NTT DATA is a part of NTT Group, which invests over $3 billion each year in R&D.

Whenever possible, we hire locally to NTT DATA offices or client sites. This ensures we can provide timely and effective support tailored to each client’s needs. description:
About MetaMorph




MetaMorph is an HR advisory firm partnering with high-growth startups and new-age businesses to help them build strong, scalable teams. We work closely with founders and leadership teams to hire talent across functions that drive long-term business impact.




About Our Client




Our client is one of India’s leading consumer internet platforms operating at massive scale in a high-volume B2C environment. The company manages millions of transactions daily and is known for its strong technology backbone, data-driven decision-making, and operational excellence.




What You’ll Do

 * Analyze large volumes of transactional data to identify revenue leakages, discrepancies, and trends.

 * Create structured data models and flat tables using SQL for reporting and analytics needs.
 * Provide actionable insights to stakeholders to support financial accuracy and control.

 * Has 2–5 years of experience in data analytics, preferably in a high-volume B2C or FinTech setup.

 * Has worked extensively on live dashboards, reporting automation, and data manipulation.
 * Possesses strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a first-principles mindset.
 * Is highly detail-oriented with a strong ownership mindset.
 * Can independently drive discussions with cross-functional teams to close gaps.
 * Thrives in a fast-paced, dynamic, and constantly evolving environment.

title: Reference Data Analyst, Associate
description:
Position Overview

Job Title: Reference Data Analyst, AS

Location: Pune, India

Role Description


 * The Reference Data Analyst supports regulatory reporting by performing daily data aggregation for 'party' records.
 * This role executes established data quality controls and maintains meticulous process documentation, ensuring adherence to regulatory requirements.
 * They assist the regulatory reporting team, help resolve issues by collaborating with stakeholders and contribute to process improvements for data accuracy and efficiency.
 * These services are crucial for supporting the organization's data outputs and operational integrity.
   
   
   

What We’ll Offer You

As part of our flexible scheme, here are just some of the benefits that you’ll enjoy


 * Best in class leave policy
 * Gender neutral parental leaves
 * 100% reimbursement under childcare assistance benefit (gender neutral)
 * Sponsorship for Industry relevant certifications and education
 * Employee Assistance Program for you and your family members
 * Comprehensive Hospitalization Insurance for you and your dependents
 * Accident and Term life Insurance
 * Complementary Health screening for 35 yrs. and above
   
   
   

Your Key Responsibilities


 * Execute daily data aggregation tasks for diverse 'party' data, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of datasets to reporting teams, following defined SLAs.
 * Perform comprehensive data quality checks, validation rules, and control procedures on incoming and aggregated party data to identify and log errors.
 * Assist in maintaining control reports and dashboards to monitor data quality metrics and pipeline health, supporting continuous oversight of data integrity.
 * Investigate and document identified data discrepancies, quality issues, or aggregation failures within party records, tracking their impact diligently.
 * Support collaboration with source system owners and IT to facilitate resolution of identified data defects at their origin, ensuring corrective actions.
 * Maintain and update operational runbooks, process documentation, and data lineage, ensuring compliance with banking policies and regulatory standards.
 * Provide support as a point of contact for reporting teams, offering clarification, issue updates, and assisting with data quality status communication.
 * Assist in identifying and documenting improvements to existing data aggregation processes, tools, and controls to enhance efficiency and accuracy.
   
   
   

Your Skills And Experience

Domain Skills


 * Over 5 years of experience in the Financial Services Industry, with 3+ year focused on data management or reference data.
 * Basic understanding of diverse banking product data (deposits, loans, cards) and their relationships with customer and account party records.
 * Familiarity with critical banking reference data including currency codes, LEIs, and branch codes, supporting accurate record aggregation.
 * Awareness of financial services data privacy regulations (e.g., GDPR, CCPA) and their implications for sensitive party data handling.
 * Foundational understanding of key financial reporting requirements (Basel III, IFRS, CCAR) and how aggregated data contributes.
 * Ability to assist in identifying data-related risks (quality, security, non-compliance) impacting financial reporting and critical submissions.
 * Familiarity with internal audit requirements, data governance frameworks, and basic operational risk controls within banking.
 * Proficiency in creating MI Reporting using advanced Excel functions and assisting with data visualizations in tools like Tableau.
 * Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, capable of understanding and contributing to breaking down complex data situations.
 * Ability to foster trust and collaborate effectively within a team, demonstrating good communication skills with various stakeholders.
   
   
   

Communication Skills


 * Strong stakeholder management skills across various seniority levels
 * Good verbal and written communication skills at all levels - onshore & remote
 * Ability to visualise complex topics to converse with stakeholders.
   
   
   

Technical Skills


 * Expert at data identification, validation, correction and reconciliation.
 * Advanced knowledge of MS Excel and MS PowerPoint is a must
   
   
   

Soft Skills


 * Ability to work independently and take ownership
 * Flexibility to handle multiple parallel projects / engagements
 * Ability and interest to adopt to new requirements and new data domains (e.g. switching from a Party reference to a Credit Risk requirement)
   
   
   

Educational Qualification


 * Degree in any subject or business management
   
   
   

How We’ll Support You


 * Training and development to help you excel in your career
 * Coaching and support from experts in your team
 * A culture of continuous learning to aid progression
 * A range of flexible benefits that you can tailor to suit your needs
   
   
   

About Us And Our Teams

Please visit our company website for further information:

https://www.db.com/company/company.html

We strive for a culture in which we are empowered to excel together every day. This includes acting responsibly, thinking commercially, taking initiative and working collaboratively.

Together we share and celebrate the successes of our people. Together we are Deutsche Bank Group.

We welcome applications from all people and promote a positive, fair and inclusive work environment.

title: Analytics Manager
description:
Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.

Together with analytics team leaders you will support our business with excellent data models to uncover trends that can drive long-term business results.

How You Will Contribute

You will:


 * Execute the business analytics agenda in conjunction with analytics team leaders
 * Work with best-in-class external partners who leverage analytics tools and processes
 * Use models/algorithms to uncover signals/patterns and trends to drive long-term business performance
 * Execute the business analytics agenda using a methodical approach that conveys to stakeholders what business analytics will deliver
   
   
   

What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:


 * Using data analysis to make recommendations to analytic leaders
 * Understanding in best-in-class analytics practices
 * Knowledge of Indicators (KPI's) and scorecards
 * Knowledge of BI tools like Tableau, Excel, Alteryx, R, Python, etc. is a plus
   
   
   

More About This Role

What you need to know about this position:

The Supply Network Design Analyst will improve business results by giving tactical & strategic business solutions via applying his/her analytical skills using analytical data modelling against various supply chain problems. He/She will be responsible for providing analytics and certain degree of project management to the various projects and regular network capacity reviews for various BUs. This role utilizes network modelling, data management tools and visualization to drive sound, fact-based business decisions on the E2E supply network. This includes product sourcing, manufacturing footprint, capacity analysis, distribution network design and cost-to-serve analysis.


 * Identifies data requirements, defines best fit data sources, and works with stakeholders on data validation
 * Models the network according to project charter and following existing global modelling standards and tools
 * Models, assesses (costs, service, inventory) and validates scenario outputs using visualization software (e.g. Tableau) and discusses it with relevant stakeholders
 * Maintains current knowledge of modelling and analysis techniques and works on continuous improvement through networking with internal stakeholders and external professional organizations, vendors, and support forums
 * Builds trust and credibility with different stakeholders to achieve common organizational goals and targets
   
   
   

What extra ingredients you will bring:

You will: 


 * Work in close partnership with the business leadership team to execute the analytics agenda
 * Identify and incubate best-in-class external partners to drive delivery on strategic projects
 * Develop custom models/algorithms to uncover signals/patterns and trends to drive long-term business performance
 * Execute the business analytics program agenda using a methodical approach that conveys to stakeholders what business analytics will deliver
   
   
   

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:


 * Using data analysis to make recommendations to analytic leaders
 * Understanding in best-in-class analytics practices
 * Knowledge of Indicators (KPI's) and scorecards
 * Knowledge of BI tools like Tableau, Excel, Alteryx, R, Python, etc. is a plus
   
   
   

Education / Certifications:


 * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Applied Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science
   
   
   

Job specific requirements:


 * Overall experience Logistics, Distribution, Production / Operations management, and/ or supply chain management (FMCG preferred)
 * Demonstrated experience in applying analytical to solve business problems
 * Strong experience in Supply Chain Guru/lyric any similar Supply Chain optimization tools is must!
 * Proven experience in reporting and managing projects with cross-functional and global stakeholders
 * Stronghold in Visualization Tools (Tableau/Power BI) – Power BI Preferred
 * Stronghold in Data Management and Processing Tools (Alteryx/R/Prep) - Alteryx Preferred
 * Experience in Statistical analytical tools and projects may be advantageous.
   
   
   

Travel requirements:

Work schedule:

Within Country Relocation support available and for candidates voluntarily moving internationally some minimal support is offered through our Volunteer International Transfer Policy

Business Unit Summary

At Mondelēz International, our purpose is to empower people to snack right by offering the right snack, for the right moment, made the right way. That means delivering a broad range of delicious, high-quality snacks that nourish life's moments, made with sustainable ingredients and packaging that consumers can feel good about.

We have a rich portfolio of strong brands globally and locally including many household names such as Oreo, belVita and LU biscuits; Cadbury Dairy Milk, Milka and Toblerone chocolate; Sour Patch Kids candy and Trident gum. We are proud to hold the top position globally in biscuits, chocolate and candy and the second top position in gum.

Our 80,000 makers and bakers are located in more than 80 countries and we sell our products in over 150 countries around the world. Our people are energized for growth and critical to us living our purpose and values. We are a diverse community that can make things happen—and happen fast.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Job Type

Regular

Analytics & Modelling

Analytics & Data Science

title: VP- Data Governance and Controls
description:
About This Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Data Management Analyst within Corporate and Investment Banking (CIB) delivers a comprehensive suite of capital markets, banking, and financial products and services. A trusted partner to our clients, we provide corporate and transactional banking, commercial real estate lending and servicing, investment banking, equity and fixed income solutions including sales, trading, and research capabilities to corporate, commercial real estate, government, and institutional clients across the globe.

Data Management: Covers jobs that drive oversight, governance, and management of critical data to support business needs, initiatives, and strategies. Consult with data product, data integrity, technology, and business partners to set standards, policies and practices for data flow, data framework, data access, documentation, quality, and remediation

In This Role, You Will


 * Organize and lead complex companywide initiatives to ensure that data quality is maintained so that data can effectively support business processes
 * Oversee analysis and reporting in support of regulatory requirements
 * Identify and recommend analysis of data quality or integrity issues
 * Evaluate data quality metrics and data quality audits to benchmark the state of data quality
 * Make decisions in complex and multi-faceted situations requiring solid understanding of data governance standards and procedures
 * Identify new data sources and develop recommendations for assessing the quality of new data
 * Lead project teams and mentor less experienced staff members
 * Recommend remediation of process or control gaps that align to management strategy
 * Serve as relationship manager for a line of business
 * Consult with and provide recommendations to senior management regarding assessments of the current state of data and metadata quality within area of assigned responsibility
 * Represent client in cross-functional groups to develop companywide data governance strategies
 * Strategically collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and mid-level to senior managers to coordinate and drive collaboration on solution design and remediation execution
   
   

Required Qualifications:


 * 5+ years of Data Management, Business Analysis, Analytics, or Project Management experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
