title: Data / AI Engineer
description:
Hello Visionary!

We empower our people to stay resilient and relevant in a constantly changing world. We’re looking for people who are always searching for creative ways to grow and learn. People who want to make a real impact, now and in the future. Does that sound like you? Then it seems like you’d make an outstanding addition to our vibrant team. Siemens Mobility is an independent run company of Siemens AG. Its core business includes rail vehicles, rail automation and electrification solutions, turnkey systems, intelligent road traffic technology and related services. In Mobility, we help our customers meet the need for hard-working mobility solutions. We’re making the lives of people who travel easier and more enjoyable while constantly developing new, intelligent mobility solutions!

We are looking for Data / AI Engineer

You’ll make a difference by


 * The Data & AI Engineer / Analyst will be responsible for designing, enabling, and supporting data-driven insights across Siemens Mobility India’s factories, offices, and projects.
 * The role focuses on analytics, reporting, data platforms, and governance, supporting business growth, operational excellence, and digitalization initiatives.
 * Translate complex business requirements into clear technical specifications and high-impact data and analytics solutions that deliver measurable business value.
 * Drive the deployment and adoption of the Data Management Framework across departments, ensuring best practices in data governance, security, quality, and regulatory compliance.
 * Design, build, and continuously enhance data processing and transformation solutions using Python, SQL, and cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Azure or AWS).
 * Demonstrate strong SQL expertise, hands-on experience with data warehouses (Snowflake preferred), and proficiency in Power BI dashboard development and analytical reporting.
 * Design, develop, and maintain scalable end-to-end data pipelines, analytics solutions, and AI/ML-ready datasets, ensuring data quality and readiness for current and future AI initiatives.
 * Implement and support robust data models, solution designs, and system architectures to enable reliable, scalable, and performant analytics platforms.
 * Domain knowledge in Finance and Manufacturing will be considered a strong added advantage, enabling deeper business understanding and more relevant, value-driven analytics solutions.
 * Work closely with business teams across factories, projects, and corporate functions to understand data and analytics requirements and translate them into effective IT and data solutions.
 * Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and analytical reports to support operational monitoring, management reporting, and data-driven decision-making.
 * Build, enhance, and support data pipelines, data lakes, and data warehouse solutions using SQL, Python, and cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Azure or AWS).
 * Ensure high data quality, consistency, security, and compliance by driving adoption of the organization’s data governance and data management framework.
 * Design and maintain scalable data models and solution architectures to enable reliable reporting, analytics, and future AI initiatives.
 * Analyse enterprise data to identify trends, patterns, and improvement opportunities, proactively proposing insights and data-driven recommendations.
 * Support data readiness for advanced analytics, AI, and GenAI use cases by ensuring clean, structured, and well-governed datasets.
 * Collaborate with IT teams, data engineers, business stakeholders, and external service providers to ensure timely and high-quality delivery of data solutions.
 * Monitor and continuously improve performance, stability, and usability of analytics platforms and reporting solutions.
 * Support user adoption through documentation, training sessions, and knowledge transfer, enabling effective use of analytics tools across the organization.
   
   

Desired Skills:


 * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (B.E./B.Tech), or Master of Computer Applications (MCA) / MBA.
 * 3+ years of relevant experience in data science, machine learning, or analytics projects.
 * Extensive knowledge of analytics systems, especially cloud data platforms (Azure/AWS) and reporting tools (Qlik Sense, Power BI, Tableau).
 * Strong data analytical skills to identify key business drivers and trends.
 * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and other programming languages as needed.
 * Hands-on experience in building data pipelines, data modeling, and implementing AI/ML solutions in business contexts.
 * Basic understanding of software development principles, algorithm design, and coding best practices.
 * Strong functional understanding of Finance and manufacturing process.
 * Hands-on experience or strong working knowledge of Power BI for financial reporting and analytics.
 * Proven experience in business analysis, requirement gathering, functional documentation, and solution design for corporate applications.
 * ERP Cloud Platform Experience: Familiarity with cloud-based ERP solutions (e.g., SAP S/4HANA Cloud) and their integration with existing on-premises systems, enabling better scalability, flexibility, and reduced infrastructure costs.
 * Experience with quality assurance, data protection, and compliance methodologies.
 * Ability to discover, evaluate, and implement new technologies as needed.
 * Demonstrated ability to deliver projects as part of a collaborative team.
   
   

Join us and be yourself!

We value your unique identity and perspective and are fully committed to providing equitable opportunities and building a workplace that reflects the diversity of society. Come bring your authentic self and create a better tomorrow with us.

Make your mark in our exciting world at Siemens.

This role is based in Pune. You might be required to visit other locations within India and outside. In return, you'll get the chance to work with teams impacting - and the shape of things to come. We're Siemens. A collection of over 379,000 minds building the future, one day at a time in over 200 countries. We're dedicated to equality, and we encourage applications that reflect the diversity of the communities we work in. All employment decisions at Siemens are based on qualifications, merit and business need. Bring your curiosity and creativity and help us shape tomorrow.

Find out more about mobility at: https://new.siemens.com/global/en/products/mobility.html and about Siemens careers at: www.siemens.com/careers

title: Associate Lead
description:
Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - Mantri

Job Purpose

As an AI Engineer in Data Intelligence Unit, you will help build and operate the core building blocks of Data Representation learning and Context Engineering across the credit Risk, Fraud/FRM, Sales, Collections & Recovery. You will work with senior engineers and Data scientists to converts raw structured and unstructured data into reliable features, embeddings, retrieval-ready knowledge assets, and repeatable evaluation pipelines – so downstream AI pods can ship models faster, safer, and with measurable quality.

Duties And Responsibilities


 * Data Representation Pipelines
 * Prepare and validate datasets from multiple sources (transactions, bureau, device/digital, documents,
   
   
   

CRM/operations)


 * Implement features engineering pipelines (aggregations, ratios, behavior signals) and maintain feature
   
   
   

definitions.


 * Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and
   
   
   

scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.


 * Support embedding workflows (text/customer/device/dealer/geo) including batch refresh, versioning, and
   
   
   

lineage.


 * Knowledge Engineering Support (Canonical Objects & Metadata Assets)
 * Help create/maintain canonical objects, entity dictionaries, taxonomies/ontologies, and labeling guidelines.
 * Support annotation/labeling workflows (quality checks, consistency, sampling) for training and evaluation.
 * Experimentation & Model Operations
 * Execute training/inference jobs using established frameworks, log experiments and outcomes.
 * Perform error analysis, data leakage checks, and basic model monitoring (drift signals, data anomalies)
 * Contribute to deployment readiness: tests, reproducible configs, and incident triage support.
 * Retrieval & Context Engineering Support (LLM/RAG enablement)
 * Assist document processing: chunking, cleaning, metadata tagging, indexing access filters.
 * Maintain prompt/context templates, grounding rules, and evaluation sets for RAG/LLM assistants used by
   
   
   

Pods.


 * Run offline evaluations (retrieval quality, answer quality, regressions) and track metrics across releases.
 * Engineering Hygiene & Governance
 * Write clean, testable code; follow Git workflows and CI checks.
 * Maintain documentation: dataset cards, feature notes, pipeline SOPs, and release checklists.
 * Follow security/privacy controls for regulated data, ensuring traceability and auditability.
   
   
   

Basic Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Experience


 * Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS/Math/Engineering
 * 0 – 2 years’ experience in Data Science /Applied ML/ ML Engineering with proven leadership delivering
   
   
   

production – grade ML system at scale.

Required Skills & Competencies Core (must-have)


 * Programming: Python (strong), SQL (strong); Git; basic unit testing.
 * Data: Pandas/PySpark basics, joins/aggregations/window functions, data validation and profiling.
 * ML Fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, embeddings, train/val/test discipline, metrics, and error analysis.
 * Applied System Mindset: reproducibility, structured debugging, logging/monitoring fundamentals. Good-to-have Skills
 * ML frameworks: Pytorch / TensorFlow; experiment tracking (MLFlow)
 * Retrieval stack: vector indexing concepts, chunking strategies, hybrid search ideas, evaluation datasets.
 * Data/Infra: Airflow/Prefect, Spark, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MongoDB, feature stores, graph Database, vector database, model serving basics. Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience building end-to-end decisioning platforms with real-time and batch orchestration.
 * Graph ML / entity-resolution experience for relationship-based risk and fraud analysis.
 * Experience operating ML systems across multiple products/segments with multi-tenant controls.
 * Publications/patents or strong track record of innovation in applied ML, large-scale ML systems

title: Data Engineer - QA (R-18907)
description:
Shape the Future with Dun & Bradstreet

At Dun & Bradstreet, we believe data has the power to create a better tomorrow. As a global leader in business decisioning data and analytics, we help companies worldwide grow, manage risk, and innovate. For over 180 years, businesses have trusted us to turn uncertainty into opportunity. We’re a diverse, global team that values creativity, collaboration, and bold ideas. Are you ready to make an impact and help shape what’s next? Join us! Explore opportunities at dnb.com/careers.




A QA engineer’s role involves the testing of both new and existing applications for Dun and Bradstreet. QA engineers are expected to develop a testing plan, execute that plan, provide feedback to developers as well as a summary for the project manager in a readable format, as well as build and maintain integration testing.






Key Responsibilities:
 * We are looking for someone who can thoroughly test newly developed code across multiple programming languages, including Python, SQL, Bash, and Java.
 * Is capable of designing, executing, and validating integration tests to ensure smooth end‑to‑end functionality.
 * Works effectively with cross‑functional teams to maintain business continuity and support ongoing operations.
 * Thrives in an Agile environment and contributes actively within SCRUM teams, applying Lean principles to deliver high‑quality outcomes.




Key Skills:
 * Looking for an experienced professional who brings a solid technical foundation with a bachelor’s degree in a related field.
 * 3-5 years of experience in SQL, Linux, manual and automated testing (with strong preference for Python).
 * Strong teamwork and communication skills, and familiarity with cloud technologies such as AWS, Azure, or similar platforms.







The job role is internally titled as Software Engineer I.




All Dun & Bradstreet job postings can be found at https://jobs.lever.co/dnb. Official communication from Dun & Bradstreet will come from an email address ending in @dnb.com.




Notice to Applicants: Please be advised that this job posting page is hosted and powered by Lever, a subsidiary of Employ Inc. Your use of this page is subject to Employ's Privacy Notice and Cookie Policy, which governs the processing of visitor data on this platform.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. title: Data Engineer II
description:
Description

FBA is seeking a Data Engineer to build AI-native data infrastructure that embeds intelligence as a foundational feature. If you enjoy innovating and want to contribute to an industry-changing business while building next-generation intelligent data platforms, this role is for you.

Core Responsibilities

AI-Native Infrastructure & Real-Time Processing


 * Engineer AI-native infrastructure supporting real-time data processing for AI/ML inference, training, and continuous learning
 * Build semantic layers and knowledge graphs enabling intelligent query routing and context-aware data access
 * Develop infrastructure for agentic AI systems with multi-agent orchestration
 * Implement GenAI-powered data quality, entity resolution, and metadata management
   
   

Data-as-a-Product Delivery


 * Own end-to-end accountability for data products from ingestion to consumption
 * Deliver data products with clear SLAs, quality metrics, and customer satisfaction measures
 * Build self-service platforms with embedded governance, lineage, and discovery
 * Establish data contracts and APIs for reliable, versioned data consumption
   
   

AWS Infrastructure & Pipeline Engineering


 * Manage AWS resources: EC2, Lambda, S3, Redshift, Kinesis, EMR, SageMaker, Bedrock, Neptune
 * Build high-quality pipelines supporting analysts, data scientists, and AI agents
 * Implement CDC and event-driven architectures for real-time data availability
 * Deploy infrastructure-as-code using CDK/Terraform
   
   

Required Qualifications


 * 5+ years in data engineering with cloud-native architectures
 * Strong AWS expertise (Redshift, S3, Glue, Kinesis, EMR)
 * Proven experience with real-time streaming (Kafka, Kinesis, Flink)
 * Hands-on AI/ML infrastructure experience (SageMaker, Bedrock)
 * Proficiency in Python, SQL, and infrastructure-as-code
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Knowledge graphs (Neptune, Neo4j) and semantic layers
 * GenAI applications and LLM integration patterns
 * Vector databases and feature stores
 * Data mesh and domain-oriented architecture
   
   

Build the foundational infrastructure powering next-generation AI-enabled data products at Amazon FBA.

Basic Qualifications


 * 3+ years of data engineering experience
 * 4+ years of SQL experience
 * Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
 * Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)
   
   

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Advanced Data Engineer
description:
Job Description

As an Advanced Data Engineer here at Honeywell, you will play a pivotal role in designing, developing, and maintaining our data infrastructure and systems. You will be responsible for building robust data pipelines, optimizing data storage, and ensuring data quality and integrity. Your expertise in data engineering will drive the efficient handling and processing of large datasets, enabling data-driven decision-making across the organization.

In this role, you will impact the organization by ensuring the seamless flow of data, enabling advanced analytics, and supporting business growth through data-driven insights. Your work will be critical in optimizing data processes, improving data accessibility, and enhancing the overall data strategy of the company.

At Honeywell, our people leaders play a critical role in developing and supporting our employees to help them perform at their best and drive change across the company. Help to build a strong, diverse team by recruiting talent, identifying, and developing successors, driving retention and engagement, and fostering an inclusive culture.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities


 * Design, develop, and implement data engineering solutions to support business needs
 * Collaborate with crossfunctional teams to understand data requirements and design data models
 * Develop and maintain data pipelines and ETL processes
 * Ensure data quality, integrity, and security
 * Optimize data storage and retrieval for performance and scalability
 * Stay updated on industry best practices and emerging technologies in data engineering
   
   

Qualifications

YOU MUST HAVE


 * Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics
 * Required experience
 * Required trait
   
   

WE VALUE


 * Advanced degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field
 * Experience with big data technologies and cloud platforms
 * Proficiency in programming languages such as Python, Java, or Scala
 * Expertise in data warehousing solutions and ETL processes
 * Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail
   
   

About Us

Honeywell helps organizations solve the world's most complex challenges in automation, the future of aviation and energy transition. As a trusted partner, we provide actionable solutions and innovation through our Aerospace Technologies, Building Automation, Energy and Sustainability Solutions, and Industrial Automation business segments – powered by our Honeywell Forge software – that help make the world smarter, safer and more sustainable.

title: Data Engineer - BI & Analytics
description:
About the job

Your Career, Accelerated

You’ve got the skills. The curiosity. The hunger to grow, try new things and make a real impact. We’re a growing global tech consultancy. Some of the world’s biggest businesses turn to us to help bring their data, AI, cloud and digital solutions to life.

We’re the home base for talented technologists who want more and are looking to take their career to the next level by having more learning, more variety, more support and more chances to do meaningful work. If that sounds like the kind of place you’d thrive in, keep reading.




What You’ll Get

tWe know you're bringing the skills, the passion and the drive. What we bring is the platform to help you go further. At Vivanti, you're not just taking a job, you're investing in your growth

Here’s a taste

 * A platform for growth: Work across industries, clients and technologies that stretch your thinking and build your personal and professional skills
 * Access global businesses: Work with some of the world's biggest brand
 * IP, frameworks and accelerators: We share what we know. Our playbooks and toolkits fast-track your success on projects
 * Access to a broad ecosystem of technologie
 * Senior consultants who have your back: You’ll always have a guide on your journey, not just be thrown into the deep end
 * Serious learning support: Paid certs, weekly training, guilds, hackathons, mentoring and more
 * Progress that’s transparent: Annual Progress Reviews based on 360° feedback, not vague vibes. Clear goals, solid feedback and real growth
 * Kudos and rewards: We celebrate wins, reward impact and offer long-term incentives
 * Real connection: From Friday socials to annual team building days - we work hard and play harder




What We’re Looking For

We are on the hunt for a Technical Builder—someone who doesn't just move data around, but understands how to architect it for impact. You are a problem-solver who enjoys the "heavy lifting" of untangling complex raw data and transforming it into a strategic asset.

We’re less about ticking boxes and more about whether you’d thrive in this environment.

title: Analyst, Digital Tech Developer, Site analytics, Bangalore , India (Hybrid)
description:
Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.

At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

,

Ralph Lauren is looking for an experience for supporting the implementation of Adobe Analytics solutions, ensuring accurate and scalable data collection across digital platforms. The position involves working with modern Adobe technologies such as the AEP Web SDK (Alloy.js), validating analytics implementations, and enabling reliable reporting through Analysis Workspace. Exposure to Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) is considered a plus, supporting future ready measurement for our ongoing migration.

,


 * Manage Adobe Analytics implementation through Adobe Tags (Launch), ensuring accurate tracking, variable mapping, and robust data collection.
 * Develop and enforce tagging standards and data layer specifications across web properties. Troubleshoot and resolve data collection issues using debugging tools.
 * Design and manage Adobe Launch workflows, including rule creation, data element configuration, and extension management for scalable and maintainable tagging
 * Define and configure data sets in analytics platforms (e.g., AEP Data Lake, CJA) is a good to have.
 * Own the integration of third party vendors into the website via Adobe Launch, ensuring proper configuration and execution of event forwarding.
 * Create and maintain reports and dashboards in Adobe Analytics Analysis Workspace in response to business and stakeholder requests.
   
   

,


 * 3 to 6 years of experience leading and supporting Adobe Analytics implementations and migrations, with good to have experience in Adobe Customer Journey Analytics (CJA) and the Adobe Experience Platform Web SDK (Alloy.js).
 * Strong background in web technologies (HTML, JavaScript, CSS) and browser debugging tools such as AEP Debugger, Omnibug.
 * Experience implementing analytics on CMSs with data layers (e.g., ACDL).
 * Experience working with Adobe Analytics Data Feeds, Data Warehouse, and Processing Rules to support data extraction, transformation, and reporting needs.
 * Hands-on experience with Adobe Analytics Analysis Workspace, including building custom projects, reports, dashboards, and deriving actionable insights for business and stakeholder needs.
 * eCommerce retail experience is a plus, particularly experience working with merchandising eVars as part of Adobe Analytics implementations.
 * A background or familiarity with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) is a plus.

title: Associate - AI Driven Consulting
description:
Associate — AI-Driven Consulting

Team: AI Strategy & Transformation (reports to Head of Consulting)

Role type: Associate hire — client-facing, semi-technical, strategic and process AI specialist

Summary

We are seeking an Associate who thrives at the intersection of AI, operations, structured thinking, and data discipline. This role sits at the frontline of AI-enabled transformation programs, responsible for capturing, validating, and structuring real-world operational data and processes into measurable, KPI focused inputs. You will work directly with client leadership and managers to ensure that transformation initiatives. This role offers significant exposure to senior client stakeholders, including CXO-level visibility.

Why this role matters

The requires the candidate to turns AI opportunity into measurable business outcomes. You’ll own stakeholder alignment, value definition, prioritization, program governance, adoption strategy and measurement and reporting ROI. The role will have to action our internal frameworks for delivery of the consulting assignment along with ensuring product development is happening at the requisite quality.

This role requires the candidate to identify the ground realities which feeds the AI transformation. The Associates ensure that operational complexity is translated into structured, quantifiable insights that leadership can act on confidently. The role will have to action our internal frameworks for delivery of the consulting assignment along with ensuring product development is happening at the requisite quality.




Core responsibilities

·      Design and run end-to-end discovery: process maps, data samples, manual observations, photos, video, and other relevant documentation within our discovery templates.

·      Execute root-cause process observations, and structured interviews with operators/supervisors to establish baselines, existing KPIs and impact on business.

·      Work with the Senior Consultant to reimagine existing processes in the most creative way with AI/

·      Build end-to-end Business Requirement Documents along with calculation of ROIs for executing said solutions.

·      Manage delivery of all solution picked to be built in constantly evolving stages.

·      Support adoption activities on-site: co-deliver training, establish “data stewardship” roles with client teams.

·      Maintain clear, professional client communication via succinct slide decks/data briefs for CXO visibility.

·      Ensure responsible AI practices: data governance, model explainability where required, and regulatory/compliance considerations relevant to the industry.




Required experience & profile

 * 2–5 years experience in consulting, operations, field engineering, or process improvement roles; manufacturing/construction experience is valuable but not mandatory.
 * Hands-on exposure to AI solutioning is valuable.
 * Comfortable with physical site visits and client-facing (often CXO) stakeholder interactions.
 * Reasonable understanding of AI/ML/ Gen AI capabilities and constraints.
 * Experience managing third-party vendors and internal development teams; ability to enforce SLAs and deliverable quality.
 * Education: Experience and excitement regarding the prospect of the value AI generates is the primary evaluation criteria. However, graduate degree in MBA and/ or Engineering (MBA, MEng, MSc) or equivalent experience are good to have.




Skills & competencies

 * Strong observational and documentation skills: meticulous discovery and data collection, timestamps, and data lineage.
 * Autonomous work: logical decision making with ownership of action and outcome is a core expectation for this role.
 * Analytical & structured thinking: hypothesis-driven, rigorous in KPIs and measurement design.
 * Program management: multi-track delivery oversight, risk mitigation, and change control.
 * Communication: crisp storytelling, ability to present complex technical trade-offs in business language.
 * Practical technical literacy: fluent in data product concepts (data pipelines, model lifecycle, observability).
 * Operational empathy: deep appreciation for plant/field constraints (safety, shift patterns, legacy systems) and the pragmatics of shop-floor adoption.







Interview process

 1. Screening (HR + recruiter): fit, compensation, location, high-level experience.
 2. Second screening (Consulting team leader): in-depth relevant experience, thought process and excitement with AI and take home consulting case.
 3. Case and domain deep-dive: 60–90 min case focused on framing an AI use-case.
 4. Semi-technical interview: understanding of AI, domain expertise in industry
 5. Client leadership simulation (with Network Science MD): 45–60 min role-play interview as a check to handle different situations one might face with clients such as missing timelines, communication protocols, discoveries and other adversities.
 6. Reference checks & offer.







How to apply

Send CV + 1-page note describing:

 1. Transformation program you have been part of (outcome, your role, measured impact).
 2. If there was an AI element in the program, what was it and why do you think it succeeded or failed?
 3. One example of a failed pilot and what you learned (why it failed, how you addressed the issue).
 4. What excites you about AI? [Do not use AI for this answer – we can tell]

·      Design and run end-to-end discovery: process maps, data samples, manual observations, photos, video, and other relevant documentation within our discovery templates.

·      Execute root-cause process observations, and structured interviews with operators/supervisors to establish baselines, existing KPIs and impact on business.

·      Work with the Senior Consultant to reimagine existing processes in the most creative way with AI/

·      Build end-to-end Business Requirement Documents along with calculation of ROIs for executing said solutions.

·      Manage delivery of all solution picked to be built in constantly evolving stages.

·      Support adoption activities on-site: co-deliver training, establish “data stewardship” roles with client teams.

·      Maintain clear, professional client communication via succinct slide decks/data briefs for CXO visibility.

·      Ensure responsible AI practices: data governance, model explainability where required, and regulatory/compliance considerations relevant to the industry.


Required experience & profile

  • 2–5 years experience in consulting, operations, field engineering, or process improvement roles; manufacturing/construction experience is valuable but not mandatory.
  • Hands-on exposure to AI solutioning is valuable.
  • Comfortable with physical site visits and client-facing (often CXO) stakeholder interactions.
  • Reasonable understanding of AI/ML/ Gen AI capabilities and constraints.
  • Experience managing third-party vendors and internal development teams; ability to enforce SLAs and deliverable quality.
  • Education: Experience and excitement regarding the prospect of the value AI generates is the primary evaluation criteria. However, graduate degree in MBA and/ or Engineering (MBA, MEng, MSc) or equivalent experience are good to have.


Skills & competencies

  • Strong observational and documentation skills: meticulous discovery and data collection, timestamps, and data lineage.
  • Autonomous work: logical decision making with ownership of action and outcome is a core expectation for this role.
  • Analytical & structured thinking: hypothesis-driven, rigorous in KPIs and measurement design.
  • Program management: multi-track delivery oversight, risk mitigation, and change control.
  • Communication: crisp storytelling, ability to present complex technical trade-offs in business language.
  • Practical technical literacy: fluent in data product concepts (data pipelines, model lifecycle, observability).
  • Operational empathy: deep appreciation for plant/field constraints (safety, shift patterns, legacy systems) and the pragmatics of shop-floor adoption.



Interview process

  1. Screening (HR + recruiter): fit, compensation, location, high-level experience.
  2. Second screening (Consulting team leader): in-depth relevant experience, thought process and excitement with AI and take home consulting case.
  3. Case and domain deep-dive: 60–90 min case focused on framing an AI use-case.
  4. Semi-technical interview: understanding of AI, domain expertise in industry
  5. Client leadership simulation (with Network Science MD): 45–60 min role-play interview as a check to handle different situations one might face with clients such as missing timelines, communication protocols, discoveries and other adversities.
  6. Reference checks & offer.



How to apply

Send CV + 1-page note describing:

  1. Transformation program you have been part of (outcome, your role, measured impact).
  2. If there was an AI element in the program, what was it and why do you think it succeeded or failed?
  3. One example of a failed pilot and what you learned (why it failed, how you addressed the issue).
  4. What excites you about AI? [Do not use AI for this answer – we can tell]

title: Associate Lead
description:
Location Name: Pune Corporate Office - Mantri

Job Purpose

As an AI Engineer in Data Intelligence Unit, you will help build and operate the core building blocks of Data Representation learning and Context Engineering across the credit Risk, Fraud/FRM, Sales, Collections & Recovery. You will work with senior engineers and Data scientists to converts raw structured and unstructured data into reliable features, embeddings, retrieval-ready knowledge assets, and repeatable evaluation pipelines – so downstream AI pods can ship models faster, safer, and with measurable quality.

Duties And Responsibilities


 * Data Representation Pipelines
 * Prepare and validate datasets from multiple sources (transactions, bureau, device/digital, documents,
   
   
   

CRM/operations)


 * Implement features engineering pipelines (aggregations, ratios, behavior signals) and maintain feature
   
   
   

definitions.


 * Build large-scale ML systems: distributed training pipelines, feature stores, model registry, CI/CD for ML, and
   
   
   

scalable batch + near-real-time scoring services.


 * Support embedding workflows (text/customer/device/dealer/geo) including batch refresh, versioning, and
   
   
   

lineage.


 * Knowledge Engineering Support (Canonical Objects & Metadata Assets)
 * Help create/maintain canonical objects, entity dictionaries, taxonomies/ontologies, and labeling guidelines.
 * Support annotation/labeling workflows (quality checks, consistency, sampling) for training and evaluation.
 * Experimentation & Model Operations
 * Execute training/inference jobs using established frameworks, log experiments and outcomes.
 * Perform error analysis, data leakage checks, and basic model monitoring (drift signals, data anomalies)
 * Contribute to deployment readiness: tests, reproducible configs, and incident triage support.
 * Retrieval & Context Engineering Support (LLM/RAG enablement)
 * Assist document processing: chunking, cleaning, metadata tagging, indexing access filters.
 * Maintain prompt/context templates, grounding rules, and evaluation sets for RAG/LLM assistants used by
   
   
   

Pods.


 * Run offline evaluations (retrieval quality, answer quality, regressions) and track metrics across releases.
 * Engineering Hygiene & Governance
 * Write clean, testable code; follow Git workflows and CI checks.
 * Maintain documentation: dataset cards, feature notes, pipeline SOPs, and release checklists.
 * Follow security/privacy controls for regulated data, ensuring traceability and auditability.
   
   
   

Basic Qualifications

Required Qualifications and Experience


 * Bachelor’s/Master’s in CS/Math/Engineering
 * 0 – 2 years’ experience in Data Science /Applied ML/ ML Engineering with proven leadership delivering
   
   
   

production – grade ML system at scale.

Required Skills & Competencies Core (must-have)


 * Programming: Python (strong), SQL (strong); Git; basic unit testing.
 * Data: Pandas/PySpark basics, joins/aggregations/window functions, data validation and profiling.
 * ML Fundamentals: supervised/unsupervised learning, embeddings, train/val/test discipline, metrics, and error analysis.
 * Applied System Mindset: reproducibility, structured debugging, logging/monitoring fundamentals. Good-to-have Skills
 * ML frameworks: Pytorch / TensorFlow; experiment tracking (MLFlow)
 * Retrieval stack: vector indexing concepts, chunking strategies, hybrid search ideas, evaluation datasets.
 * Data/Infra: Airflow/Prefect, Spark, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch, MongoDB, feature stores, graph Database, vector database, model serving basics. Preferred Qualifications
 * Experience building end-to-end decisioning platforms with real-time and batch orchestration.
 * Graph ML / entity-resolution experience for relationship-based risk and fraud analysis.
 * Experience operating ML systems across multiple products/segments with multi-tenant controls.
 * Publications/patents or strong track record of innovation in applied ML, large-scale ML systems

title: Intern - Member of Technical Staff
description:
About Vymo

Vymo transforms how financial institutions manage their distribution networks and collections

operations. Our AI-powered DMS and CMS platform serves 350,000+ users across 70+ global financial

enterprises, enabling banks and insurers to optimize performance across their distribution channels, and

empowering banks to drive operational excellence in collections.

Why Global Leaders Choose Vymo

Vymo partners with financial institutions through a comprehensive solution that combines deep domain

expertise with cutting-edge technology. Our platform's human-centric design, coupled with

enterprise-grade scalability and AI-powered intelligence, delivers measurable business outcomes while

ensuring high user adoption and engagement.

Recognition & Trust


 * Backed by $45M+ funding from Peak XV partners (formerly Sequoia), Emergence Capital, and
   
   

Bertelsmann Investments.


 * Trusted by leading global financial institutions including Berkshire Hathaway, AIA, AXA, SBI Life,
   
   

HDFC Bank, Aditya Birla Capital, Tata AIA, ABSLI and many more!


 * Recognized by Celent in their 2024 Distribution Management Solutions report, with an Advanced
   
   

Functionality ranking.


 * Featured in Gartner's Market Guide for Sales Engagement Applications and recognized as a
   
   

"Strong Performer" in Forrester's Sales Engagement Wave Report.


 * Microsoft 'AI for All' award winner for innovation in artificial intelligence
   
   

Explore Vymo on https://vymo.com/

Product:

The evolution of Vymo as a product can be broadly divided into three phases


 * Lead and Activity Management: We provided a mobile-first lead and activity management tool
   
   

that enabled large enterprises with distributed field sales teams to digitize their sales processes

and get real time visibility into their team’s productivity.


 * Sales Engagement Platform: We built capabilities like nudges, goals, playbooks, performance
   
   

dashboards etc that enabled large financial institutions to improve their business outcomes

(faster time to convert, higher sales, increased productivity etc).


 * Distribution Management Platform: We are currently in this phase. With a significant increase in
   
   

the number of apps an average seller uses to perform their day-to-day business activities,

financial institutions are looking to consolidate their tech stack. In addition, we realize that we

have an opportunity to become an insurance “core system” by owning the end-to-end advisory

life cycle - recruitment, onboarding, training, selling, engagement and performance

management.

About The Role

We are looking for passionate Computer Science students who are excited to work on distributed backend systems, high-scale data pipelines, and enterprise-grade APIs. As a Backend Intern, you will contribute to real production systems and work closely with experienced engineers to design, build, and optimize scalable services.

Key Responsibilities


 * Develop and maintain backend services using Node.js and/or Java
 * Design and implement RESTful APIs
 * Work on high-performance database systems including:
    * MongoDB
    * Postgres
    * ClickHouse
    * Elasticsearch

 * Contribute to data pipeline development using:
    * Kafka
    * Debezium (CDC pipelines)

 * Optimize database queries and improve system performance
 * Build scalable and reliable distributed systems
 * Work on data visualization and analytics integrations (Apache Superset)
 * Participate in code reviews, debugging, and performance tuning
 * Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ship production-ready features
 * Write clean, testable, and maintainable code
   
   

Requirements


 * Educational Qualification
    * Freshers- B.Tech / M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field.

 * Technical Skills
    * Strong fundamentals in Data Structures and Algorithms
    * Good understanding of backend development principles
    * Hands-on experience with Node.js and/or Java
    * Experience designing and building REST APIs
    * Good understanding of databases (SQL and NoSQL concepts)
    * Familiarity with
    * MongoDB
    * MySQL / Postgres
    * ClickHouse
    * Elasticsearch
    * Kafka
    * Debezium (Change Data Capture pipelines)
    * Apache Superset
      
      

 * Understanding Of
    * Distributed systems basics
    * Database indexing and query optimization
    * Asynchronous programming
    * Version control systems (Git)

 * Good to Have
    * Experience building scalable systems
    * Knowledge of event-driven architectures
    * Exposure to production monitoring and logging systems
    * Prior backend internship or significant backend project experience

title: Data Analyst II
description:
About The Role

Booking Holdings is a global leader in travel and related services, operating a portfolio of trusted brands that help millions of people experience the world every day. Behind these brands is a large, interconnected organisation where strong financial foundations are critical to operating at scale across regions, markets, and regulatory environments.

Our Finance organisation plays a central role in enabling that scale ensuring accuracy, consistency, and trust in how the business operates and reports. The India Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bangalore is a key part of this global ecosystem, partnering closely with teams across geographies and supporting core finance and accounting activities.

Booking Holdings and its portfolio of brands have been recognised among Forbes World’s Best Employers, TIME & Statista World’s Best Companies, and Forbes Best Employers for New Grads. The India CoE is also Great Place to Work (GPTW) certified, reflecting the culture and people experience we continue to build.

We are looking for an Analyst to join its global function based in the India Centre of Excellence (CoE) in Bangalore. The role supports credit risk and credit analysis activities across the group, working closely with Finance, Accounting, and Commercial teams to assess exposures, support credit decisions, and strengthen risk oversight. Reporting to a Global Credit Risk Manager, the Analyst will bridge financial analysis and data insights to support the group’s evolving business models and risk framework

Key Responsibilities:


 * Responsible for owning the design and delivery of entire Data Analytics solutions based on business requirements, bringing them from the initial idea-generation phase to implementation independently.
 * Design and develop credit risk models using statistical techniques to identify and quantify risk exposures.
 * Translate business problems into data stories, providing intuitive insights that steer critical business decisions.
 * Organize and analyze large datasets to uncover trends and produce meaningful risk reports for internal and external stakeholders.
 * Perform deep-dive impact analysis of credit risk models and conduct both ad hoc and cyclical financial analysis across portfolios.
 * Prepare use case narratives of models for new and existing products and provide recommendations based on the company's risk tolerance.
 * Own the ongoing operations, maintenance, and monitoring of credit risk models to ensure data quality and reporting accuracy.
 * Leverage available technologies to automate reporting mechanisms for tracking risk profiles and monitoring exposure.
 * Anticipate data needs and partner with Data Engineering to ensure the reliability of the credit risk platform.
 * Serve as a "force multiplier" within the team by coaching and mentoring junior colleagues on data analytics best practices.
 * Support the creation of risk policies and ensure these are operationalised to manage various aspects across business, including supporting the implementation, adherence and maintenance of Credit Risk Policies;
 * Continuously liaise with key stakeholders across the business to understand business priorities/requirements and requirements and identify associated risks to support with business decisions, to adjust credit risk models;
 * Develop strong business relationships with key internal stakeholders across finance, fintech and other cross functional teams.
   
   
   

Qualifications & Skills:


 * 5+ years of relevant experience gained in a quantitative role, preferably within finance, banking or related field;
 * You have an academic degree (MSc or PhD), preferably in a quantitative field - preferably a Master’s degree.
 * Proven experience in executing big data analytics projects in an industry setting.
 * Advanced knowledge of SQL, Python, Pyspark and/ or other statistical and advanced programming languages.
 * Experience in credit risk is a big plus.
 * Problem solving ability, analytical mindset aligned with high attention to detail.
 * Excellent communication skills (both written and verbal) in English and ability to effectively convey difficult or complex information in an easy to understand manner while adapting style and approach based on the seniority of applicable stakeholders.
 * Familiarity with Big data platforms ( Snowflake, AWS) and version control is a plus.
 * Experience of working with ETL and Data Modelling tools like Airflow, Dagster and DBT is a plus.
 * Experience with data visualization tools like Tableau is a plus.
 * Self-starter, who is able to work with minimal supervision and prioritize tasks to meet required deadlines.
   
   
   

Pre-Employment Screening

If your application is successful, your personal data may be used for a pre-employment screening check by a third party as permitted by applicable law. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

title: Associate Director-Sector Insights -Power and Utilities
description:
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Senior Domain Analyst

Associate Director

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

As a Senior Domain Analyst at EY, you will be an expert on key domain topics, contributing to EY's distinctive perspective on client issues within the domain. You will lead specific programs within your area of expertise, delivering high-impact analysis and insights for the Domain and its activation with clients. Recognized as a subject matter expert, you will provide analytical support and strategic advice on domain developments to both clients and EY leadership.

Your key responsibilities:


 * Develop a strong internal brand to become recognized within EY as a leader and subject matter expert, shaping go to market narratives and influencing client buyer decisions at the business unit and executive level.
 * Engage with senior domain stakeholders to provide commercial perspectives on issues, challenges, and opportunities facing the domain, preparing insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients.
 * Participate in client meetings and represent the firm at selected events to enhance EY’s presence in the market.
 * Collaborate with domain stakeholders and EY colleagues across Insights and Clients and Industries to drive the development of new Insights agendas and support business development activities and service delivery to clients.
 * Working with the Lead Analyst, proactively support the development of the Insights strategy for the domain, based on business priorities and a detailed understanding of the domain’s dynamics.
 * Lead the creation of specific insights by leveraging EY’s proprietary knowledge, emerging tools and technologies (like AI) and collaborating with Clients and Industries colleagues.
 * Identify opportunities for cross-Domain collaboration and share insights with other Insights and Clients and Industries teams and lead key cross domain initiatives.
 * Synthesize diverse perspectives and sources to develop compelling insights that drive results.
 * Use qualitative and quantitative research methodologies to provide analytic insights.
 * Coach less-experienced team members to improve their skills in research, analysis, data analytics, and visualization.
   
   

Skills And Attributes For Success


 * Strong presentation skills and commercial storytelling, with experience influencing senior clients and internal decision-makers.
 * Demonstrated experience in a fast-paced, client-driven environment.
 * A proactive self-starter, able to bring new ideas for new insights to leadership.
 * Advanced skills in AI enabled insights generation.
 * Collaborative and able to work effectively in a global, multi-cultural environment.
 * Excellent oral and written communication skills, capable of explaining complex concepts clearly and concisely.
 * Ability to proactively build a network of internal and external contacts to shape insights.
 * Proficient in managing multiple projects simultaneously.
   
   

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals who are curious, strategic thinkers with a commercial perspective driven by an understanding of client experiences and broader marketplace dynamics. You should have strong analytical skills and the ability to present insights to clients, including at the executive level, in support of the domain’s agenda. A collaborative mindset is essential, as you will play a vital role in responding to emerging issues with technical experts across the EY network. You will work closely with the Domain Lead Analyst and other Analysts to deliver insightful content that helps EY differentiate itself in the marketplace and proactively identify new business opportunities and risks.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

Senior Domain Analyst

Associate Director

At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.

We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.

Join EY and help to build a better working world.

The opportunity

As a Senior Domain Analyst at EY, you will be an expert on key domain topics, contributing to EY's distinctive perspective on client issues within the domain. You will lead specific programs within your area of expertise, delivering high-impact analysis and insights for the Domain and its activation with clients. Recognized as a subject matter expert, you will provide analytical support and strategic advice on domain developments to both clients and EY leadership.

Your key responsibilities:

  • Develop a strong internal brand to become recognized within EY as a leader and subject matter expert, shaping go to market narratives and influencing client buyer decisions at the business unit and executive level.
  • Engage with senior domain stakeholders to provide commercial perspectives on issues, challenges, and opportunities facing the domain, preparing insightful analysis on the impact of those trends for EY and its clients.
  • Participate in client meetings and represent the firm at selected events to enhance EY’s presence in the market.
  • Collaborate with domain stakeholders and EY colleagues across Insights and Clients and Industries to drive the development of new Insights agendas and support business development activities and service delivery to clients.
  • Working with the Lead Analyst, proactively support the development of the Insights strategy for the domain, based on business priorities and a detailed understanding of the domain’s dynamics.
  • Lead the creation of specific insights by leveraging EY’s proprietary knowledge, emerging tools and technologies (like AI) and collaborating with Clients and Industries colleagues.
  • Identify opportunities for cross-Domain collaboration and share insights with other Insights and Clients and Industries teams and lead key cross domain initiatives.
  • Synthesize diverse perspectives and sources to develop compelling insights that drive results.
  • Use qualitative and quantitative research methodologies to provide analytic insights.
  • Coach less-experienced team members to improve their skills in research, analysis, data analytics, and visualization.

Skills And Attributes For Success

  • Strong presentation skills and commercial storytelling, with experience influencing senior clients and internal decision-makers.
  • Demonstrated experience in a fast-paced, client-driven environment.
  • A proactive self-starter, able to bring new ideas for new insights to leadership.
  • Advanced skills in AI enabled insights generation.
  • Collaborative and able to work effectively in a global, multi-cultural environment.
  • Excellent oral and written communication skills, capable of explaining complex concepts clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to proactively build a network of internal and external contacts to shape insights.
  • Proficient in managing multiple projects simultaneously.

What We Look For

We are looking for individuals who are curious, strategic thinkers with a commercial perspective driven by an understanding of client experiences and broader marketplace dynamics. You should have strong analytical skills and the ability to present insights to clients, including at the executive level, in support of the domain’s agenda. A collaborative mindset is essential, as you will play a vital role in responding to emerging issues with technical experts across the EY network. You will work closely with the Domain Lead Analyst and other Analysts to deliver insightful content that helps EY differentiate itself in the marketplace and proactively identify new business opportunities and risks.

What We Offer You

At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.

Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.

To help create the best experience during the recruitment process, please describe any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.

EY | Building a better working world

EY is building a better working world by creating new value for clients, people, society and the planet, while building trust in capital markets.

Enabled by data, AI and advanced technology, EY teams help clients shape the future with confidence and develop answers for the most pressing issues of today and tomorrow.

EY teams work across a full spectrum of services in assurance, consulting, tax, strategy and transactions. Fueled by sector insights, a globally connected, multi-disciplinary network and diverse ecosystem partners, EY teams can provide services in more than 150 countries and territories.

title: Senior Project Data Analyst (PSO)
description:
Job Title

Senior Project Data Analyst (PSO)

Job Description

JOB TITLE:Senior Project Data Analyst (PSO)

The Senior Project Data Analyst is a core member of the Project Management Support Office (PMSO). This role leads a small team of PSO Coordinators and acts as the central driving force for project analytics, technology enablement, and operational efficiency across Product Development programs. The role combines project management experience, product development domain knowledge, and advanced digital automation skills (Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, Smartsheet) to elevate how the PMO delivers insights, reporting, and workflow automation. This position plays a critical role in modernizing the PMO, enabling predictive decision-making, and driving smart automation initiatives that reduce manual work, improve accuracy, and increase execution speed.


 * Key Responsibilities
 * PMO Operations & Project Support
 * Lead, coach, and manage a team of PSO Coordinators supporting multiple projects across the product development lifecycle.
 * Oversee project planning, tracking, financials, documentation control, and reporting, ensuring alignment with PMO standards
 * Work with PMs to ensure all project reporting needs (status updates, dashboards, PMO reports) are consistently delivered with quality & reporting happens via Smartsheet (project plans, execution dashboards, risk logs).
 * Data Analytics & Reporting
 * Own and deliver enterprise-grade reports and dashboards using:
    * Power BI (portfolio KPIs, milestone health, risk heatmaps, capacity reports)
    * Smartsheet dashboards (automated project health summaries, critical path insights)

 * Establish automated data flows and reporting pipelines using Power Query / DAX.
 * Improve visibility of project performance through actionable insights and trend analytics.
 * Lead PMO digitization initiatives using the Power Platform:
 * 
    * Build Power Apps to replace manual trackers and forms.
    * Use Power Automate to eliminate repetitive tasks (approvals, reminders, workflows, updates).

 * Drive integration of Smartsheet with Power BI, Power Automate, MS Teams, and SharePoint for seamless execution.
 * Recommend new tools and methods to improve PMO efficiency (predictive analytics, AI-assisted reporting, automated health scoring).
 * Process Standardization & Continuous Improvement
 * Standardize PMO reporting cadence, templates, documentation, and governance models.
 * Identify inefficiencies across PMO processes and propose automation opportunities to reduce effort and cycle time.
 * Contribute to PMO capability building—training PMs and PSO coordinators on digital tool usage.
 * Required Skills & Experience
 * Technical Skills
 * Demonstrated expertise in Power BI (DAX, modeling, advanced visualization).
 * Strong proficiency in:
    * Power Apps (canvas & model-driven apps)
    * Power Automate (flows, triggers, connectors)
    * MS Excel (advanced)
    * Smartsheet (formulas, automated workflows, dashboards, reports)

 * Strong understanding of SharePoint, Teams, and cross-system integrations.
 * Experience using or supporting PLM/Document Control systems (Windchill preferred).
 * Project Management & PMO Knowledge
 * Overall 12+ Experience of which 8+ years working in Project Management, PMO, or Product Development environments.
 * Solid understanding of end-to-end PDLM / Product Development processes (concept–launch–sustaining).
 * Experience supporting or managing large cross-functional programs.
 * Ability to read and interpret project schedules, risks, mitigation plans, resource demands, and budgets.
 * Prior exposure to stage-gate processes
 * Leadership & Behavioral Skills
 * Demonstrated experience leading small teams or coordinators.
 * Strong influencing skills; able to partner with global R\&D, Quality, Marketing, and Operations.
 * Ability to simplify complex data into clear executive-level insights.
 * High ownership, discipline, and proactive problem-solving mindset.
 * Customer-centric, collaborative, and passionate about process excellence.
 * Education
 * Bachelor’s degree required (Engineering, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Business Management, or related field).
 * Master’s degree preferred.
 * PMP, CAPM, Agile certifications, or similar credential is an added advantage.
 * What Success Looks Like
 * PMO reporting becomes automated, accurate, and insight-driven.
 * Reduction in manual work for PMs and PSO coordinators through workflow automation.
 * Improved portfolio visibility, milestone predictability, and data integrity.
 * PMO becomes significantly more digitally enabled, enabling faster and smarter execution.
 * Team of PSO Coordinators operates with clarity, consistency, and high performance.
 * Additional Notes (Optional)
 * Role may interact with global teams across EU, APAC, and US.
 * Occasional travel to R\&D or manufacturing sites depending on business needs.

title: Data Engineer
description:
About Catalytics Datum

Catalytics Datum is the Next-Gen Enterprise that amalgamates Data Science, Big Data, Cloud Computing & Business Intelligence to solve complex business problems for enterprises through user experience and faster decision-making. Recognized by Microsoft BizSpark, Catalytics is present across the globe to become your partner in Digital Transformation.

Catalytics Datum offers Platform as a Service, which is One Stop Solution. The complete process; starting from Requirement Gathering to the Final Deployment, is data-driven, processed by collaborative and different Predictive modeling tools which leave clients overhead free. We provide up to 99.9% accurate results in order to increase profitability by providing the deepest insights of your brands.

 

Role Summary

We are looking for a Data Engineer (1-4 years experience) to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, data warehouses, and data lakes that power analytics, machine learning, and reporting. You’ll work closely with analytics, data science, and business teams to ensure data is reliable, accessible, and production-ready.




Skills & Competencies

Role Overview:

Design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines, warehouses, and lakes. Enable data accessibility for analytics, ML, and reporting. Mapped Skills / Tools: Cloud Data Platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), Data Engineering Fundamentals.

Core Responsibilities:

Develop & manage ETL/ELT pipelines; Build and optimize data warehouses & lakes; Ensure data quality & governance; Enable real-time & batch processing; Support AI/ML model data needs. Mapped Skills / Tools: SQL, Python, Scala, Databricks, Spark, Hadoop, Kafka, Azure Data Factory, dbt, Airflow.

Data Modeling:

Design schemas & data models; Optimize queries & storage; Implement star/snowflake schemas. Mapped Skills / Tools: SQL, Relational DBs, NoSQL, Data Vault, Dimensional Modeling.

Data Governance:

Implement access controls, lineage, cataloging; Ensure compliance with GDPR, HIPAA, SOC2 (awareness level). Mapped Skills / Tools: Azure Purview, Unity Catalog, Collibra, Data Quality/Observability Tools.

Infrastructure & Ops:

Build CI/CD for data pipelines; Monitor cost, performance & reliability. Mapped Skills / Tools: DevOps, GitHub/GitLab, Docker, Kubernetes (basic), Terraform (basic), Azure DevOps.

Collaboration:

Work with analysts, data scientists, and business teams; Translate requirements into data solutions. Mapped Skills / Tools: Agile/Scrum, JIRA, Confluence, Business Communication.

Required Skills:

Strong SQL, Python, and/or Scala; Hands-on cloud data experience; Knowledge of big data frameworks; ETL/ELT pipeline development. Mapped Skills / Tools: SQL, Python, Scala, Spark, Hadoop, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, AWS Glue, dbt.

Preferred Skills:

Experience with Databricks & Delta Lake; Exposure to ML pipelines; Familiarity with APIs & microservices; Knowledge of observability tools. Mapped Skills / Tools: Databricks, Delta Lake, MLflow, Ragas, Great Expectations, REST APIs, GraphQL.

Soft Skills:

Strong communication & teamwork; Analytical problem solving; Ownership & accountability; Ability to explain the data journey (raw → curated → consumed) to technical & non-technical stakeholders using PPT. Mapped Skills / Tools: Collaboration, Agile mindset, Documentation, Critical Thinking.




Key Responsibilities

 * Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines for batch and near real-time data
 * Develop and optimize data warehouse and data lake structures
 * Ensure data quality, reliability, and basic governance controls
 * Support data consumption for analytics and ML use cases
 * Monitor pipeline health, performance, and costs
 * Collaborate with analysts and data scientists to deliver trusted datasets
 * Contribute to CI/CD pipelines and basic DevOps practices for data




Minimum Qualifications

 * 1–2 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering or Analytics Engineering
 * Strong SQL and working knowledge of Python (or Scala)
 * Experience working on at least one cloud platform (Azure/AWS/GCP)
 * Exposure to building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines
 * Familiarity with data warehouses/lakes and dimensional modeling basics




Nice-to-Have Qualifications

 * Hands-on exposure to Databricks & Delta Lake
 * Familiarity with Airflow/dbt for orchestration and transformations
 * Exposure to ML data pipelines or feature engineering
 * Understanding of data observability and quality frameworks




What Success Looks Like (First 6 Months)

 * Reliable data pipelines running in production with low failure rates
 * Clean, well-documented data models adopted by analytics teams
 * Improved data freshness and quality metrics
 * Positive feedback from analysts/data scientists on dataset usability
 * Increased ownership of one end-to-end data pipeline

title: Data Entry Specialist
description:
Who we are

COMPLY is a fast-growing SaaS leader in the Compliance and Regulatory technology space. Serving more than 7,000 financial services firms globally, our unique portfolio of services and software transform how firms proactively assess, identify, and manage risk. The world’s largest hedge funds, private equity firms, wealth asset managers, and institutional brokers trust us to help them navigate a complex and challenging regulatory environment as pursue new opportunities.




We are passionate about what we do, how we do and why we do it. Success will be determined by the quality and character of the people we bring into our organization and the performance they achieve.




Come join our global team of talented professionals and work with a company that appreciates and rewards people who make a difference.




The Role

We are looking for a polished, passionate, and empathetic Data Entry Analyst to join our dynamic team and take our highly rated data services team to the next level! In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and managing client facing data projects to meet deadlines, improving upon existing processes for added department efficiency, and acting as a liaison between our client and the data services team members. Our ideal candidate is patient with investigating and troubleshooting to effectively resolve issues, has a “How Can I Help” mindset, and thrives in a fast-paced environment focused on providing an exceptional data services experience. If you are genuinely excited to help customers, problem-solving comes naturally to you, and you strive to exceed data services expectations, lets connect!




The Career Opportunity

This position has high expectations as you will have extensive exposure to our Customer Success, Customer Support, and Sales teams at all levels. If you excel in this role, there is potential for advancement, learning, and overall career development within the organization!




Responsibilities:

 * Assist with operations by contributing new ideas toward expanding the team’s scope and effectiveness.
 * Assist with backend and administrative functions of the Professional Services team.
 * Transcribe key data from brokerage statements into the ComplySci platform.
 * Utilize translation and automation tools to convert statements containing foreign language into English.
 * Coordinate with other Data Entry Analysts to determine priority clients to service week-over-week.
 * Create detailed notes of any data entry issues that come about.
 * Conduct routine quality control audits of ongoing manual data entry operations.
 * Perform ad-hoc administrative tasks as needed.




Qualifications:

 * Bachelor’s Degree with 0-3 years of work experience.
 * Strong Microsoft Excel experience (Vlookups, Hlookups, pivot tables, VBA)
 * Major in Accounting, Finance or Economics is a plus!
 * Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.
 * Ability to accurately analyze and interpret data.
 * Exceptional organizational and time management skills.
 * Superior troubleshooting, resolution, and analysis skills.
 * Previous operational experience in Power BI.
 * Ability to perform complex tasks and prioritize multiple projects.
 * Basic to advanced knowledge of securities and training markets a plus!
 * Previous experience in a high-volume call environment and/or Data Services role is a plus!
 * Experience with Salesforce.com (or other CRM systems), SaaS technology, MS Office, software support is a plus!




COMPLY is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, disability, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin. Nothing in this job posting should be construed as an offer or guarantee of employment.

title: Senior Analyst, People Analytics
description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Senior Analyst, People Analytics

Overview

Mastercard is a global leader in technology and payments, committed to empowering businesses and economies to thrive. Our Global People Operations & Insights team is at the forefront of leveraging data to drive strategic decisions about our most valuable asset – our talent.

The Senior Reporting Analyst will be a member of the Data Service team within the People, Operations and Insights team which provides data, analytics, and strategic decision support across multiple business units in regions across Mastercard.

This individual will bring experience in analytics and reporting to enable data-driven decisions about talent at Mastercard. Competitive candidates will be detail-oriented, execution-focused, and accomplished with identifying opportunities to introduce consistency & scale to analytical outputs within a matrixed organization.

Essential

All About You

Overall 3-6 years of career experience in a similar field

Experience in People / Human Resources Analytics

Excel experience including creating pivot datasets, conditional formulas and formatting, essential formulas, and charts/graphs

Experience communicating technical results to non-technical audiences

Ability to collaborate with peers and cross-functional teams, working across multiple time zones

Flexible and responsive, with ability to adapt to rapid change in direction or business priority

Openness to feedback and strong self-awareness

Excellent verbal and written communication skills

Ability to work within the confines of data governance and privacy standards

Experience operating in an environment with handling multiple priorities at any given time

Experience With Querying Databases (SQL Or T-SQL Preferred)

Experience in BI tools (Tableau or Power BI preferred)

Experience in working with organizational/workforce data

Experience in providing regular reporting for a leadership audience, including attention to detail and ensuring consistency in presentation/output for scaled deliverables

Strong ability to see the forest for the trees, and implement creative strategies to reduce ad-hoc request volume and increase value

Proactive approach and style; comfortable with navigating through areas of ambiguity

Desirable

Experience Using HRIS Tools (Workday Preferred)

Experience in relationship building across large-scale organizations

Experience managing and analyzing structured and unstructured data using tools such as SQL, R, or Python

Familiarity with ETL tool capabilities and utility (e.g., Alteryx, SPSS, Informatica)

Role

First point of contact for recurring reporting & metrics requests from stakeholders across multiple functions globally

Partners closely with People Analytics Consultants within the broader People Operations and Insights team to identify opportunities to create scalable reporting solutions & visualizations

Sees beyond requestors’ asks to understand the root query or challenge for which data are being requested

Validates and enforces people data integrity in collaboration with Data management & HR Systems teams

Provides reporting & program management support for BAU activities, examples include annual performance management, talent reviews, employee experience surveys, and other key activities as warranted

Demonstrates exceptional judgment and discretion when dealing with highly sensitive people data

Corporate Security Responsibility
