title: Analyst/Senior Analyst - Data Analytics (Reference Data Management) - Financial Research
companyName: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $65 billion in investment capital as of December 1, 2024, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world's capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.

We are looking for candidates to join the Data Analytics (DA) team within our Financial Research group based in Hyderabad. The team partners closely with teams across Financial Research, as well as with Front Office and Technology functions, to manage critical data processes and deliver structured analytical support across the firm’s quantitative and discretionary investment strategies.

WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY-TO-DAY:

In this role, you will support multiple asset classes including equities, futures, options, etc. by ensuring the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of reference data and security master information across global business lines. You will play a critical role in enabling seamless downstream processes by partnering closely with trading, and technology teams. You will manage the setup, maintenance, and ongoing validation of security master attributes across asset classes, maintaining high standards of data integrity and adherence to internal controls. You will investigate and resolve data issues through structured root cause analysis and proactive coordination with internal and external stakeholders. In addition, you will support time-sensitive, business-critical processes driven by the data analytics function, analyze large datasets to generate ad hoc insights, and contribute to reporting that informs operational decision-making. You will also identify opportunities to streamline workflows and drive automation initiatives that enhance efficiency and scalability across business processes.

WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:

The ideal candidate should hold-

Basic qualifications:


 * A master’s degree in finance or an equivalent discipline, with 1 to 2.5 years of relevant experience in the financial services industry, preferably within reference data, operations, middle office, or analytical support functions
 * The ability to demonstrate robust understanding of financial instruments, security setup and maintenance
 * Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including VBA, macros, and Power Query; experience in automation will be an added advantage
 * Excellent analytical skills, with a keen attention to detail and a robust focus on data accuracy and quality
 * Intellectual curiosity and initiative, with the ability to synthesize information from multiple sources, think critically, and learn quickly in a dynamic, data-driven environment
 * Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate insights and collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams
   
   

Preferred qualifications:


 * Familiarity with SQL, Python, automation, or Artificial Intelligence tools
 * Hands on experience with financial data platforms such as Bloomberg, Refinitiv (Reuters), and Capital IQ
   
   

Interested candidates can apply through our website:

https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/AnaSrAanaDAMarch26

We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender-neutral return-to-work initiative.

The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers

title: Data Scientist
description:
The Company
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.

We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.

We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.

Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.

Job Description Summary:
This job will develop and implement data science models and algorithms to support business needs. You will work with stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver solutions. Your role involves ensuring data quality, optimizing data processes, and collaborating with cross-functional teams.

Job Description:
Essential Responsibilities:


 * Develop and implement data science models and algorithms.
 * Analyze and interpret complex data sets.
 * Ensure data quality and integrity.
 * Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data requirements.
 * Optimize data processes for efficiency and performance.
 * Perform advanced statistical analysis and reporting.
   
   
   

Expected Qualifications:


 * Minimum of 2 years of relevant work experience and a Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
   
   
   

Additional Responsibilities And Preferred Qualifications

 * Solid technical / data-mining skills and ability to work with large volumes of data; extract and manipulate large datasets using common tools such as SQL, SAS, Hadoop, or other programming/scripting languages (Python, R, etc.) to translate data into business decisions/results
 * Be data-driven and outcome-focused
 * Must have good business judgment with demonstrated ability to think creatively and strategically
 * Must be an intuitive, organized analytical thinker, with the ability to perform detailed analysis
 * Takes personal ownership; Self-starter; Ability to drive projects with minimal guidance and focus on high impact work
 * Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering or related field with 2-3 years’ experience, or Master’s degree with 1-2 years’ experience in risk management, data science and/or loss forecasting, in the payments space or banking/finance services industry would be particularly desirable.
 * Proficiency using SQL and querying relational databases
 * Experience in at least one statistical programming language (SAS, R, Python)
 * Familiarity with reporting tools (Tableau, Power BI or Qlik) is highly desired.
 * Experience in predictive modelling techniques such as Regression, Classification, Time series forecasting, NLP, etc.
 * Experience with structuring analyses to solve business problems using data and analytics tools and techniques
   
   
   

PayPal does not charge candidates any fees for courses, applications, resume reviews, interviews, background checks, or onboarding. Any such request is a red flag and likely part of a scam. To learn more about how to identify and avoid recruitment fraud please visit https://careers.pypl.com/contact-us.

For the majority of employees, PayPal's balanced hybrid work model offers 3 days in the office for effective in-person collaboration and 2 days at your choice of either the PayPal office or your home workspace, ensuring that you equally have the benefits and conveniences of both locations.

Our Benefits:

At PayPal, we’re committed to building an equitable and inclusive global economy. And we can’t do this without our most important asset-you. That’s why we offer benefits to help you thrive in every stage of life. We champion your financial, physical, and mental health by offering valuable benefits and resources to help you care for the whole you.

We have great benefits including a flexible work environment, employee shares options, health and life insurance and more. To learn more about our benefits please visit https://www.paypalbenefits.com

Who We Are:

To learn more about our culture and community visit https://about.pypl.com/who-we-are/default.aspx

Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

PayPal provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. In addition, PayPal will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities. If you are unable to submit an application because of incompatible assistive technology or a disability, please contact us at paypalglobaltalentacquisition@paypal.com.

Belonging at PayPal:

Our employees are central to advancing our mission, and we strive to create an environment where everyone can do their best work with a sense of purpose and belonging. Belonging at PayPal means creating a workplace with a sense of acceptance and security where all employees feel included and valued. We are proud to have a diverse workforce reflective of the merchants, consumers, and communities that we serve, and we continue to take tangible actions to cultivate inclusivity and belonging at PayPal.

Any general requests for consideration of your skills, please Join our Talent Community.

We know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates. Please don’t hesitate to apply.

title: Data Engineer
description:
A growing firm operating in the Recruitment & HR Services sector, delivering talent solutions and HR analytics to enterprise customers across India. We use data-driven engineering to power hiring intelligence, workforce planning, and operational reporting. This is an on-site Data Engineering role based in India, focused on building scalable pipelines and analytics platforms that support people and business insights.

Primary job title: Data Engineer

Role & Responsibilities


 * Design, build, and maintain robust batch and streaming data pipelines to ingest, transform, and store HR and operational data.
 * Develop and optimize ETL workflows using industry-standard tools to populate and curate the cloud data warehouse.
 * Implement data models, schema designs, and partitioning strategies to support analytics and reporting performance.
 * Collaborate with analytics, product, and operations teams to translate business requirements into reliable data solutions.
 * Monitor data quality and pipeline health; implement alerting, retries, and remediation for production issues.
 * Drive cost and performance optimizations across compute, storage, and ingestion layers; document runbooks and best practices.
   
   

Skills & Qualifications

Must-Have


 * SQL
 * Python
 * ETL
 * Apache Airflow
 * Apache Spark
 * Amazon Web Services (AWS)
   
   

Preferred


 * Snowflake
 * Apache Kafka
 * dbt
   
   

Qualifications


 * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
 * Proven track record building production data pipelines and maintaining data warehouses or lakehouse architectures.
 * Ability to work full-time on-site in India and collaborate across engineering and business stakeholders.
   
   

Benefits & Culture Highlights


 * Opportunity to influence HR-tech analytics used by enterprise clients and impact hiring decisions at scale.
 * Collaborative, data-driven environment with focus on learning and engineering excellence.
 * Competitive compensation, training allowances, and clear growth pathways for technical contributors.
   
   

To apply: Submit your resume highlighting relevant data engineering projects and technologies. Join a team that turns HR data into actionable insights—build scalable systems, improve decision-making, and see your work drive measurable business outcomes.

title: Data Engineer
description:
This role is for one of Zepcruit's clients.




Job Description:

Junior Data Engineer

Location: Baner, Pune, Maharashtra.

Experience: 1–3 years

Type: Full-Time




About The Role:

We are seeking a motivated Junior Data Engineer to support our data engineering initiatives. You will work closely with senior engineers to design, build, and maintain scalable data pipelines on Azure. This role is ideal for someone who wants to grow into a senior/lead data engineering position in the future.




Key Responsibilities: -

 * Assist in building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines using Azure Data Factory.
 * Develop, optimize, and test data transformation workflows using Azure Databricks (PySpark/SQL).
 * Work with stakeholders to understand data needs and support analytical and reporting requirements.
 * Support senior engineers in designing scalable and secure data architectures.
 * Perform data validation, quality checks, and ensure clean and reliable data flow.
 * Monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize data pipelines for performance and cost.
 * Collaborate with data analysts, data scientists, and other engineering teams.

Required Skills & Experience: -

 * 1–3 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in a similar data-focused role.
 * Mandatory:
 * Hands-on experience with Azure Databricks (PySpark, Delta Lake).
 * Strong knowledge of Azure Data Factory (pipelines, triggers, activities).
 * Good understanding of SQL (optimization, joins, data modeling basics).
 * Familiarity with Azure storage solutions (ADLS Gen2, Blob Storage).
 * Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and version control (Git).
 * Strong problem-solving skills and willingness to learn.




Good to Have: -

 * Exposure to Azure Synapse, Azure Functions, or Event Hub/Kafka.
 * Experience working with structured and unstructured datasets.
 * Knowledge of Python for scripting.
 * Understanding of data warehousing concepts (Star/Snowflake schema).

Why Join Us: -

 * Opportunity to work with experienced data engineers and grow quickly in your career.
 * Work on modern data platforms and cutting-edge Azure technologies.
 * Supportive environment focused on learning, ownership, and innovation.
 * Chance to contribute meaningfully to end-to-end data engineering projects.

At LPL’s Global Capability Center, you'll find a collaborative culture where your voice matters, integrity guides every decision, and technology fuels progress. LPL's success reflects its exceptional employees, who together pursue one noble purpose: empowering financial advisors to deliver personalized advice for all who need it. We’re proud to be expanding and reaching new heights in Hyderabad.

Join us as we create something extraordinary together.

Job Overview

We are seeking a creative and hands-on BI and data engineer with extensive experience delivering advanced analytics and enterprise reporting and BI solutions. This role will be pivotal in bridging business needs with data discoverability and use, ensuring our customers have access to trusted insights for use to drive our business forward.

Responsibilities


 * Lead the development and delivery of the LPL Intelligence Marketplace, enabling consumers to discover and use certified data and AI assets through a unified experience
 * Design, develop, and maintain enterprise BI solutions, including data models, data marts, and reporting systems
 * Build and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines to extract, transform, and load data from diverse sources into centralized repositories (data warehouses, data lakes)
 * Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, and Alteryx
 * Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements, translate business needs into technical solutions, and deliver actionable insights
 * Ensure data quality, integrity, and consistency across all BI deliverables; implement data validation and reconciliation processes
 * Support and enhance data governance, cataloging, and lineage initiatives to ensure compliance and transparency
 * Optimize database queries, data models, and reporting performance for scalability and efficiency
 * Troubleshoot and resolve data-related issues, supporting business users and analysts in their data needs
 * Document BI processes, data flows, and technical specifications; provide training and support to end users
 * Stay current with BI trends, tools, and best practices; recommend and implement improvements to BI architecture and processes
   
   

What are we looking for?

We’re looking for strong collaborators who deliver exceptional client experiences and thrive in fast-paced, team-oriented environments. Our ideal candidates pursue greatness, act with integrity, and are driven to help our clients succeed. We value those who embrace creativity, continuous improvement, and contribute to a culture where we win together and create and share joy in our work.

Requirements


 * 3+ years of experience cloud-based enterprise business intelligence tooling, with at least 2 years focused on delivering data and ent3+ years of experience cloud-based enterprise business intelligence tooling, with at least 2 years focused on delivering data and enterprise-level BI solutions for advanced analytics
 * Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer science or related field; Master’s degree preferred
 * Demonstrable hands-on experience with:
    * Advanced development experience in Tableau, Power BI, and Alteryx for dashboarding, data preparation, and advanced analytics
    * Data modeling and warehousing: designing star/snowflake schemas, building data marts, and optimizing for analytical workloads
    * ETL/ELT development: building and maintaining pipelines using tools such as Alteryx, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, or dbt.
    * SQL: advanced query writing, performance tuning, and data analysis
    * Scripting/programming: Python or R for data processing and automation
    * UI: experience in delivering custom UI analytics and dashboard solutions preferred

 * Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, and security best practices.
 * Advanced Tableau experience required.
   

Preferences


 * Experience in financial services or other regulated industries is a plus, wealth management experience preferred
 * Advanced knowledge and experiencing in delivering data access/discoverability experiences – delivering quality trusted data for analysts to use
 * Experience with enterprise-scale BI deployments and self-service analytics enablement
 * Demonstrated use of AI/ML tools to augment engineering and BI productivity
 * Familiarity with data cataloging, lineage, and metadata management tools
 * Knowledge of advanced analytics, machine learning, or statistical modeling
 * Advanced analytics user interface and design experience
 * BI or cloud certifications (e.g., Tableau Desktop Specialist, Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, AWS Certified Data Analytics)
   
   

Skills & Tools


 * Tableau, Power BI, Alteryx
 * SQL, Python, R
 * ETL/ELT tools (Alteryx, SSIS, Informatica, Talend, dbt)
 * Data warehousing (Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Synapse)
 * Data governance & cataloging (Collibra, Alation, Atlan)
 * Cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP)
 * Version control (Git), CI/CD for BI assets

title: Sustainability Senior Analyst - Data & Analytics
description:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

BCG has set an industry-leading net zero commitment that requires rigorous measurement systems, trusted reporting, and scalable operational processes. As a Sustainability Senior Analyst, you will play a critical supporting role within BCG’s Global Internal Sustainability Team, working closely with the Sustainability Data & Analytics Manager to help operationalize the firm’s carbon reduction program.

You will contribute to the build-out, maintenance, and continuous improvement of sustainability data systems, providing analytical and operational support to ensure accurate, transparent, and actionable greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions insights. You will partner closely with BCG’s Data Tribe and technical product teams to operationalize tools, integrate data sources, and promote adoption across global stakeholders.

You Will Be Responsible For


 * Supporting the implementation of systems and processes to gather, process, and validate complex GHG emissions data at scale
 * Assisting in integrating data sources and manage automated data pipelines using tools such as Snowflake, DBT, and Airflow
 * Developing and maintaining interactive dashboards (e.g., Tableau) to track progress toward carbon reduction goals
 * Executing routine data quality assurance checks to maintain a reliable single source of truth
 * Supporting the annual carbon footprint calculation and the external audit of GHG emissions data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timely delivery
 * Preparing documentation, SOPs, and reference materials to support robust operational processes
 * Providing ad-hoc quantitative and analytical support to ongoing sustainability strategy and program work
   
   

You’re Good At (roles And Responsibilities)


 * Working collaboratively and delivering high-quality, detail-oriented analytical work
 * Managing multiple priorities and deadlines while maintaining strong attention to detail
 * Communicating clearly and proactively with stakeholders across geographies and functions
 * Applying a structured, logical approach to problem solving in data-heavy environments
 * Exercising strong judgment around data quality, accuracy, and consistency
 * Building strong working relationships and supporting change adoption across a diverse global audience
   
   

What You'll Bring

Must-have Technical Experience


 * Fluency in SQL and hands-on experience with cloud-based enterprise data tools such as Snowflake and DBT
 * Demonstrated experience building complex, enterprise-grade dashboards in Tableau or similar analytics platforms
 * Experience working with large and complex data sets to support accurate reporting
 * Strong understanding of ETL processes and working with APIs
 * Excellent written and verbal communication skills including drafting technical documentation
   
   

Preferred Qualifications


 * Familiarity with greenhouse gas accounting principles and sustainability reporting frameworks
 * Experience with BCG systems such as SAP, Workday, or ChromeRiver
 * Advanced Excel skills (PowerQuery, VBA, macros, advanced functions)
 * Experience using JIRA or similar project management tools
   
   

Who You'll Work With

You will report directly to the Sustainability Data & Analytics Manager and work closely with BCG Sustainability Director for Measurement and Reporting. You will engage regularly with BCG’s Data Tribe and other key data and product owners across BCG. You will also work with external vendors from Quantis and CO2AI on annual reporting tasks.

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.
